column2: An sinister heart method where each layer of cultivation adds another degree of killing intent to the mind; those with shallow cultivation or those who rush the training easily suffer qi deviation and go berserk

column1: 源于佛门，一种套路多变，以灵活见长的棍法，其中挑、点、戳的招式极多，可用于封人穴脉
column2: A Buddhist-origin staff art with varied sequences, known for agility; rich in flicking, pointing, and jabbing moves that can seal acupoints

column1: 源于佛门，一种套路简练，以力道见长的棍法，其中扫、劈、拨的招式极多，可压制整片敌人
column2: A Buddhist-origin staff art with concise sequences, known for power; rich in sweeping, chopping, and deflecting moves that can overwhelm entire groups

column1: 源于天竺的金刚宗杵形法器，象征所向无敌、无坚不摧的智慧与佛法，可斩断烦恼，祛除邪魔
column2: A ritualistic vajra-shaped implement originating from India. It symbolizes invincible wisdom and Buddhist truth, said to cut through delusion and dispel inner demons.

column1: 相传是如来佛祖为普度众生，授予俗世的一套掌法，其威力可敌天灾地祸，确实不似凡间所有
column2: A palm technique said to be bestowed by the Buddha for saving all beings; its power rivals natural disasters and feels beyond anything mortal.

column1: 精妙奇门笔法，笔尖上下翻飞，轻舞慢点，残影在空中生出纷繁绚烂各式花卉，可谓华丽非常
column2: A refined brush technique in which the brush tip moves rapidly in all directions. Its motions create residual images resembling blooming flowers, making it visually dazzling and highly ornamental.

column1: 能感知众生过去之宿业，知晓现时或未来之果报的密宗绝技，非修持禅定多年者难以得此神通
column2: An esoteric technique granting perception of beings’ past karma and present or future consequences. It requires long-term meditative training to attain.

column1: 脚踩转轮贴地滑行的神奇轻功，金刚宗弟子常借此快速下山，其中修为高深者甚至可凌空飞行
column2: A miraculous Movement Art in which the practitioner glides along the ground using rotating wheel-like footwork. Vajra Sect disciples use it to descend mountains quickly, and highly skilled practitioners are even said to be able to levitate.

column1: 臂如鹰展，指如钢钩，气提丹田，大力开合，周身关节亦咯咯作响，猎物一旦被擒便再难挣脱
column2: A claw technique with eagle-like arms and iron-hook fingers. Force is driven from the dantian; once captured, escape becomes nearly impossible.

column1: 自下向上的掌法招式，以稳固下盘为基，发全身之力向上迎敌，即便来势如泰山压顶亦能抵御
column2: An upward palm technique grounded in a stable base; it launches the full body's force upward to meet the enemy, capable of withstanding even a mountain-crushing blow

column1: 茅山派剑法根基，招式谨守中庸之道，不疾不徐，不温不火，攻守有度，亦有调复内息之功效
column2: The foundation of Maoshan sword arts; its moves adhere to the middle way — neither too fast nor too slow, neither too warm nor too cold — balanced in offense and defense, and also beneficial for restoring inner breath

column1: 西楚霸王项羽所传，极尽刚猛的内修心法，以澎湃内息催动周身劲道，发动巨力足以拔山举鼎
column2: A supreme internal cultivation method passed down from Xiang Yu, the Western Chu Overlord, using overwhelming Inner Force to unleash physically godlike strength capable of uprooting mountains.

column1: 讲求顶平肩平脚平枪平“四平”之枪法，平直穿插，去势如箭，尽管招式简单，却又难以招架
column2: A spear art emphasizing four alignments — top, shoulder, foot, and spear — with straight thrusting force like an arrow; simple yet hard to stop

column1: 说起来，杨师兄才是本门练功最为刻苦之人。\n一天十二个时辰，怕是一大半都在这儿苦练。
column2: Speaking of it, Senior Brother Yang is the most diligent practitioner in our sect. Out of the twelve hours in a day, he probably spends the majority of them training here.

column1: 通过掐指之法辅助占卜吉凶或推算干支的玄妙法门，智慧超群且通晓周易之理者方能完全掌握
column2: A divination technique using finger calculations to determine fate; only those deeply versed in the Yijing and high wisdom can master it.

column1: 道家修真之法，可激发人体及经脉之潜能，据说修炼此功法至巅峰，便能逼近凡人武学之极限
column2: A Daoist cultivation method that can unlock the potential of the body and meridians; said that reaching the peak of this art brings one close to the ultimate limit of mortal martial arts

column1: 长乐帮独门暗器，专攻人头脑心腹，其毒性一旦侵入心脉，中毒者便会大笑狂舞三天三夜而死
column2: A Changle Gang signature hidden weapon targeting the head, heart, and abdomen; once its poison enters the heart meridian, the victim laughs and dances wildly for three days and nights before dying

column1: 门派中人居住休憩之所，低级弟子往往几人合住一简朴厢房，位高者则有豪华厢房单独居住。
column2: Living quarters for disciples; juniors often share rooms while seniors may have private quarters.

column1: 韩湘子所作之洞箫曲，辞语空灵玄奥，摄人心神，可令听者如闻仙乐，心醉神迷之间不能自已
column2: A flute technique by Han Xiangzi. Its ethereal melodies are mentally entrancing, causing listeners to become lost in a state of blissful confusion.

column1: “封闭提掳拿拦还缠”八式乃一切枪术之基本，其生出的组合又变化万千，因此以八母闻名
column2: The eight foundational moves of all spear arts give rise to countless combinations; hence named the Eight Mothers

column1: 一处装饰精良，环境优美，售价也颇为不菲的私人住宅，可供人休息，储藏或是习武使用。
column2: A well-furnished home used for living and training.

column1: 一门刚柔并济，攻守兼备的掌法，其诀窍在于“摔”字，即借助手腕甩打之力增强搏击威力
column2: A palm art balancing hard and soft, offense and defense; the key lies in the word "smash" — using wrist-snap force to amplify striking power

column1: 一门攻守兼备的实用拳法，招式严谨，底盘扎实，其创始者曾以此拳法伏虎除恶，因而闻名
column2: A practical all-around fist art with disciplined techniques and a solid base; its creator once subdued tigers with it, earning it its fame

column1: 一门滞空飘行之身法，修习者可借由微风之力扶摇而上，常人视之，真如直奔月宫而去一般
column2: A hovering body technique; the practitioner can ride gentle winds to float upward — to ordinary eyes, it truly seems as if they are flying straight to the moon palace

column1: 专为劈砍重型甲盾所创，结合强悍力道与刀刃特性的精妙劈砍法门，可斩人无血，削铁如泥
column2: Created specifically for chopping through heavy armor and shields; a refined chopping method combining tremendous force and blade properties — able to cut without blood and slice iron like mud

column1: 专攻远距离的戟法，其出势如龙，长攻远击，可谓一寸长一寸强，但难以应付近身肉搏之敌
column2: A halberd art specializing in long-distance attacks; its strike surges forward like a dragon — long reach and far strike, the longer the stronger — but it struggles against enemies who close to close range

column1: 为江湖人士所禁忌的功法，需配合腐尸之毒修炼而成，对修炼者的毒功和意志均是一种考验
column2: A technique forbidden in the jianghu; requires training with corpse poison, testing both the practitioner's poison cultivation and willpower

column1: 从猛禽捕食动作中演化出的擒拿路数，着重抓锁猎物的脖颈或关节处，并伺机予以致命一击
column2: A grappling method derived from a raptor's hunting motion; targets the neck or joints, locks them down, and waits for the killing blow

column1: 以内劲扰乱敌方重心，使之跌倒的奇门咒术，茅山道士有时会用以戏弄功力低微的武林人士
column2: An exotic incantation that uses inner force to disrupt the enemy's center of gravity and cause them to fall; Maoshan Daoists sometimes use this to tease jianghu people of low cultivation

column1: 以极快速度挥舞转轮，使之化为万千幻影攻敌，若敌人不倒，其攻势亦无穷无尽，无止无休
column2: A high-speed spinning disc technique in which the weapon is rotated into countless afterimages. If the opponent does not fall, the assault continues endlessly without pause.

column1: 以脚沾水，在地面挥洒行书之步法，其所成文字矫健活泼，潇洒大气，颇有几分嬉戏之意趣
column2: A calligraphy-based footwork style performed with wet feet on the ground, forming elegant and lively characters, playful and free-spirited in nature.

column1: 以连续挥击而闻名，短时间内数十次挥出势大力沉之铁锤，即便身强体壮者有时也难以驾驭
column2: Famous for sustained strikes; dozens of heavy iron hammer blows in rapid succession, sometimes too much even for a powerful practitioner to sustain

column1: 以高速舞剑，使剑刃模糊不清难以辨认之法，对敌之人需要观察剑柄指向，方能判断其走势
column2: A method of swinging the sword at high speed until the blade becomes blurred and unrecognizable; opponents must observe the direction of the hilt to judge its trajectory

column1: 传说佛祖曾掷象于空中，三日后方才坠地，此法虽无如此神通，但仍可以怪力抛掷百斤巨石
column2: A legend describing the Buddha casting an elephant into the sky, which fell only after three days. Though this technique does not reach such divine power, it still allows the practitioner to hurl hundred-jin boulders with tremendous force.

column1: 你的战斗力很大程度上由武功配置决定。\n请优先装备自己最擅长的武功，方能百战不殆。
column2: Your combat strength is largely determined by your martial arts configuration. Equip your most proficient martial arts first to ensure victory in a hundred battles.

column1: 共分为十三大剑势，快慢相兼，刚柔并济，讲求形神相合，意气贯通，乃武当正宗剑法之基
column2: A Hidden Pavilion secret technique where each heavy strike triggers a cycle of Inner Force within the body, culminating in a final explosive rebirth-like resurgence.

column1: 出手快速，击长攻远，霹雳堂低级弟子用此枪法逼退敌人，以保护后排使用火器的高级弟子
column2: A spear technique characterized by rapid thrusts and extended reach, used by junior Thunderclap Hall disciples to repel enemies and protect those handling fire-based weapons behind them.

column1: 到大比之时，若看你仍无半点进步，\n可别怪我在擂台上不留情面，把你打个哭爹喊娘哦！
column2: When the big competition comes around, if you've made no progress at all, don't blame me for showing no mercy on the arena and beating you until you cry for your parents!

column1: 劲势刚猛，以力道取胜的重剑剑法，传说越王勾践曾以此一招劈斩马车为两半，足见其威力
column2: A heavy sword art of fierce and powerful force that wins through strength; legend says the King of Yue Goujian once cleaved a war chariot in two with this single move — showing its tremendous power

column1: 单击武功栏中的图标，便可进行装备操作。\n内功/轻功/绝技，一经装备便会持续生效。
column2: Click on the icon in the martial arts bar to equip. Once equipped, Internal Art/Movement Art/Body will continuously take effect.

column1: 双掌在周身游走翻飞，如车轮急转，虎虎生风，每次出手却是遵循九宫规制，颇为严谨细密
column2: A sword technique inspired by the Dunhuang flying apsaras murals, featuring aerial dives from above like a celestial waterfall crashing into the mortal world.

column1: 取关公过五关斩六将之意，横冲直撞，势不可挡，追求冲击力道而非闪避灵活的猛将之步法
column2: Drawing from the spirit of Guan Yu charging through five passes and slaying six generals; a fierce general's footwork that charges forward unstoppably, pursuing impact force rather than evasive agility

column1: 取出淤泥而不染，濯清涟而不妖之掌意，是丐帮之中少有的以柔克刚，以弱胜强之精巧掌法
column2: Drawing from the spirit of the lotus that rises unstained from mud; one of the few Beggars Sect palm arts that overcomes the hard with the soft and defeats the strong with the weak

column1: 呵呵，你若是把你那耍贫嘴的小心思，放一些到练功上去，\n这身功夫也不至于如此不堪。
column2: Heh, if you put as much effort into your training as you do into being witty, your skills wouldn't be so pitiful.

column1: 哼！还说什么梦中修炼武功，\n连本门最粗浅的连环剑法都没有掌握，有何脸面告饶求情！
column2: Hmph! Talk about refining your martial arts in dreams. You haven't even mastered our sect's most basic Linked Sword. What face do you have to beg for mercy!

column1: 唐代幻真先生所传，一门将天地元气吞服到自身体内，转化利用以充盈内息的进阶内功心法
column2: An advanced inner art passed down by the Tang dynasty master Huanzhen Xiansheng; swallows the primordial qi of heaven and earth into the body, converting it to enrich one's own inner breath

column1: 唐门隐藏出手痕迹的暗杀之法，挥手之间绵软似无力，却能激射出致命暗器，令人无从防备
column2: The Tang Sect's assassination technique for concealing the act of striking; a wave of the hand seems soft and effortless, yet it launches lethal hidden weapons with no warning

column1: 如同卧虎之姿，看似闭眼假寐，实则为蓄力待敌之法，甫一起身，则如猛虎扑食，势不可挡
column2: Like a crouching tiger feigning sleep — in truth gathering force and waiting; the moment the practitioner rises, they strike like a tiger pouncing on prey

column1: 尾部连接锁链的特制铁爪，命中目标后，爪上倒钩会自动收紧并牢牢抓握，从而阻滞其行动
column2: A specially made iron claw with a chain attached; upon impact, the reverse hooks tighten and grip the target firmly, impeding their movement

column1: 当地捕快驻扎巡防之处，设有瞭望塔可俯瞰城内情况。一地治安皆依赖此处方能管理周全。
column2: A security station with lookout towers overseeing city safety and order.

column1: 所为子午，一阴一阳，一北一南，剑招蕴含天干地支，时辰方位之理，聪慧过人者方能参悟
column2: Named Ziwu — one yin, one yang, one north, one south; the moves embed the principles of the heavenly stems, earthly branches, hours, and directions — only those of exceptional intelligence can understand it

column1: 打得有模有样的嘛。国师弟若能保持这股劲头，\n想来不用多久，就有希望超过师兄我了。
column2: You're doing quite well. If you, my junior, can maintain this level of effort, it won't be long before you surpass me.

column1: 摩诃者大也，无量者不可计量也。修习此功法者内力如大海无量，且可随心所欲，掌控自如
column2: A cultivation method meaning “great and immeasurable,” granting Inner Force as vast as the sea, yet fully controllable at will.

column1: 本地{{A}}兑换，典当放债之处，区域所有者可在此赚取{{A}}，以供门派使用。
column2: Local {{A}} exchange, a place for pawnbroking and lending. The area owner can earn {{A}} here for the use of the sect.

column1: 正气凛然，以金刚大力正面迎击敌人胸腹部位的杵法，闪避不及者难免肋骨断折，脏腑震颤
column2: A righteous and powerful staff technique that directly strikes the chest and abdomen with Vajra-like force. Those who fail to evade may suffer broken ribs and internal injury.

column1: 此刀法力道惊人无比，可引动九州风雷于刀锋之上，一刀劈下，当真是魂飞魄散，鬼哭神嚎
column2: This blade art carries a force so tremendous it can summon the wind and thunder of all nine provinces onto the blade's edge; one chop truly scatters souls and makes ghosts cry and gods wail

column1: 武当功夫讲求刚柔并济，软硬兼施，此功法将腹部软功和周身硬功结合，劲道收放灵活自如
column2: The upper volume of the “Tai Xuan Scripture,” requiring absorption of midday solar essence over long periods to cultivate extreme yang Inner Force.

column1: 源于山间猿猴动作的棍法，使用者装如猿猴，左右横跳，棍招亦灵活多变，令敌人防不胜防
column2: A staff art derived from mountain apes; the user mimics an ape, leaping side to side, with agile and unpredictable staff moves

column1: 牛头乃阴间衙役，手持钢叉，力能排山。此招假其名号，由身强体壮者使出，确实威猛异常
column2: The Bull-Head is an underworld officer wielding a steel fork with mountain-moving strength; this technique borrows his name, and is truly ferocious when used by a powerful fighter

column1: 猛将所使步法，每一步皆重重落地，铮然有声，引得周遭地面微颤，其力道与气势均是不俗
column2: A heavy-step martial gait used by warriors of great stature, where each step lands like a thunderous impact, shaking the ground and emphasizing overwhelming presence.

column1: 由九节铁鞭铰接而成的奇门兵器，以内力灌注其中，则可刚可柔，如臂指使，招式多变异常
column2: A jointed iron whip linked in nine sections; infused with inner force, it can be hard or soft, responsive as a finger, with endlessly variable techniques

column1: 由于现在你实力较弱，建议先从功力较低的杨思迟师兄开始。\n点击头像，便可开始切磋。
column2: Since you are still relatively weak, it's advisable to start with your senior brother Yang Sichi, who has lower inner force. Click on his portrait to begin the sparring session.

column1: 茅山秘传引雷之术，将内息所生之雷电引入地下，电击周遭敌人，其威力颇强，消耗也颇大
column2: A secret Maoshan lightning-drawing technique that channels inner breath-generated lightning into the ground, electrocuting surrounding enemies; its power is considerable and its consumption equally great

column1: 蓬莱派地处海边，因而有此在海水中修炼之法，功成者迎风破浪，泅水浮波，颇为轻松惬意
column2: A coastal Penglai Sect training method that uses seawater resistance for cultivation; practitioners become capable of moving through wind and waves with ease.

column1: 走马灯般绕敌旋转之步法，待到敌人眼花缭乱，心神烦躁之时，往往使用者自己也头晕目眩
column2: A footwork method that circles the enemy like a spinning lantern; by the time the enemy is dazzled and agitated, the user is often dizzy themselves

column1: 都是同门师兄弟，有什么见笑不见笑的。\n国师弟你若能知耻而后勇，也不失英雄之所为。
column2: We're all fellow disciples. There's no need for embarrassment. If you, Brother Guo, can overcome your shame and become brave, you won't lose face in the eyes of a hero.

column1: 金刚宗弟子入门时，师傅需以水或醍醐灌洒其头顶，显示诸佛护持与慈悲，也能使神智清明
column2: A Vajra Sect initiation rite in which a master pours water or sacred nectar over the disciple’s head, symbolizing divine protection and clarity of mind.

column1: 铸剑山庄兵械绝技之首，练成后可同时使用四把武器，长短交接，软硬兼施，如同万刃齐发
column2: The foremost weapon supreme technique of Sword Forging Villa; once mastered, the practitioner can simultaneously wield four weapons — long and short alternating, hard and soft combined — like ten thousand blades releasing at once

column1: （杨思迟这家伙，估计是想要赖账不还了，只是不知该如何打发这个债主啊......）
column2: (Yang Sichi seems to be trying to dodge his debt. The only problem is, how do I get rid of this creditor...)

column1: 一名痴情高人所创，旨在伤人而非取人性命之手法，刀刀不伤人要害，却又刀刀避无可避
column2: Created by a lovelorn master who aimed to wound but not kill; every blade stroke avoids vital areas yet is impossible to dodge

column1: 一套注重力道运用的轻功法门，需要推动数百斤重的石球或铁球行走，奔跑，乃至上下坡
column2: A Movement Art method focusing on force application; requires pushing stone or iron balls of several hundred jin while walking, running, and climbing slopes

column1: 一拳击出，虎虎生风，想来已提升至下一重功力了。\n嘿嘿，该去找顾师兄履行赌约了。
column2: A single punch sends gusts of wind, it seems my skill has advanced to the next level. Heh heh, time to find Brother Gu and fulfill our bet.

column1: 一门借力打力，以巧胜强的功夫，其对劲道的把握以及时机之掌控，非日夜苦练难得纯熟
column2: A skill of using an opponent's force against them, winning with cleverness over strength; mastery of force and timing requires day-and-night practice

column1: 丐帮高级内功心法，此功法内息刚猛，遒劲有力，左冲右突之时颇有几分混天动地之威势
column2: An advanced Beggars Sect inner art; its inner breath is fierce and powerful, surging left and right with the momentum of shaking heaven and earth

column1: 专供练习闪转腾挪的功法，又练习心眼和拳脚的灵敏度，是武林人士经常练习的一门绝技
column2: A skill for practicing evasion and redirection, also sharpening the sensitivity of mind and limbs; widely practiced in the jianghu

column1: 主攻关节部位的阴毒擒拿手法，招法灵活诡谲，敌人一旦着手，难免伤筋错骨，无力再战
column2: A vicious grappling method targeting joints; once the enemy is caught, sinews are torn and bones dislocated, leaving them unable to fight

column1: 举枪问天，霸气豪壮之枪法，其招式多自下而上，或刺或挑，据说源于军中应对骑兵之法
column2: A bold and domineering spear art with upward thrusting and lifting moves; said to originate from military techniques for fighting cavalry

column1: 以一双铁钩使出的奇门招法，左右开弓，龙飞凤舞，一旦武器或肢体被其钩住便再难挣脱
column2: A peculiar technique using twin iron hooks. They strike from both sides like a dragon in flight; once caught, neither weapons nor limbs can easily escape.

column1: 以内力驱动之指法，故每次出招前皆需蓄力，一指既出则飒飒作响，气能凌云，威势不俗
column2: A finger technique requiring stored energy before each strike; once released, it produces a sharp sound and striking force that reaches the skies.

column1: 以内劲灌注剑刃，使之高速颤动化为残影，配合此套剑招使出，令人眼花缭乱，难辨虚实
column2: Channels inner force into the blade, making it vibrate at high speed to create afterimages; combined with these sword moves, it dazzles the eye and makes it hard to distinguish real from false

column1: 以极热内力灌注扇面的法门，可在空中扇出温度极高的金色烈焰，触者转瞬便会化作焦炭
column2: A fan technique infused with extreme yang Inner Force, capable of releasing golden flames in the air that instantly reduce anything touched to ash.

column1: 传说此剑法本有十五式，但因后两式凶煞无比，杀业过重而被作者毁去，最终仅余十三式
column2: A Sword said to originally contain fifteen forms, but the last two were destroyed by its creator due to their extreme brutality and overwhelming killing intent, leaving only thirteen forms.

column1: 依天干地支之理，缩减行动距离，从而加快移速之步法，常人眨眼之间便能变换数个方位
column2: A footwork method based on the heavenly stems and earthly branches principles that shortens movement distance to increase speed; in the blink of an eye the practitioner can shift through several positions

column1: 修炼此功法需用三指拔出钉入木板的一百单八枚铁钉。练成者三指抓出，便似有千斤之力
column2: Requires pulling 108 iron nails from wooden boards with three fingers; the adept's grip carries enormous force

column1: 力道独特，招式精妙的挥戈之法，修习此功法登峰造极者，可用长戈雕琢玉器，分毫不差
column2: A ge technique of unique force and refined moves; at peak mastery, the practitioner can carve jade with a long ge without the slightest error

column1: 同门切磋，以武论道，有什么出丑不出丑？\n杨师兄只管攻过来吧，大不了我让你几招！
column2: Sparring with fellow disciples, discussing the Dao through martial arts—what's there to be ashamed of? Go ahead and attack, Senior Brother Yang. I'll give you a few moves if need be!

column1: 唐门暗器高手可在袖中暗藏数十种不同暗器，无论想使哪种，不需找寻，一挥袖便能发出
column2: A Tang Sect hidden weapon master can conceal dozens of different hidden weapons in their sleeves; whichever they wish to use, a single flick of the sleeve releases it without searching

column1: 唐门独特内家心法，以此内劲所发之暗器，可以空中转向九次，任你轻功再高也难以闪避
column2: The Tang Sect's unique inner art; hidden weapons fired with this inner force can change direction nine times in mid-air — no matter how high one's Movement Art, evasion is nearly impossible

column1: 啊，还是别了吧……\n国师弟天赋异禀，我是远远不及的。\n顾师兄莫要逼我出丑了……
column2: Ah, let's not… My Junior Brother Gu has exceptional talent; I can't come close. Senior Brother Gu, please don't force me to embarrass myself...

column1: 在竹筒中装填火药和铁砂而成，点燃引线后子弹自开口处爆射而出，射程较长但威力一般
column2: A bamboo-tube firearm loaded with gunpowder and iron pellets. Once the fuse is lit, the shot explodes out of the opening. It has relatively long range, but only moderate destructive power.

column1: 天山派女弟子修习之柔美剑法，其挥招之时如素女立雪，羽衣蹁跹，鸾回凤舞，妙招频频
column2: A graceful sword style of female disciples, resembling a celestial maiden dancing in snow, elegant and flowing.

column1: 奇形飞轮，掷出后划圆弧飞行并回到手中，熟练者可反复次第掷出多枚，令敌人难以闪避
column2: An oddly shaped flying wheel; thrown, it curves through the air and returns to the hand — the skilled can throw multiple wheels in sequence, making them nearly impossible to evade

column1: 威力强悍的转轮功法，其凶狠招式可助人快速脱离苦海，往生极乐——无论对方是否愿意
column2: A powerful rotational martial art technique whose ruthless strikes are said to lead enemies toward “liberation,” regardless of their willingness.

column1: 将千张白纸钉为纸方，悬于墙上反复击打之功法。表面上是阳刚劲路，却也暗含阴柔之力
column2: A training method of nailing a thousand sheets of white paper into a block and repeatedly striking it; outwardly a hard-force path, yet concealing soft force within

column1: 师……师傅？？！！你怎么不早说！\n我这就穿衣服，你先去拖延下时间，我马上就到！
column2: Master?!! Why didn't you say so earlier! I'll get dressed right away. You go ahead and stall for time; I'll be there shortly!

column1: 描绘瑜伽修行十七重境界的金刚宗秘法，若能一一研习，可令修持者身体康健，心神清明
column2: A Vajra Sect secret method outlining seventeen progressive stages of yogic cultivation. Mastery of each stage improves physical health and mental clarity.

column1: 杨师弟过谦了，你虽进步缓慢，但胜在笨鸟先飞。\n比起国师弟，说不定还略胜一筹呢。
column2: Little Brother Yang is too modest. Though you progress slowly, you make up for it by getting an early start. Compared to National Brother, you might even have the upper hand.

column1: 极为高深的佛门心法，其言甚简却涵摄诸多法门之精义，对于修行者心智神识均大有裨益
column2: A profoundly deep Buddhist heart method; its words are few yet encompass the essence of many disciplines, greatly benefiting the practitioner's spirit and mind

column1: 极细极长之银针，需要以灵巧手法催动内劲射出，一旦命中敌人穴道，便可使其内息紊乱
column2: Extremely fine and long silver needles requiring Agility hand techniques and inner force to fire; a hit to an acupoint throws the enemy's inner breath into chaos

column1: 樵夫出身的奇门高手所创，其招式层层叠叠，专攻下盘，真如老树盘根一般令人动弹不得
column2: Created by a woodcutter-turned-master; moves pile up like tangled roots, attacking only the lower body, making enemies truly unable to move

column1: 此功法专练手肘的顶凿屈转与抗击打能力，功成后手肘孔武有力，纵以利刃砍之亦不能损
column2: Trains the elbows for thrusting, bending, turning, and resisting impacts; the adept's elbows are formidably powerful, impervious even to sharp blades

column1: 此招重在回打二字，即利用鞭子坚韧，使每一鞭挥出均有回环往复之后招，令人防不胜防
column2: The key lies in the rebound strike — each whip stroke uses the weapon's elasticity to create a looping follow-up, making it nearly impossible to guard against

column1: 此掌法擅长久战，招式以守代攻，绵密无比，劲道如春蚕吐丝般缠绕敌人，令其疲敝不堪
column2: A palm art suited to prolonged combat; its techniques defend in place of attacking, dense and relentless, wrapping around the enemy like a spring silkworm spinning silk until they are exhausted

column1: 此步法擅长控制敌我之间距离，步法柔婉凄怆，缓缓别离，却又回身紧逼，令人无从捉摸
column2: A footwork method skilled at controlling distance; its steps are soft and melancholy, slowly parting then suddenly pressing in, leaving the enemy with nowhere to escape

column1: 此硬功修习者遍体黝黑刚毅，皮肤粗糙如砂砾一般，实乃风吹日晒，经年累月的苦修所致
column2: A hard-body training result in which the practitioner’s skin becomes dark, coarse, and stone-like due to years of exposure to wind, sun, and relentless conditioning.

column1: 每一招均以英雄命名，豪气干云，霸道纵横之刀法，若由臂力过人者使出，气度更是不凡
column2: A heroic-named blade system where each move is associated with legendary figures, emphasizing grandeur, dominance, and overwhelming physical presence.

column1: 每走一圈恰好经过八卦八个方位，故而得名。武当弟子习此步法，可为后续进修树立根基
column2: A sword style following the principle of yin-yang mutual generation and restraint. Each move alternates between offense and defense, unpredictable yet logically consistent.

column1: 源于佛门的苦修之法，常人需三年方能技成。练习精纯者一指到处，木石皆碎，胸腑洞撤
column2: A grueling Buddhist discipline that takes ordinary people three years to master; the adept's single finger can shatter wood and stone, penetrating the chest cavity

column1: 源自道家秘术，修炼者需引日月精华、五行灵气入体。功成后，举手投足皆可与天地同力
column2: A Daoist secret art that absorbs sun, moon, and elemental energies; once mastered, every movement aligns with the force of heaven and earth.

column1: 由行伍枪法演化而来的棍法，掩去枪法之锋芒，化为绵密之守势，使用长兵之人多有修习
column2: Evolved from a military spear art; its sharp edge is softened into dense defense, widely practiced by those who use Polearm

column1: 相传为古时名将总结大量实战经验，汇编而成的二十四招枪决，乃是行伍猛将必修之法门
column2: Said to have been compiled by ancient famous generals from extensive battlefield experience; twenty-four spear techniques are essential study for any fierce warrior

column1: 相传是无名乞丐长棍被恶徒砍断后，情急之下以两节断棍使出的棍法，颇有几分灵巧快速
column2: Said to have been improvised by an unknown beggar after a villain cut his long staff in two; the resulting two-section technique is notably nimble and fast

column1: 看似平平无奇的铁珠，实则内藏数个更小的铁珠，手法高超者掷出，能同时打击多个穴位
column2: Seemingly ordinary iron pellets, but each contains several smaller pellets inside; thrown by a skilled hand, they can strike multiple acupoints simultaneously

column1: 着重进攻的内家掌法，其内劲倾吐如同惊涛骇浪，内功薄弱者稍有不慎，便会被伤及五脏
column2: An inner offensive palm art; its inner force pours out like crashing waves — those with weak inner art risk having their organs injured if not careful

column1: 结合呼吸吐纳与排打锻炼，增强力道与体魄的功法。其修习过程艰苦漫长，常人难以忍受
column2: Combines breathing exercises with hard-body training to strengthen force and physique; the process is long and grueling, difficult for ordinary people to endure

column1: 若是刚才遇到的是贼人，徒儿怕是早已一命呜呼，\n再也没法在您老人家身旁尽孝了啊！
column2: If we had encountered thieves just now, disciple would likely be dead by now and unable to serve you in your old age!

column1: 融合百家拳法而成，招式似是而非，真假莫辨，旁人看来错漏百出，但实则招招出其不意
column2: A fusion of a hundred fist arts; moves seem both familiar and strange, true and false — to outsiders it appears full of flaws, but every move catches the enemy off guard

column1: 返璞归真之棍招，此当头一棒，颇含禅机，对敌之人稍有不慎，便被震慑心神，动弹不得
column2: A staff move that returns to fundamental simplicity; this direct strike to the head carries a Chan-like quality — careless enemies find their spirit shaken and their body frozen

column1: 这六招剑法皆是花哨虚招，取烟雨朦胧之意，挥舞时云山雾罩，故弄玄虚，自是难以捉摸
column2: Six flashy sword forms that are mostly feints, inspired by misty and cloudy scenery, deliberately deceptive and hard to read.

column1: 通过神游之法，在睡梦中研习经典，冥想开悟，从而凝练心神，增长智慧的神奇道家法门
column2: A wondrous Daoist method of studying classics and achieving insight through meditation in dreams; concentrates the spirit and increases wisdom

column1: 铸剑弟子在庖厨中修习之刀法，以牛刀宰杀活鸡，切分鸡肉，专练手部力道和掌腕控制力
column2: A blade art practiced by Sword Forging disciples in the kitchen; using a kitchen knife to slaughter live chickens and carve chicken meat, specifically training hand force and palm-wrist control

column1: 长乐帮入门弟子时常与其他帮派中人争抢地盘与档口，此时以怒面示人，可以吓退竞争者
column2: Entry-level Changle Gang disciples often compete with rival gang members for territory and stalls; showing an enraged face at these times can intimidate and drive off competitors

column1: 阎罗殿强身健骨苦修之法，功成者全身劲力勇猛，更兼不惧刀砍斧劈，鬼怪见了也得发愁
column2: A Yama Hall body-strengthening and bone-toughening discipline; once mastered the whole body's force is formidable and impervious to blade and axe — even ghosts would be troubled by this

column1: 顶尖杀手所使步法，有如鬼魅，无踪无影，无声无息，待敌人发觉之时，往往已陷入死境
column2: A footwork method used by top assassins; ghost-like, with no trace, no shadow, no sound — by the time the enemy notices, they have usually already fallen into a fatal situation

column1: 顾师兄这么说我可就不服气了。\n杨思迟与我差不多同时入门，想来也就半斤八两而已。
column2: I won't take that lying down, Gu Senior Apprentice Brother. Yang Sichi entered the school around the same time as me; he can't be much better than I am.

column1: 一套使用铁扇的奇门武功，其招式进退有据，儒雅非凡，劲风绵绵不绝，可达数尺之远
column2: An exotic martial art using an iron fan; the moves are measured and refined, with a continuous wind force reaching several chi

column1: 丐帮高手醉酒后意外使出的独到拳法，拳路似醉非醉，似醒非醒，左倒右支，难以捉摸
column2: A unique fist art accidentally produced by a Beggars Sect master while drunk; the moves seem half-drunk, half-sober, swaying left and right — hard to read

column1: 专练头部硬功之绝技，初学时需以棉布包裹避免受伤，练成后则以头碎石劈砖亦无大碍
column2: A head-hardening technique requiring initial protection during training; once mastered, the practitioner can smash stones or bricks with their head.

column1: 东南刀客于海边练成的刀法，需挥刀反复劈斩海浪，至刀风可开分海浪数尺，方能功成
column2: A blade art mastered by a southeastern swordsman training at the sea's edge; the practitioner must chop at waves repeatedly until the blade wind can split the water by several chi

column1: 书法名家所创，或挥或洒，或点或按，走脉打穴之间颇现笔力，悟性不足者难得其神髓
column2: Created by a calligraphy master; the moves sweep, scatter, dot, and press — striking meridians and acupoints with brush-like force; those lacking insight cannot grasp its essence

column1: 产自天竺的圆轮形奇门兵刃，平时可作祭祀法器，战斗时可大力挥舞格挡，或投掷攻敌
column2: A circular disc-shaped weapon from India. It is used in rituals but can also be swung in combat for defense or thrown offensively.

column1: 以内家功夫分拨水面，初学者不过毫厘而已，而大成者可令水开数尺，足见其劲道浑厚
column2: Uses inner art to split water; beginners can barely manage a hairbreadth, but the adept can part water by several chi, demonstrating the depth of their force

column1: 以奇门遁甲中的生死八门之法计算飞刀射击的方位，可以缩小乃至封死敌人的躲避空档
column2: Uses the eight gate calculations of Qimen Dunjia to determine flying blade trajectories, narrowing or completely sealing off the enemy's evasion window

column1: 以蛮力取胜，速度较为缓慢的刀法，劈空砍地时能感到地面微微震颤，足见其势大力沉
column2: A slow but overwhelmingly powerful blade technique that relies on brute strength; when it cleaves through air or ground, the tremor of force can be felt beneath the earth, revealing its crushing weight.

column1: 借助踩踏之力，在水面漂行之轻功，初时需要借助木板训练，功成后可奔行数丈而不沉
column2: A Movement Art that skims along the water's surface using stepping force; beginners train with wooden boards — the adept can run dozens of zhang without sinking

column1: 假托蔡文姬之名所作琴曲，其音调如怨如慕，如泣如诉，闻者无不落泪伤心，难以自持
column2: A zither piece falsely attributed to Cai Wenji, with melodies full of sorrow and longing, like weeping and lamentation, causing listeners to break down emotionally.

column1: 刺客所用，以诡异多变，悄无声息的步法闻名，身形如幽冥鬼影，视之无形，听之无声
column2: An assassin's footwork; famous for its strange, unpredictable, and utterly silent movement — the body moves like an underworld shadow, invisible to the eye and inaudible to the ear

column1: 劲道阴柔细密之拳法，以缠丝之劲道限制敌方关节扭动，令其难以发力，从而以巧胜强
column2: A soft yet intricate fist technique using coiling force to restrict an opponent’s joints, preventing power from being exerted, thus overcoming strength with skill.

column1: 原来这处广场便是本门的练武场啊。\n我路过时常听到叫喊之声，还以为是在杀猪呢！
column2: So this square is actually our school's Training Grounds. Whenever I passed by, I often heard shouting and thought they were slaughtering pigs!

column1: 双腿摆动迅捷，更兼指掌攀援的奇特轻功，登山越险，见缝插针，上树游墙，如履平地
column2: A unique Movement Art of rapidly swinging the legs combined with hand and finger gripping; climbing mountains over dangerous terrain, slipping through gaps, scaling trees and walls — all as easy as flat ground

column1: 呵，藏经阁不去，练武场也不来，\n国师弟你入门之后，难不成只在食堂和宿舍转悠？
column2: Heh, you haven't been to the Scripture Pavilion or the Training Grounds. Since you entered the school, have you only been wandering around the cafeteria and Dormitory, Junior Disciple Guoshi?

column1: 呼，这太祖长拳看似简单，但却是百拳之基。\n一旦练习起来，便不知不觉忘了时间。
column2: Ah, this Taizu Long Fist may seem simple, but it's the foundation of a hundred fists. Once you start practicing, you lose track of time without even realizing it.

column1: 国师弟稍加参阅，就能发现自己的错漏之处。\n进步如此神速，倒要令我刮目相看了。
column2: Just a brief glance at my teachings, and you can spot your own mistakes. To see such rapid improvement is truly eye-opening.

column1: 在悬挂绳索上修习，或跑动，或跳跃，或打坐，或小憩，可锻炼身形平衡和下盘之稳固
column2: Trained on suspended ropes — running, leaping, sitting in meditation, or resting — to develop balance and a stable foundation

column1: 对于其他人来说或许不值一提，\n但对于一向偷懒的国师弟你来说，已经难能可贵了。
column2: It may not be noteworthy to others, but for you, who always slack off, it's truly commendable.

column1: 将全身内劲灌注于腿脚，以极快之速度，瞬间闪身跃出数丈距离，可轻松躲避大多攻击
column2: Channels the whole body's inner force into the legs and feet, instantly flashing several zhang in distance at extreme speed — capable of easily dodging most attacks

column1: 将内息脱离体外建立循环的高超功法，修行者自觉物我两忘，天人合一之时，方为大成
column2: An advanced art that establishes a circulation of inner breath outside the body; the practitioner achieves great mastery when they feel the dissolution of self and unity with heaven and earth

column1: 峨眉派入门道家心法，修习者需在坐禅之时忘却己身，排除杂念，清心净性，真气自生
column2: An Emei sect beginner Taoist mental method requiring meditation and self-forgetting; only through purity of mind does Inner Force naturally emerge.

column1: 我就随口一夸你还当真了。\n师兄我也是每日刻苦练功的，岂能被你这小儿轻易超过？
column2: I was just paying you a compliment, but you took it seriously. Senior brother, I train diligently every day; how could I let a mere child like you surpass me so easily?

column1: 本是海边船夫以铁钩捕鱼之法，化为武学后招式奇特，别出心裁，非聪慧之人难以使用
column2: Originally a fisherman's iron hook technique; converted into martial arts, the moves are inventive and unusual, difficult for those lacking intelligence

column1: 模仿毒蛇进攻动作的拳法，施展时手臂可弯曲至超乎常理之角度，灵活婉转，柔中带刚
column2: A fist art imitating the attacking movements of venomous snakes; when deployed the arm can bend to angles beyond normal range — flexible and winding, soft yet hard

column1: 欢迎来到江湖，当下是武林历一年一月一日，\n当前的日期会一直显示在屏幕左上角。
column2: Welcome to the martial world. The current date is Year 1, Month 1, Day 1 of the Martial Calendar, which will be displayed in the upper left corner of the screen.

column1: 此剑法暗含修道之理，需平心静气方能发挥威力，修习者越是急于求成，越是难以精进
column2: This Sword contains Taoist principles. Only a calm and steady mind can bring out its full power; the more the practitioner rushes for quick success, the harder true progress becomes.

column1: 此步法灵动大气，潇洒自然，有欣喜豪爽之意，可谓春风得意马蹄疾，一日看尽长安花
column2: A lively and free-spirited footwork method, as carefree as galloping through Chang'an in spring — one day to see all the flowers

column1: 每项均分为总和值，基础值和潜力值。
column2: Each item is divided intoTotal Value，Base ValueAndPotential Points。

column1: 源于苗疆的双刀刀法，鸳刀主攻，鸯刀主守，双刀配合无间，上下翻飞，可谓滴水不漏
column2: A dual-blade art from the Miao borderlands; one blade attacks, the other defends — the two work seamlessly together, covering every angle

column1: 潮起潮落，月盈月亏，据说此功法有异曲同工之妙，在吐纳呼吸之间，积蓄澎湃之内力
column2: Tide rises and falls, the moon waxes and wanes; this art is said to work in the same way — accumulating vast inner force through the rhythm of breath

column1: 相传乃是一无名老道所传，以虚招为主，刀意空玄飘幻，令人如坠云里雾里，无从捉摸
column2: Said to have been passed down by an unnamed old Daoist; mainly feints, with a blade intent that is void and mysterious, leaving the enemy feeling lost in clouds and mist

column1: 眼下，顾游年师兄正在藏经阁内等候。\n点击“藏经阁”按钮，进入其中与他汇合吧！
column2: Right now, Senior Apprentice Brother Gu Yunian is waiting in the Scripture Pavilion. Click the "Scripture Pavilion" button to enter and meet up with him!

column1: 着重锻炼头部和臂部抗击打能力的硬功绝技，运功之后，皮肤坚硬如铁，刀枪几不能入
column2: A hard qigong specialty focused on toughening the head and arms; once activated, the skin is as hard as iron, nearly impervious to blades and spears

column1: 立于闹市中心的木牌，其上张贴有各式通缉悬赏和委托告示，往来行人不时驻足端详。
column2: A public board displaying bounties, missions, and announcements.

column1: 精锐重铠军士所修之硬功，稳若泰山，人甲合一，能够最大化发挥所穿盔甲之防御效用
column2: A hard qigong practiced by elite heavy-armored soldiers; stable as Taishan, man and armor as one — maximizes the defensive effectiveness of the armor being worn

column1: 结合了暗器手法的奇特短刀，触动刀柄机关，刀刃便会弹射而出，出人意料，攻敌不备
column2: An unusual short blade combined with hidden weapon technique; trigger the handle mechanism and the blade shoots out — unexpected and impossible to guard against

column1: 罕有人练成的奇功，经脉运转之时，肤色呈现墨玉般的黑暗光泽，水火难侵，刀枪不入
column2: A rare technique where the practitioner’s meridians turn dark jade-like during circulation, making the body resistant to water, fire, blades, and spears.

column1: 脱胎于普贤心经的佛门内功，缘起非有无，非实亦非虚，可大大增加修习者的内功修为
column2: A Buddhist inner art derived from the Puxian Heart Sutra; neither existing nor non-existing, neither real nor void — greatly increases inner art cultivation

column1: 脱胎自道家典籍庄子之拳法，或水击千里，或扶摇直上，招式大开大合，内劲潇洒浑厚
column2: A fist art derived from the Daoist classic Zhuangzi; striking water for a thousand li, soaring straight upward — moves are wide and sweeping with a free and powerful inner force

column1: 蕴含八阵图义理的刀法，以生死八门配合五行生克，经过精确计算使出，方能发挥威力
column2: A blade art embodying the principles of the Eight Formation Diagram; only through precise calculation using the eight gates and five elements can it reach its full power

column1: 设置有杵臼甘埚以及各式丹炉药鼎之所，弟子在此炼制各式灵丹妙药，以供门派使用。
column2: A place for refining medicinal pills and elixirs using various alchemical tools and furnaces.

column1: 设置有熔炉铁砧以及各式木匠工具之所，弟子在此制作各式武器防具，以供门派使用。
column2: A workshop equipped with furnaces and tools for forging weapons and armor for sect use.

column1: 身披铁甲之人修习的硬功，通过肌肉运劲和姿势调整，令敌人的攻击落在甲胄较厚实处
column2: A hard qigong practiced by those wearing iron armor; through muscle force and posture adjustment, enemy attacks are directed onto the thicker sections of the armor

column1: 还有茅厕……咳咳。\n师兄你还是和我说说，该如何提升实战经验吧。
column2: And the latrine... cough. Senior Brother, could you tell me how to improve Combat Experience Okay.

column1: 这门阴柔内功旨在维持修炼者心智之清净。心无杂念，灵台清明，气感自生，功法自成
column2: A soft yin inner art aimed at keeping the practitioner's mind pure; with no distractions, clarity arises naturally and the art develops of itself

column1: 速度迅捷，跳跃冲刺能力亦极为惊人的名马，传说其先祖曾背负刘备越过阔数丈的檀溪
column2: A famous horse of extraordinary speed and leaping ability; legend holds that its ancestor carried Liu Bei across the Tan Creek, a gap several zhang wide.

column1: 金刚宗修气瑜伽法，借助观想拙火疏通并洗涤自身经脉，可令内息滚沸，抵御藏地严寒
column2: A Vajra Sect yogic practice using visualization of inner fire to purify and open the meridians. It intensifies Inner Force and helps withstand the cold of high-altitude regions.

column1: 钟离权所传之扇法，招式开合有度，擅以凌厉劲风扰乱敌人，关键时刻也可做格挡之用
column2: An umbrella/hand-fan technique passed down by Zhongli Quan. Its openings and closures are precisely controlled; it can disrupt opponents with sharp gusts of force and also serve as a defensive shield when needed.

column1: 铸剑山庄秘传绝技，练成后可同时使用三把武器，切换迅捷，上下翻飞，如同百刃出击
column2: A secret supreme technique of Sword Forging Villa; once mastered, the practitioner can simultaneously wield three weapons, switching with lightning speed, flipping up and down — like a hundred blades striking at once

column1: 阎罗殿弟子常用之进阶刀法，讲求以战养战，威猛嗜杀，挥砍之间鬼神惊惧，气势不凡
column2: An Advanced Blade commonly used by Yama Hall disciples; emphasizes fighting to strengthen through combat, ferocious and bloodthirsty — each swing strikes fear into gods and demons, with formidable momentum

column1: 静为阴，动为符，此枪法动静结合，兵行诡道，专攻下三路，敌人稍有不慎便非残既伤
column2: Still is yin, motion is the talisman; this spear art combines stillness and motion, taking an unorthodox path targeting the lower three roads — careless enemies will find themselves crippled

column1: 顾师兄夸得我都不好意思了，\n不过是太祖长拳而已，好像练成什么绝世武功了似的。
column2: Senior Brother Gu's praise makes me feel embarrassed. It's just the Taizu Long Fist; it's not like I've mastered some world-renowned martial art.

column1: 高僧所创，可将天地阴阳二气化为悲智双运之力，最终达到无缘大慈，同体大悲之境界
column2: A technique created by high monks that transforms yin-yang energy into compassion and wisdom, ultimately reaching boundless benevolence and shared suffering.

column1: 黄皮黑嘴，身布连环旋毛，世人多以为丑，然而其矫健善走，蹄大快程，不可以貌取之
column2: Yellow-skinned with a black muzzle and a coat of swirling curls; many find it ugly, yet it is agile, fast-hoofed, and not to be judged by appearance.

column1: 一门阴柔内功心法，练成者浑身遍布绵柔坚韧之内劲，可自行吸附或化解来袭之攻势
column2: A soft yin inner art; the adept's body is filled with resilient gentle inner force that can absorb or dissolve incoming attacks on its own

column1: 为江湖人士所不齿之刀法，需将兵刀藏于袖中，待敌人近前，突然出手，以偷袭取胜
column2: A blade art scorned in the jianghu; the blade is hidden in the sleeve and drawn suddenly when the enemy closes in, winning through ambush

column1: 从西域传入的奇门鞭法，鞭势绵密飞舞，卷起沙尘高达数丈，可令周遭敌人目不能视
column2: An exotic whip art from the Western Regions; the whip dances in dense spirals, raising dust clouds several zhang high, blinding nearby enemies

column1: 从长兵偃月刀中演化而来的刀术，其招式气势雄伟，威武庄严，往往令敌人不战自危
column2: Evolved from the long-weapon crescent blade; its moves are majestic and imposing, often causing the enemy to lose the will to fight before contact

column1: 以巨型铡刀使出，顺劈竖砍，或格或架，因其形制独特，体积巨大，可以不变应万变
column2: Used with a giant chopping blade; vertical and diagonal cuts, parrying and blocking — its unusual size and volume allow it to meet any situation with one unchanging response

column1: 以连续追击而闻名之剑术，一剑比一剑更快，更险，敌人刚挡下一剑，往往数剑又至
column2: A sword art famous for relentless pursuit; each sword strike comes faster and more dangerously than the last — the enemy barely blocks one strike before several more arrive

column1: 供商贾旅人和武林人士打尖住店之所，一楼提供各式家常菜肴，二楼则为住宿客房。
column2: A lodging place for travelers and martial artists, offering food downstairs and Guest Room upstairs.

column1: 刀意潇洒豪爽，正气凛然，相传髯须刀客曾以此刀法扫荡贼寇，剪除恶徒，因而闻名
column2: Bold and heroic in spirit, radiating righteousness; said to have been used by a bearded swordsman to sweep out bandits and cut down villains — hence its fame

column1: 反复击打铁砂锤炼而成的刚猛掌法。功成者手掌比常人厚两倍有余，骨节也粗大异常
column2: A fierce palm art forged through repeated striking of iron sand; the adept's palms are more than twice as thick as normal, with unusually large knuckles

column1: 呵呵，既然你不服，今日又凑巧有空，\n干脆你和杨师弟过上几招，分个高下如何？
column2: Hehe, since you're not convinced, and we happen to have some time today, why don't you spar a few rounds with Brother Yang to settle things?

column1: 唐门特制暗器，上有机关，一旦命中便自动刺出倒钩，着者难免皮开肉绽，错骨伤筋
column2: A Tang Sect custom-made hidden weapon with a spring mechanism; once it strikes, reverse hooks automatically extend — the victim suffers torn skin and dislocated bones

column1: 四指并用陆续弹击，有如音乐家弹琵琶之指法，可令使用者的外功招式更加变幻莫测
column2: Strikes in sequence with four fingers like a musician plucking a pipa; makes the practitioner's external techniques far more unpredictable

column1: 外功等级在三重以下时，威力极弱。\n需要先在自行练习，方能快速获取实战经验。
column2: When your External Art level is below three, your power is extremely weak. You need to practice on your own first to quickly gain practical experience.

column1: 如同一轮弯月的细长铁钩，一旦被其钩中便再难脱身，乃是苗疆抓捕恶徒之奇门兵刃
column2: A long and slender iron hook shaped like a crescent moon; once hooked, the target cannot escape — an Qimen weapon from the Miao borderlands for capturing criminals

column1: 威力强悍的刀法，其凶狠招式可助人快速脱离苦海，往生极乐——无论对方是否愿意
column2: A similarly powerful Blade imbued with sharp vajra wisdom, also described as delivering enemies into liberation irrespective of consent.

column1: 孔雀翎毛编织而成的羽扇，内藏毒针，发动之时，四射飞散，如孔雀开屏，斑斓炫目
column2: A feather fan woven from peacock feathers concealing poison needles within; when deployed, they scatter in all directions like a peacock spreading its tail — dazzling and deadly

column1: 将双手力道集中于刚猛一击之中，极简的招式蕴含着千钧之力，也因此缺乏防御后招
column2: Concentrates both hands' force into a single fierce strike; the simplest of moves contains a thousandfold force, but leaves no defensive follow-up

column1: 将金属锤头系于长绳一端，可旋转蓄力，如由力大者甩出，真如流行破空般势不可挡
column2: A metal hammerhead tied to one end of a long rope; spun to gather force, a throw from a strong arm is unstoppable as a shooting star

column1: 峨眉山养鸭道士所创，身体左摇右摆，前后晃动，古朴笨拙中隐藏着奇特的拳法技巧
column2: A strange Emei mountain “duck-herding Daoist” boxing style, characterized by swaying, rocking movements that conceal subtle martial intent.

column1: 招式刚猛的刀法，蕴含无比锐利且无坚不摧之金刚智慧，号称可消除罪孽，降魔息灾
column2: A similarly fierce Blade infused with vajra wisdom, capable of overwhelming opponents with decisive and purifying force.

column1: 招式刚猛的杵法，蕴含无比锐利且无坚不摧之金刚智慧，号称可消除罪孽，降魔息灾
column2: A ferocious vajra staff technique embodying indestructible wisdom, said to purify karma and suppress demons.

column1: 敷有剧毒之钢针，其断肠草之毒性令人痛不欲生，若命中心腹部位则会加快毒性发作
column2: A steel needle coated with virulent poison derived from heartbreak grass; the agony is unbearable, and if it strikes the chest or abdomen the poison spreads even faster

column1: 暗器高手所使铁牌，薄如蝉翼却颇具重量，专攻咽喉小腹等要害部位，见之如见阎王
column2: An iron tablet used by a hidden weapon master; thin as a cicada wing yet with considerable weight — targets the throat and lower abdomen, the vital points — those who see it may as well be seeing death

column1: 极细之玉针，带有的冰寒之气一旦刺入人体，便会在经脉中自行游走，阻滞内息运行
column2: An extremely fine jade needle carrying a cold yin energy; once it enters the body, it travels through the meridians on its own, blocking inner breath circulation

column1: 此杖法以招式严谨，防守致密见长，修习者需以水桶取水泼之而不能进，方见其功力
column2: A staff art known for disciplined techniques and tight defense; the practitioner must be able to splash water with the staff without letting a drop pass — that is mastery

column1: 此枪法擅长以游龙探海之势攻击下盘，一旦刺伤敌人腿脚，便能更好发挥长兵之优势
column2: This spear art excels at attacking the lower body with a roaming dragon probing the sea; once the enemy's legs are wounded, the advantage of a Polearm can be better exploited

column1: 此步法专走斜路，看似歪歪扭扭，不成体统，实则蕴含几分威猛冲劲，不可掉以轻心
column2: This footwork moves exclusively along diagonal paths; it appears crooked and disorderly, yet conceals a fierce charging force that should not be underestimated

column1: 看似朴实无华的剑招，直来直往之间却蕴含千钧重力，堪称剑法大巧若拙之至高境界
column2: A seemingly plain sword style that strikes directly yet carries immense hidden force, representing the ultimate simplicity within complexity.

column1: 练习中每击落一个射击物，都会使连击数加1。\n连击数越高，就能获得越多经验。
column2: Each shot knocked down during practice adds 1 to your combo count. The higher the combo count, the more experience you gain.

column1: 经霹雳堂历代不断研发的火药制备之法，消耗更少的原料，其产量和威力皆有所提升
column2: A continuously improved gunpowder refinement method developed over generations in Thunderclap Hall, requiring fewer materials while increasing yield and explosive power.

column1: 给刀柄安装机关，使刀刃可以弯折旋转，因此可从各种诡异角度出刀，招式变化无穷
column2: A mechanism is installed on the blade handle allowing the blade to bend and rotate; this enables strikes from all manner of strange angles with endless variations

column1: 耐心消耗为零，便无法继续阅读了。\n此时点击“阅毕”按钮，结束本次读书即可。
column2: When patience reaches zero, you can no longer continue reading. Click the "Finished Reading" button to end this session of reading.

column1: 自天竺传入中原之指法，专攻敌人周身穴位，少林僧众常以此作为穴位辨识入门之法
column2: A finger technique originating from India, designed to target acupoints throughout the body. Shaolin monks use it as an introductory method for learning pressure point identification.

column1: 蓬莱派基础内丹法门，其炼气者，需冥心定息，元寂绵绵，直至气入丹田，丹火旺盛
column2: A foundational internal alchemy method of the Penglai Sect. Practitioners must quiet the mind and regulate breathing until consciousness becomes still and continuous; only then does qi enter the dantian and ignite a flourishing inner “dan fire.”

column1: 跪伏在地，头顶佛脚的敬礼姿势，每日坚持修习，可增长清净智慧，并锻炼下盘腰力
column2: A posture of kneeling and touching one’s head to the Buddha’s feet. Practiced daily, it is believed to cultivate wisdom and strengthen the lower body.

column1: 这套江湖人士常用刀法以攻击见长，刀势结合内劲长驱直入，如同青龙出海勇猛难当
column2: A strong offensive blade art; the blade force drives forward like an azure dragon emerging from the sea

column1: 道家法器，本作驱鬼辟邪之用，对敌时可格架攻击，或用摧耳铃音扰乱周边敌人心智
column2: A Daoist magical artifact used originally for exorcism; in combat it can block attacks or disrupt enemies with sound.

column1: 都日晒三竿了，怎么还窝在宿舍里赖床？\n我看今天的练功早课，徒儿你也没去吧。
column2: It's already high noon. Why are you still lazing in bed in your Dormitory? I bet you skipped today's early morning training session, didn't you, disciple?

column1: 配合铁制盔甲训练的硬功，在合适时机以合适姿态迎击敌人，可令甲胄防御能力倍增
column2: A hard qigong trained in conjunction with iron armor; meeting the enemy's attack at the right moment and in the right posture can double the armor's defensive effectiveness

column1: 阅读秘籍需要消耗时间，秘籍越高级消耗时间越多。\n点击确认即可正式开始阅读。
column2: Reading a manual requires time, with more advanced manuals taking longer. Click confirm to start reading officially.

column1: 阴狠凶邪，专攻人体要害的刀法，传说此刀一出，必须见红夺命，否则便会反噬其主
column2: A sinister and vicious blade art targeting vital areas; legend says once this blade is drawn it must draw blood and take a life — otherwise it will turn on its own master

column1: 霸刀门基础硬功，以砂砾滚磨皮肤使周身老茧遍布，以岩石击打筋骨使肌体强韧非常
column2: A foundational hard-body training method of the Ba Dao Sect, where sand and gravel are used to grind the skin into calloused toughness, while stones strike the bones to forge extreme physical resilience.

column1: 鲜血铸就，惊鸿绝巘之枪法，三国名将赵子龙凭此出生入死，斩将七十余人未尝一败
column2: A spear art forged in blood, a breathtaking peak; the Three Kingdoms general Zhao Zilong used it to charge through life and death, slaying over seventy enemy generals without a single defeat

column1: 黢黑粗大之钢钉，边缘有增加穿透力的锋棱，以其劲道迅猛可以击碎头颅，故而闻名
column2: A thick black steel nail with sharp ridges along its edges to increase penetrating power; famous for being able to shatter a skull with its forceful impact

column1: 一张由铁索编成的大网，以内劲抛出，可罩住颇大一片范围，落网之人皆动弹不得
column2: A large net woven from iron chain links; thrown with inner force, it covers a wide area — all who fall under it are immobilized

column1: 以六种基本招式为根基的简练枪法，枪路刚猛直接，只需身强力壮者便能发挥威力
column2: A concise spear art built on six fundamental techniques; direct and forceful, anyone with a strong physique can wield it effectively

column1: 以棋盘对弈为形制，分析阵型地利之法，用兵作战，攻守纵横之妙，皆可蕴含其中
column2: A strategic system modeled after a chessboard formation, analyzing terrain and tactics for warfare, containing both offensive and defensive principles within its structure.

column1: 以琴弦引动音波，化为劲风飞射攻敌的奇特武功，其招式无影无形，因此难以躲避
column2: A peculiar martial art that uses sound waves from zither strings to launch invisible gusts of force at the enemy, making its attacks extremely difficult to evade.

column1: 你们几个都起来起来！\n徒儿，为师与你过招时处处手下留情，怕真伤了你性命。
column2: All of you, get up! Disciple, I've always held back when sparring with you, afraid of truly harming your life.

column1: 借助轻功与内劲吸附，在墙面游行之轻功，精通此术者于广厦高墙上亦能如履平地
column2: A Movement Art that adheres to wall surfaces using Movement Art and inner force absorption; the adept can move across towering walls as if on flat ground

column1: 健体强身之苦修功法，相传修习者日啖牛肉数斤而不觉饱，持之日久可得熊虎之相
column2: A grueling body-strengthening discipline; practitioners reportedly consume several jin of beef daily without feeling full — sustained over time, it produces the bearing of a bear or tiger

column1: 军队所用，可连续发射箭矢的机关弩，经神机门改进，威力和精准度都有较大提升
column2: A military crossbow system enhanced by the Shenji Sect, capable of firing continuous bolts with improved power and accuracy.

column1: 刀出如雷霆震怒，万军辟易，破阵如碾碎蝼蚁一般，久经沙场者亦不敢挡其锋芒。
column2: A saber technique like thunder’s wrath—devastating enough to scatter armies; battle-hardened warriors dare not block its edge.

column1: 吐纳功之进阶功法，于吐纳之时引气归元，使内力达到循环往复，生生不息之功效
column2: An advanced breathing art; while exhaling and inhaling, qi is guided back to its origin, creating a self-sustaining cycle of inner force

column1: 哎，就算这样，我这身功夫也是进步龟速。\n还望国师弟和顾师兄以后多多提点。
column2: Sigh, even so, my progress in martial arts is still painstakingly slow. I hope Brother Guo and Senior Apprentice Ge will offer me more guidance in the future.

column1: 嘿嘿，师傅，徒儿我最近研究了一套功法。\n此功颇为奇特，只能在梦中修炼……
column2: Hehe, Master, I've been studying a new set of techniques recently. This art is rather peculiar; it can only be cultivated in dreams…

column1: 在空气流通之清静室内，屏息凝神，盘腿打坐之法，有修身养性，锻炼心智之功效
column2: A sweeping, grand brush-style martial method. Amid extravagant feints lie decisive strikes targeting vital acupoints; once executed, no target is missed.

column1: 好了好了，你们俩这三脚猫功夫，\n你一拳我一脚打了半天，看的我都快睡着了。
column2: Enough already, your half-baked skills. You've been trading blows for ages—punches and kicks—that I'm on the verge of falling asleep.

column1: 如同乌黑树叶一般的飞镖，颇有几分重量，在夜间或树林中射出，常人人难以察觉
column2: Heavy dark-leaf-shaped darts that are nearly invisible when thrown at night or through trees

column1: 如果你能在一次攻击中击落多个射击物，\n就能获得额外连击数。
column2: If you canDeflect multiple projectiles in a single attack, you will gain additional combo strikes.

column1: 如此共襄盛举之大会，不知为何气氛突变。\n两派人马剑拔弩张，眼看便要动手。
column2: Such a grand gathering, yet the atmosphere suddenly turned tense. The two factions drew their swords, ready to clash at any moment.

column1: 如雪花纷飞洒出银屑攻敌之法，其功效与石灰粉相似，着之者目不能视，泪流不止
column2: Scatters silver powder like flying snowflakes to attack the enemy; its effect is similar to lime powder — contact causes blindness and uncontrollable tears

column1: 将全身力道绷紧，用以抵抗乃至反弹来袭的攻势，因蓄力时身形弯曲如龟壳而闻名
column2: Tenses the whole body's force to resist and deflect incoming attacks; named for the turtle-shell posture assumed while gathering Strength

column1: 将内息灌注周身经脉，用以抵挡攻击的防御法门，需有深厚内力根基方能发挥功效
column2: Channels inner breath through all the body's meridians to resist attacks; requires a deep inner force foundation to be effective

column1: 情势危急之时使出，足以力挽狂澜的挥戈之术，传说鲁阳公曾以此法逼退空中烈日
column2: A ge technique deployed in desperate moments, capable of turning the tide; legend says that Lord Luyang once used it to force the blazing sun to retreat across the sky

column1: 想我 成年之后，就一直胸怀壮志，\n想凭借自己的能力，在这江湖中一展拳脚。
column2: Ever since I came of age, I've been filled with ambition, eager to make a name for myself in this martial world using my own abilities.

column1: 攻守兼备之刀招，一经使用，四面八方皆为刀光所笼罩，需要相当高超的用刀技巧
column2: A well-rounded blade technique; once deployed, blade-light covers all eight directions, requiring considerable skill to wield

column1: 效仿百兽形意之刀法，其招式威猛霸道，颇具熊虎之姿，对修习者的体魄大有裨益
column2: A blade art imitating the spirit-forms of a hundred beasts; its moves are fierce and domineering with the bearing of bears and tigers, greatly benefiting the practitioner's physique

column1: 本是行伍中短钢鞭路数，被化用在长鞭之上，每一鞭挥出皆是孔武有力，威力不俗
column2: Originally a short steel whip method from the military; adapted for the long whip, every stroke carries formidable power

column1: 本用于惩罚犯戒僧众的佛门鞭式，也可做苦修之法，对使用者的内力修为要求较高
column2: Originally a Buddhist whip method used to punish monks who broke precepts; also used as a harsh training method, requiring a relatively high inner force foundation

column1: 此功法修炼者腰身与四肢极为柔韧，遇敌起舞，如迎风摆柳，或攻或守，灵活异常
column2: The practitioner's waist and limbs are extremely supple; when facing enemies, they move like willows in the wind, shifting between offense and defense with fluid agility

column1: 此杵法招式精深，攻守兼备，进能降服恶魔，故称大威，退能护佑良善，故称大德
column2: A vajra staff technique of profound depth, balancing offense and defense. When attacking, it subdues demons; when withdrawing, it protects the righteous—hence its dual names of “Great Might” and “Great Virtue.”

column1: 此棍法以攻代守，全力狂舞之时，棍影遮天蔽日，旨在以舍身之势压倒敌人的战意
column2: This staff art attacks in place of defending; when fully unleashed, the staff shadow blots out the sky, aiming to overwhelm the enemy's fighting spirit through sheer commitment

column1: 此棍法取大圣闹天宫之意，挥洒自若，汹涌滂湃，棍扫过处，纵十万天兵亦不能当
column2: This staff art draws from the spirit of the Great Sage rampaging through the Heavenly Palace; free and surging — where the staff sweeps, not even ten thousand heavenly soldiers can stand

column1: 此棍法注重灵活迅速，因此以短棍为优，棍势如同蟠龙环游周身，使敌人莫能近前
column2: A staff art emphasizing agility and speed, best with a short staff; the staff force circles the body like a coiling dragon, keeping enemies at bay

column1: 此蛊虫状如小蛇，阴寒至极，能够钻入目标体内顺血脉而行，阻塞内息，啮咬内脏
column2: This gu creature resembles a small snake and is extremely yin and cold; it can burrow into the target's body and travel through the blood vessels, blocking inner breath and gnawing at the internal organs

column1: 此针灸之法专门医治心脉重疾，对于气血亏虚之人大有裨益，亦有安定心神之功效
column2: An acupuncture method specifically for treating serious heart meridian illnesses; greatly beneficial for those with deficient qi and blood, and also calms the spirit

column1: 江湖传闻身中此符者，绝无生还之可能，真可谓阎王要你三更死，断不留人到五更
column2: A talismanic technique said in legend that anyone struck by it has no chance of survival, as if even Yama (the ruler of the underworld) decrees death at the third watch.

column1: 注重内功修为之剑法，其内劲收发方式繁多且可以自由组合，因此得“无量”之名
column2: A sword art that emphasizes inner cultivation; its methods of releasing and gathering inner force are numerous and freely combinable, earning it the name Wuliang — boundless

column1: 状如枣核的铁钉，便于携带隐藏，传说高手可从口中吐出，专攻面门令人防不胜防
column2: Iron nails shaped like jujube pits; easy to conceal, and masters can reportedly spit them from the mouth, targeting the face in a way that is nearly impossible to guard against

column1: 猛将应对盾牌之法，如烈火燎原，狂猛高速不断刺击，再严密之防御也难掩其锋芒
column2: A fierce general's method for dealing with shields; like wildfire spreading across a plain — relentless high-speed thrusting that no defense can withstand

column1: 短打拳法，其动作刚猛，招式朴实无华但发力迅速。由体质刚健者使出，威力更大
column2: A powerful short-range fist art with plain but fast techniques; even more effective when used by someone with a strong constitution

column1: 细如牛毛之钢针，一次发出多枚，威力不足以伤人性命，却能扰人心智，阻人血脉
column2: Steel needles as fine as ox hair; multiple are fired at once, too weak to take a life but capable of disturbing the mind and blocking blood flow

column1: 药王孙思邈所传之针灸术，以毫针捻转提插，刺激穴位，从而疏经通络，活血化瘀
column2: An acupuncture method passed down by the Medicine King Sun Simiao; the needle is twisted, lifted, and inserted to stimulate acupoints, unblocking meridians and activating blood circulation

column2: The Sutra Repository is where you read {{A}}. All {{A}} can only be studied here.

column1: 街边乞丐一遍以筷子敲碗，一遍所唱之歌谣，其吐字换气中暗含丐帮入门内功心法
column2: A street beggar's song tapped out with chopsticks on a bowl; the breath control and articulation conceal the Beggars Sect's entry-level inner art

column1: 装有火药和发烟物的球形暗器，掷出后会引起小幅爆炸，并产生大量烟雾迷惑敌人
column2: A spherical explosive device filled with gunpowder and smoke agents. Upon detonation, it produces a small blast and thick smoke to disorient enemies.

column1: 设有各式医疗工具和常见药材，供本门弟子寻医问药，疗养伤病，康复元气之所。
column2: A facility equipped with medical tools and herbs for treating injuries and restoring vitality.

column1: 这<color=#9A7CFF>十六路青龙戟</color>乃我成名绝学
column2: This<color=#9A7CFF>Sixteen-Pronged Green Dragon Halberd</color>It's my renowned masterpiece.

column1: 这套剑招灵巧绵密，如同云雾般无孔不入，无处不在，不需内功基础便能发挥效力
column2: Agile and relentless like mist — pervasive and inescapable; requires no inner art foundation to be effective

column1: 通过经脉运转，提高身体温度的瑜伽法门，在金刚宗所处的高原苦寒之地多有流传
column2: A yogic method that raises body temperature by circulating energy through the meridians. It is commonly practiced in the harsh high-altitude regions where the Vajra Sect resides.

column1: 道家上乘内功，将体内五气经过任督二脉汇聚于脑海，可去人间烦恼，入极乐幻境
column2: A high Daoist inner art that gathers the five inner qi through the governing and conception vessels to the crown of the head; it dispels worldly troubles and leads the practitioner into a blissful state

column1: 铸剑山庄基础心法，如同打铁一般撞击锤炼丹田内息的功法，需运功百次方能练成
column2: The foundational heart method of Sword Forging Villa; an art of striking and tempering the dantian's inner breath like forging iron — requires a hundred cycles to complete

column1: 铸剑山庄进阶心法，如同打铁一般撞击锤炼丹田内息的功法，需运功千次方能练成
column2: An advanced heart method of Sword Forging Villa; an art of striking and tempering the dantian's inner breath like forging iron — requires a thousand cycles to complete

column1: 集中全身力道冲撞之步法，纵使面对铜墙铁壁，亦能力破千军，如架战车长驱直入
column2: A footwork method that concentrates the whole body's force for a ramming charge; even against walls of bronze and iron, it can break through ten thousand soldiers — like driving a war chariot straight forward

column1: 一种独特的运劲技巧，将内力冲击通过实体传导，功力深厚者可以一拳击飞数人
column2: A unique force technique that transmits inner force impact through solid objects; those with deep power can knock several people flying with one punch

column1: 一门大开大合的进攻性鞭法，功力深厚者可以一鞭击碎岩石，足见其力道之刚猛
column2: A forceful offensive whip art; the powerful can shatter rock with a single stroke

column1: 专攻人体周身紧要死穴的狠毒指法，中招者五内翻滚，经脉逆行，如坠九幽黄泉
column2: A vicious finger method targeting the body's critical death acupoints throughout; those struck find their organs in turmoil and meridians reversed, as if falling into the nine depths of the underworld

column1: 举刀砍劈敌人上盘之刀法，招式简单以力量取胜，抵挡不及者难免头颈遭受重创
column2: A blade art of chopping at the enemy's upper section; the moves are simple and win through strength — those who fail to block risk severe damage to the head and neck

column1: 举剑过头顶，自上而下连续刺击之剑术，如天山飞瀑倾泻而落，以强劲力道取胜
column2: A downward continuous thrusting sword technique resembling a waterfall plunging from the heavens, relying on overwhelming force.

column1: 以巨斧迎头重劈的奇门招式，伴以怒吼之声増其声威，如盘古开天地般势不可挡
column2: An exotic heavy-axe technique that brings the blade crashing down with a battle cry to amplify its might — unstoppable as Pangu splitting heaven and earth

column1: 双手持刀，以全身之力快速劈出刀招，刀锋隐隐有雷鸣之声，乃是劈空刀气所致
column2: Two hands grip the blade, and the full body's force drives rapid chopping strokes; the faint thunder-like sound from the blade's edge is caused by the cleaving sword qi

column1: 名将所传，隐于诗词之绝技。练成此功者体魄心智均如脱胎换骨、神仙再造一般
column2: A supreme technique passed down by a famous general, hidden within poetry and verse; those who master it undergo a complete transformation of body and spirit, as if reborn

column1: 哼！当今乱世，皇帝暗弱，\n正是推举我兄长赵胤宗继承大统，改朝换代之时。
column2: Hmph! In this chaotic world, with the emperor weak and indecisive, it's the perfect time to have my brother Zhao Yinzong ascend to the throne and usher in a new era.

column1: 在九宫格阵中按五行生克移动之法，能够提升修习者下盘灵活以及奇门数术功力
column2: A martial philosophy where subtle teachings contain profound meaning. Each technique appears simple but hides layers of offense and defense only the wise can decipher.

column1: 在布置成梅花形的木桩上修炼步法，随功力渐进，木桩也会不断增高至五尺有余
column2: Trains footwork on plum-blossom-shaped wooden posts that grow taller as skill improves, eventually exceeding five chi

column1: 地痞流氓常用武功，章法散漫，好似胡打乱挥一气，却也能唬住一些武功低微者
column2: A technique commonly used by street thugs; seemingly random and wild, yet capable of intimidating those with little martial skill

column1: 安定心神，提振胆魄之法，可使惊慌失措之人顿生豪气，旁人看来有如关公附体
column2: A method for calming the spirit and bolstering courage; those in a panic suddenly feel a surge of heroic energy — to onlookers it seems as if Guan Yu himself has possessed them

column1: 将乾坤之气化于胸腹之中，即便是寻常招式，也可于瞬息之间发挥出惊人的威力
column2: A method of condensing cosmic qi into the chest and abdomen, allowing even ordinary techniques to unleash tremendous power in an instant.

column1: 将铁钩绑在手上运用的功法，使用时以钩代手，势如蜈蚣，蜿蜒诡谲，无孔不入
column2: Binds iron hooks to the hands; the user strikes with hooks instead of fists, winding and deceptive like a centipede

column1: 小巧的蛇形锥刺，便于携带隐藏，使用起来防不胜防，威力不俗且带有些微毒性
column2: Small snake-shaped awls that are easy to conceal and use; hard to guard against, with decent power and a mild toxin

column1: 屏息静气，全神贯注于耳部，从而增强听力之法，能听闻并定位周围微小的声响
column2: A breathing discipline focused entirely on the ears. By concentrating awareness there, the practitioner greatly enhances hearing and can detect and locate even the faintest sounds nearby.

column1: 我说顾师兄怎么突然定下赌约，\n原来是激将之法，专门激我刻苦练功来的啊！
column2: I see, that's why Senior Apprentice Brother Gu suddenly set up a wager. It was just a ploy to motivate me to train harder!

column1: 招法优雅灵动，落花流水般倾泻而下，而剑招中暗含的内力更是能够伤人于无形
column2: Elegant and fluid, cascading like falling flowers and flowing water; the hidden inner force within the moves injures the enemy invisibly

column1: 有四只白蹄的纯黑色骏马，其先祖位列唐太宗六骏，被赞为倚天长剑，追风骏足
column2: A pure black horse with four white hooves; its ancestor was one of Taizong's Six Steeds, praised as a sword reaching heaven and hooves chasing the wind.

column1: 此拳法手型独特，如螳螂前爪般勾起，招式灵活迅速，讲求以螳螂捕蝉之势制敌
column2: Features a distinctive hand shape hooked like a mantis foreleg; moves are swift and agile, seeking to catch the enemy as a mantis catches a cicada

column1: 泰山高手留下的内家心法，其内力奔流之势雄浑磅礴，有如泰山压顶，能敌百人
column2: An inner heart method left by a Taishan master; its inner force surges with overwhelming momentum like Taishan pressing down, capable of overwhelming a hundred enemies

column1: 清风徐来，水波不兴，此剑法不急不躁，舒缓平稳，旨在锻炼经脉而非逞强伤人
column2: A gentle breeze stirs, the water ripples not — this sword art is unhurried and steady, aimed at conditioning the meridians rather than overpowering opponents

column1: 猛将所传，刀势自下而上攻击骑兵之招数，据说由臂力惊人者使用，能挑飞战马
column2: Passed down by a fierce general; the blade strikes upward to target mounted enemies — said to send war horses flying when used by someone with extraordinary arm strength

column1: 用拳脚和身体击打冲撞砖墙的硬功修行之法，墙壁破碎坍塌之日，便是功成之时
column2: A hard qigong discipline of striking and ramming brick walls with hands, feet, and body; the art is complete when the wall crumbles and collapses

column1: 腾空而起，快速左右横移之步法，因其发力迅速，能够躲避各种常见招式的攻击
column2: A footwork technique of leaping into the air and rapidly shifting left and right. Its explosive initiation allows the practitioner to evade a wide range of common attacks.

column1: 蕴含道家修真法门的内功典籍，讲求清静无为，归根复命，资质凡俗者颇难参悟
column2: An inner art classic embodying Daoist cultivation principles of stillness and returning to the root; difficult for those of ordinary talent to comprehend

column1: 要尽量避免击落这些特殊射击物，\n让他们触碰到自身，方能获得其正面效果。
column2: Try to avoid deflecting these special projectiles; let them hit you to gain their beneficial effects.

column1: 踩在冰面上以五指取冰之法，不仅需维持腿脚之平衡，手部抓握力道亦不能松懈
column2: A balance-and-grip training method practiced on ice, requiring practitioners to maintain stability on slippery surfaces while also applying precise hand strength.

column1: 轻快迅捷之刀法，施展时闪烁刀光覆盖周身，犹如身披羽衣，寻常拳脚不能近之
column2: A light and swift blade art; when deployed, flickering blade-light covers the entire body like wearing a feathered robe — ordinary fists and feet cannot get close

column1: 这<color=#2779FA>泼墨成画功</color>乃我成名绝学
column2: This<color=#2779FA>Ink Painting Technique</color>It's my renowned masterpiece.

column1: 这<color=#FF8C06>日月明光掌</color>你能否抵挡？
column2: This<color=#FF8C06>Sun Moon Bright Palm</color>Can you withstand it?

column1: 这<color=#FF8C06>镇魔斩妖刀</color>你能否抵挡？
column2: This<color=#FF8C06>Demon-Slaying Sword of Exorcism</color>Can you withstand it?

column1: 这位少侠想租下本武馆的书房，用于研读秘籍吗？\n保管安静舒适，价钱实惠~
column2: Would Young Hero like to rent this Martial Arts School’s Study Room to read manuals?\nIt is quiet, comfortable, and reasonably priced.

column1: 钟离权所创蓬莱派修真心法，内含阴阳调和，修生养息，运气御剑等基础之法门
column2: A cultivation technique created by Zhongli Quan, emphasizing yin-yang harmony and foundational qi control for healing, energy circulation, and sword guidance.

column1: 需要双手握刀的刀法，以身催刀，刀随身转，使用者悟性越高，刀势越难于预料
column2: A two-handed blade art that uses the body to drive the blade; the more perceptive the user, the more unpredictable the blade

column1: 高人观泰山五大夫松所创之剑法，其剑势如苍松挺直，古朴沉稳，讲求以静制动
column2: Created by a master observing the five Grandee Pines of Taishan; the sword force is like a straight ancient pine — composed and still, overcoming motion with stillness

column1: 一字电剑剑势喜直，将全身力道集中一线击出，不留防御后手，自然快如闪电
column2: The Single Character Lightning Sword favors straight thrusts, concentrating all force into one line with no defensive follow-up — naturally fast as lightning

column1: 从推拿手法中演化而来，以巧劲攻敌软弱之处，也能借反冲力道畅通自身气血
column2: Evolved from tuina massage techniques; uses clever force to strike the enemy's weak points, and can also use the rebound force to unblock one's own qi and blood

column1: 以人体为画布，以穴位为着墨之处的奇门绘画武功，能快速点指敌人多处穴位
column2: A strange martial art that uses the human body as a canvas, striking acupoints as if painting, allowing rapid and precise disruption of multiple vital points.

column1: 以内劲攻击人体关键穴位之指法，中招者血流淤塞，经脉受阻，只得任人鱼肉
column2: A finger method that attacks key acupoints with inner force; those struck find blood flow stagnant and meridians blocked, left entirely at the mercy of the attacker

column1: 以灵巧手法抛出大量粹毒铁砂，一旦接触皮肤或眼睛，便疼痛难忍，无法再战
column2: Throws a large quantity of poison-laced iron sand with nimble technique; contact with skin or eyes causes unbearable pain, rendering the victim unable to fight

column1: 以高强内力催动之轻功，可在空中快速行进，周身真气萦绕如同腾云驾雾一般
column2: A high-level Movement Art powered by strong Inner Force, allowing the practitioner to move through the air as if riding clouds.

column1: 传自天竺的瑜伽柔术，可使全身筋骨关节柔软如棉，团缩后身形几乎减小一半
column2: A flexible Indian yogic art that renders the joints and bones soft and pliable, allowing the body to fold into unusually compact forms.

column1: 传闻是西楚霸王项羽被困垓下时领悟出的最后招式，奈何因其败亡而最终失传
column2: A final move allegedly realized by Xiang Yu at the Battle of Gaixia; it was never passed down due to his ultimate defeat and death.

column1: 再者说来，国师弟这身功夫也着实蹩脚，\n我看在眼里，也为你捏了把汗啊。
column2: To put it plainly, your skills are rather poor. I've been watching and have been worried for you.

column1: 凶狠诡谲之鞭法，形同五鬼缠绕敌身，不断撕扯其皮肉，逃避不掉亦甩脱不开
column2: A vicious and uncanny whip technique resembling five ghostly spirits entangling the opponent, tearing relentlessly and impossible to shake off.

column1: 分为七式，将北斗七星之方位与运行规律蕴含其中，招式精妙非凡，常人难解
column2: Divided into seven forms embodying the positions and movements of the Big Dipper; exquisitely refined and difficult for ordinary people to understand

column1: 双手上下翻转，如同龙飞凤舞，颇为好看，其实暗含巨大力道，不能掉以轻心
column2: Both hands flip and turn like a dancing dragon and phoenix — visually impressive, but concealing enormous force not to be taken lightly

column1: 合掌迎击的防御掌法，双掌相合后虽灵活性下降，但其重击能令敌方血脉不畅
column2: A defensive palm art that meets attacks with joined palms; while flexibility decreases, its heavy strikes can disrupt the enemy's blood flow

column1: 国师弟不妨随我去练武场上，我来指导你如何获取实战经验！
column2: Why don't you follow me to the Training Grounds, Little Brother? I'll guide you on how to acquireCombat Experience！

column1: 天山苦寒，积雪深厚，外门弟子在山道上洒扫庭除，挑水担柴，颇要几分脚力
column2: Due to the harsh snowy environment of the Tianshan mountains, outer disciples are tasked with sweeping, carrying water, and gathering firewood along steep mountain paths, developing endurance and footwork.

column1: 宇文极获得了 <color=#2779FA>逐浪刀法</color>
将下盘以磐石之劲道扎根地面的硬功绝技，可增强身体平衡和腿脚抗击打能力
column2: A hard-body technique that anchors the lower stance like a stone, greatly enhancing balance and resistance to leg attacks.

column1: 将寒冷内息注入他人体内之咒术，可令其气血冰凝，经脉淤阻，周身寒气弥散
column2: An incantation that injects cold inner breath into another person's body, causing their qi and blood to freeze, meridians to stagnate, and cold qi to spread throughout

column1: 屏息静气，全神贯注于眼部，从而增强视力之法，能看清远处高速移动的物体
column2: A vision-focused breathing discipline that enhances eyesight, allowing the practitioner to track fast-moving distant objects.

column1: 当朝皇帝所居之宫殿，虽几经战乱焚毁太半，依旧气势恢宏，极具王者气象。
column2: The emperor’s residence, grand and majestic despite historical destruction.

column1: 新的江湖传闻：<color=#FD1430>武学奇才</color>
column2: New rumors in the world of martial arts：<color=#FD1430>A genius in martial arts</color>

column1: 本地开山凿石，探寻矿脉之处，区域所有者可在此开采矿石，以供门派使用。
column2: A mining site for extracting Ore.

column1: 本地森林繁茂，树木茁壮之处，区域所有者可在此砍伐木材，以供门派使用。
column2: A wooded area used for harvesting timber for sect construction and crafting.

column1: 本地种植药草，栽培异花之处，区域所有者可在此采摘药材，以供门派使用。
column2: A cultivation area for Herbs and rare plants.

column1: 本地耕种粮食，养殖放牧之处，区域所有者可在此收取粮食，以供门派使用。
column2: An agricultural area for growing crops and raising livestock to supply Food.

column1: 本地银两兑换，典当放债之处，区域所有者可在此赚取银两，以供门派使用。
column2: A place for currency exchange and lending, generating income for the sect.

column1: 本是佛门惩罚犯戒僧众的杖法，被江湖人士用以对敌，容易命中，但威力不足
column2: Originally a Buddhist punishment staff method; adapted for jianghu combat, it is easy to land but lacks power

column1: 本是商贾招财进宝之摆件，熟铜铸就，颇有几分重量，改作暗器倒也还算趁手
column2: Originally a merchant's good-luck ornament cast in solid copper with some weight; repurposed as a hidden weapon, it is reasonably effective

column1: 此剑招共一十八路，进退有据，快慢相合，其节奏变化往往令对敌者难以招架
column2: Eighteen roads of sword moves with measured advance and retreat, mixing fast and slow; the rhythm changes often leave opponents struggling to respond

column1: 此剑法以气势见长，在雪地中使出时能将周围积雪扬起，挥挥洒洒随剑风飘荡
column2: A sword style known for its imposing momentum; when used in snowy terrain, it can stir up surrounding snow, scattering it like wind-blown flakes.

column1: 此心法暗合天道，旨在颐养神智，功成后如高僧入定，泰山崩于前亦面不改色
column2: This heart method aligns with the heavenly way and is aimed at cultivating the spirit; once mastered, the practitioner is as composed as a high monk in meditation — unmoved even by a collapsing mountain

column1: 毛色如绸缎般柔亮，体格极为健壮的黑马，霸王项羽曾骑着这种战马征伐四方
column2: A black horse with a coat as smooth and lustrous as silk; the warlord Xiang Yu once rode its ancestor to conquer all under heaven.

column1: 注重防御之步法，其身形弯腰弓背，左挡右支，每日演练也有养生健体之功效
column2: A defensive footwork method; the practitioner bends and stoops, blocking left and right — daily practice also benefits health and longevity

column1: 源于佛门的心神修炼之法，讲求临危不乱，神识铁铸，有如五方揭谛加持一般
column2: A Buddhist mental training method emphasizing composure in crisis; the spirit becomes iron-forged, as if blessed by the Five Direction Jiedis

column1: 源自上古之招式，集中全身力道体魄于一点，射出惊天动地，鬼哭神嚎之一箭
column2: An arrow technique from ancient times that concentrates the practitioner’s entire strength and physique into a single point, unleashing a devastating, soul-shaking shot.

column1: 灵巧协调之拳法，其三十六式变化多端，连环紧扣，擅长封禁敌手，避实打虚
column2: A flexible thirty-six-form boxing system with continuous chaining variations, specializing in sealing techniques and exploiting openings in an opponent’s defense.

column1: 爆炸威力不俗，且声响震天的火药暗器，光凭借其声势便可吓退心智脆弱之人
column2: A highly explosive hidden weapon with a loud detonation. Its sheer sound and shockwave alone are often enough to frighten away the mentally weak.

column1: 状如莲花的奇门暗器，其花瓣边缘锋利无比，可一齐飞射而出，攻击周遭敌人
column2: A lotus-shaped exotic hidden weapon with razor-sharp petals that all fly out at once, attacking surrounding enemies

column1: 着重于锻炼身体柔坚韧的功法，练成者的关节与肢体能以极大的幅度弯曲摆动
column2: Focuses on training flexibility; the adept's joints and limbs can bend and sway to an extraordinary degree

column1: 绕圣山转圈而行的祭祀之法，由于需一路翻山越岭，颇为考验虔诚之心和脚力
column2: A ritual practice of circling a sacred mountain, requiring the practitioner to traverse rugged terrain. It is a test of both devotion and physical endurance.

column1: 自由无碍，随心所欲移动现身之本领，不论重峦叠嶂或刀枪障碍皆可轻易翻过
column2: A movement skill of effortless freedom, allowing the practitioner to traverse mountains, obstacles, and weapon barrages with ease.

column1: 茅山派最为闻名的奇门功法，引动阴阳内息剧烈摩擦碰撞，产生雷电攻击敌人
column2: The most famous exotic art of the Maoshan Sect; drives yin and yang inner breath into violent friction and collision to generate lightning that strikes the enemy

column1: 茅山派集中神智，使耳聪目明之法，被民间讹传为眼睛伸长，耳朵飞出的仙术
column2: A Maoshan method for concentrating the mind to sharpen hearing and vision; folk legend has garbled this into a magical art of extending the eyes and flying out the ears

column1: 行伍猛士所使的挥戈术，专破敌人防御，凭其惊人力道，可轻易啄开寻常甲盾
column2: A ge strike art used by fierce military warriors; specializes in breaking the enemy's defense — with tremendous force, it can easily peck open ordinary armor and shields

column1: 谢师傅教诲！\n我从今日起一定痛改前非，刻苦练功，定不辜负您老的教诲！
column2: Master Xie, thank you for your guidance! From today on, I will earnestly mend my ways and diligently practice. I will not disappoint your teachings!

column1: 这<color=#FF8C06>春秋笔法</color>乃我成名绝学
column2: This<color=#FF8C06>Spring and Autumn Annals technique</color>It's my renowned masterpiece.

column1: 长乐帮正式弟子有时需要迎送贵客，此时摆出知足常乐之笑脸，方为生财之道
column2: Formal Changle Gang disciples sometimes receive distinguished guests; greeting them with a content and joyful smile is the way to prosperity

column1: 长白山人观察野狐缠斗猎犬而悟出的拳法，招式多为虚招，意在智取而非力胜
column2: A fist art devised by observing a wild fox entangle a hunting dog in the Changbai Mountains; most moves are feints, aiming to outwit rather than overpower

column1: 随着时间推进，参战角色会自动积累行动条。\n行动条满者，即可进行行动。
column2: As time progresses, participating characters will automatically accumulate action bars. Once a character's action bar is full, they can take an action.

column1: 霹雳堂流出的火药法，经黑道高手改造后体积更小，出手更快，令人防不胜防
column2: A firework technique derived from the Thunderbolt Sect, refined by underworld experts to become smaller and faster, making it even harder to defend against.

column1: 一双手掌如同铁琵琶一般环抱身前，防御滴水不漏，令敌人难寻破绽之掌法
column2: A palm art where both hands circle in front like an iron pipa; defense is airtight, leaving the enemy no opening to exploit

column1: 专攻敌人心胸部位之钢钉，较之其他暗器要锋利沉重许多，因此穿透力不俗
column2: A steel nail specifically targeting the enemy's chest and heart; heavier and sharper than other hidden weapons, with excellent penetrating power

column1: 主修翻滚腾跃之轻功功法，使用者身形上下回转之间，更容易避开敌人攻击
column2: A Movement Art focused on rolling and leaping; the user's body rotates up and down, making it easier to evade attacks

column1: 京城守卫禁军所习之入门内功心法，与武林中人的内功相比，颇为简单直接
column2: The entry-level inner art practiced by the Imperial Guard defending the capital; compared to the inner arts of jianghu practitioners, it is quite simple and direct

column1: 仿照手戟制成的暗器，可作近身格斗之用，关键时刻掷出，威力也不容小觑
column2: A hidden weapon modeled on a hand halberd; usable in close combat, and when thrown at a critical moment, its power is not to be underestimated

column1: 你这太祖长拳功夫刚达三重境界，\n不如就先在此处自行练习一次，如何？
column2: Your Great Ancestor Long Fist technique has just reached the third level. How about you practice it here first?

column1: 刀光剑影，地暗天昏，\n泰岳大典会场上群雄相争，一时竟不知鹿死谁手。
column2: Blades gleam, swords cast shadows; the ground darkens as heaven dims. At the Taiyue Grand Ceremony, heroes clash, and for a moment, it's unclear who will emerge victorious.

column1: 刺客所用，以诡异多变，悄无声息的快刀闻名，招式如阴风阵阵，杀意凛然
column2: A footwork used by assassins; famous for its strange, unpredictable, and utterly silent swift blade — its moves are like a chill wind, chilling with killing intent

column1: 剑招中饱含泼墨挥毫的潇洒之意，相传乃是剑术名家观颜真卿书法领悟而成
column2: Full of the free-spirited feeling of dashing ink and sweeping brushstrokes; said to have been inspired by a sword master watching the calligraphy of Yan Zhenqing

column1: 古门派点苍遗留之剑谱，大巧不工，重剑无锋，招式之中颇有古朴归真之意
column2: A sword manual left behind by an ancient sect at Diancang; great skill lies in simplicity, a heavy sword needs no edge — the moves carry an ancient, unadorned quality
Do you recognize this move?<color=#FD1430>Murderous Blade</color>？

column1: 右侧的菜单栏，可以进行其他的战斗操作，\n如移动，休息，使用物品等。
column2: The right-side menu bar allows you to perform other combat actions, such as moving, resting, and using items.

column1: 啊这......嘿嘿。\n师兄你还是快说说，这{{A}}阅读之法吧。
column2: Ah, this... hehe. Senior Brother, please tell me about the {{A}} Reading Method quickly.

column1: 基础点穴手法，药王谷入门弟子常借修习此功夫来辨认穴位，学习经脉走向

column2: A Movement Art that concentrates the body's entire weight on the arms to amplify striking force — balanced on a thread

column2: A rapid offensive blade style as fast as a violent wind, capable of unleashing multiple strikes in the blink of an eye, commonly used by Western frontier swordsmen.

column2: A broom technique used by servants and errand-runners; useful enough for sweeping dust, but noticeably lacking in power against opponents
