column2: A thirteen-form technique like rolling sea winds chasing waves—vast, flowing, and continuous. Its Inner Force is layered upon itself, creating endless cascading momentum.

column1: 此步法讲求绵绵不绝之快速平移，使用者如纷繁流星划空，令敌人眼花缭乱
column2: A footwork method of sustained rapid lateral movement; the user shifts like a shower of meteors across the sky, dazzling the enemy

column1: 此马色如霜纨，形如秋雁，毛发如白练，高首而脩颈，气质如霜，寒气逼人
column2: Its coat is like frosted silk, its form like an autumn crane, its mane like white satin; it holds its head high with a cold and ethereal bearing.

column1: 武当内家剑之母，其神韵悠然自得，沉着稳重，亦包含基础的内劲运用技巧
column2: A movement style derived from the “Feather Garment Dance,” shifting between graceful spirals and dragon-like turns; even simple moves become endlessly variable.

column1: 注重刚柔并济之刀法，因其招式不疾不徐，横平竖直，观之有如雁行而闻名
column2: A blade art balancing hard and soft; its steady, horizontal techniques resemble geese in formation

column1: 用手掌反复拍打蓝色毒砂，直至皮肤微微发蓝，此后掌力便带有冰寒之毒性
column2: A training method of repeatedly slapping blue poison sand with the palms until the skin turns faintly blue; thereafter the palm force carries an icy toxic quality

column1: 用细密银线编织之网，一旦罩住猎物后会自行不断收紧，寻常兵刃无法砍动
column2: A net woven from fine silver thread that continuously tightens on its own once it covers prey; ordinary weapons cannot cut it

column1: 眼下你不必多虑，先开始练习再说，\n遇到问题之时，我自会在一旁指点。
column2: Don't worry about it for now. Just start practicing, and I'll guide you along the way when you run into any issues.

column2: The Yaowang Valley entry-level heart method; gathers the essence of heaven and earth to nourish one's own yuan qi, strengthening inner breath and extending lifespan

column1: 蓬莱高人观海边流云所创，剑势时而聚拢，时而飘散，以虚胜实，难以捉摸
column2: A sword style created by a Penglai master after observing drifting sea clouds. Its movements alternate between gathering and dispersing, using emptiness to overcome substance and making its trajectory impossible to predict.

column1: 谋朝篡逆本就是滔天大罪。\n副统领此言说来，倒像是什么惊天善举一般。
column2: Usurping the throne is already a heinous crime. Yet, Second-in-Command makes it sound like some kind of noble deed.
This<color=#FF8C06>Flower Pinch Finger Technique</color>Can you withstand it?

column1: 这套剑法起源于行伍，大开大阖，势大力沉，非身强体壮者难以发挥其威力
column2: Originates from the military; large and powerful, requiring a strong physique to wield effectively

column1: 追求极高出剑速度的剑法，其势若闪电，一去不返，但也因此导致防御薄弱
column2: Pursues the highest possible sword speed; its momentum is like lightning, with no return — leaving defense weak

column1: 遍体火红，体型庞大之骏马，冲锋时势大力猛，如烈火燎原，堪称马中王者
column2: A massive horse with a fiery red coat; its charge is as overwhelming as a wildfire - the undisputed king among horses.

column1: 铸剑山庄旁有寒泉一眼，此剑法以此得名，其招式简洁明快，如同清泉奔流

column1: 长乐帮特制乱人心神之毒药，中此毒者或狂呼或大笑，手舞足蹈，丑态百出

column1: 阴险剧毒之暗器，中此砂者痛苦万分，如坠黄泉九幽，求生不得，求死不能
column2: A vicious hidden poison weapon; those struck by this sand suffer unbearable agony as if falling into the nine depths of the underworld — neither living nor dying in peace

column1: 霹雳堂多使爆炸暗器，若此法修习不精，很容易因投掷距离不够而炸伤自己
column2: A low-level Thunderclap Hall practice: insufficient mastery often leads to mishandling explosive tools, causing users to injure themselves due to poor throwing range or timing.

column1: 青铜制机关牛，牛角弯曲尖锐，其冲锋时如野牛奔突，威力惊人，势不可挡
column2: A bronze mechanized bull with sharply curved horns that charges like a wild beast, unstoppable and devastating in impact.

column1: 韬光养晦之功法，将内力藏于丹田，如龙潜于深渊之中，以图厚积薄发之机
column2: A patient art that conceals inner force in the dantian like a dragon lying in deep waters, waiting for the moment to release immense accumulated power

column2: The sword art used by Zhuan Zhu when he assassinated the King of Wu; primarily thrusting techniques, with a certain dangerous edge in close combat

column1: 以双臂抱树不断运力拔持的奇特功法，功成者一发力便可将树木连根拔起
column2: An unusual art practiced by repeatedly hugging a tree and exerting force to uproot it; the adept can tear a tree from the ground with a single exertion

column1: 以极细之棉纱反复编织至拇指粗细而成，可以有效牵制被套住的敌人行动
column2: Woven repeatedly from extremely fine cotton thread to thumb thickness; effectively restrains the movement of anyone caught in it

column1: 以猴拳为基础，讲求近身缠斗的小擒拿手法，很适合内力根基薄弱者使用
column2: A small grappling method based on monkey fist, focusing on close-range entanglement; well-suited to those with a weaker inner force foundation

column1: 传说祖先乃秦始皇座下名马，为求仙药随其东巡，过名川大山如飞履平地
column2: Legend holds that its ancestor was a prized horse of the First Emperor of Qin; it accompanied him east in search of immortality, crossing great mountains and rivers as if on flat ground.

column1: 你可以在武馆中阅读秘籍，习武练功，\n但都需要花费一定的银两才行。
column2: You can read manuals, practice martial arts, and train at the martial arts hall, but all of these require a certain amount of silver coins.

column1: 势大力沉，刚猛雄壮之刀法，如由膂力过人者使出，更是有分金断玉之能
column2: Overwhelmingly powerful and fierce; in the hands of someone with exceptional arm strength, it can cleave gold and split jade

column1: 取寻仙问道之“仙”字，与陶弘景“心标象外，志结霞门”之“霞”字，

column2: A pair of thrusting weapons sweeping around the body in continuous loops; a tight defensive technique

column2: A lotus-step Movement Art that becomes effortless when the mind is pure.

column1: 极大加快出手速度的发力技巧，招法快如闪电，兼具万钧之势，常人难挡
column2: A force-releasing technique that greatly accelerates striking speed; moves are fast as lightning and carry immense force — hard for ordinary people to withstand

column1: 柔弱无骨，顺势攀附之奇特手法，可沿敌人手臂缠绕而上，攻其心腹要害

column1: 此绝技姿势奇特，狂放不羁，大摇大摆之间，可将自身的力道催发到极致

column1: 武当入门内功，通过呼吸吐纳取天地精气，排体内浊气，求阴阳调和之法
column2: A refined brush technique where the tip moves in rapid, delicate motions, producing floral afterimages in the air—extremely ornate and visually dazzling.

column2: The private residences in the capital are the most expensive due to their highest rank.

column1: 每一级别的武功都有修习数量上限，\n超出上限后所有该级别武功获得的经验都会减少。
column2: Each level of martial arts has a study limit. Once this limit is exceeded, all experience gained for that level will be reduced.

column1: 外功武学的突破效果，\n只有在使用该武学时才会生效。
column2: The Breakthrough Effects of external martial arts only takes effect when using that specific martial art.

column1: 探索耐力耗尽后，\n每走一步都会消耗越来越多生命/内力。

column1: 战场局势瞬息万变，\n对付实力较弱者也不可掉以轻心。
column2: The battlefield situation changes in an instant, and even when facing those with weaker strength, one must not take it lightly.

column1: 行走江湖不能一味单打独斗，\n多与其他侠士组队同行，方为万全之法。
column2: Traveling through the world shouldn't be done alone; teaming up with other knights often leads to better outcomes.

column1: 国少侠来得正好，你仙霞派的杨思迟欠我不少银两，早已过了还款期限。\n我此次特意前来，便是为了讨回这笔欠款。
column2: Master, you've arrived just in time. Yang Sichí from your Xianxia sect owes me quite a sum of silver, and the repayment deadline has long passed. I came here specifically to collect this debt.

column1: 杨思迟有事出远门了吗？\n也罢也罢，那我改日再寻他好了。
column2: Yang Sichi has gone on a long journey? Very well, I'll look for him another day.

column1: 杨师兄你慌慌张张的从大门跑进来干啥呢？\n不会又背着师傅偷偷溜下山了吧！
column2: Senior Brother Yang, why are you rushing in through the main gate? Could it be that you're sneaking down the mountain behind Master's back again!

column1: 呼...呼...适才在山下和几个武林人士打了一架，幸好我溜得快才保住小命。\n师弟你可千万要替我保守秘密，不能让掌门知道啊！
column2: Huff... huff... I just had a fight with some martial artists down the mountain. Fortunately, I ran fast enough to save my skin. Little brother, you've got to keep this secret for me; we can't let the Grandmaster find out!

column1: 你们两个在这儿鬼鬼祟祟干什么呢？\n是不是有人又偷偷溜下山，闯祸惹事了啊？
column2: What are you two up to, sneaking around like that? Did someone slip down the mountain again and cause trouble?

column2: With the culprit arrested and brought to justice,\nlawlessness around here should settle down for a while.

column1: 那名逃犯被你击倒在地，再也无力反抗，只得乖乖束手就擒。
column2: You knock the fugitive to the ground. Unable to resist any longer, he has no choice but to surrender.

column1: 这封信是给我的吗？那就有劳金少侠了。
column2: This letter is for me? Thank you for bringing it, Young Hero Jin.

column1: # TEST24 - direct PlotData harvest 300-330 (source dump exact backups)
杨师兄？没啊，师姐寻他有事？
column2: Senior Brother Yang? No. Are you looking for him, Senior Sister?

column1: 他前些时候自告奋勇，替我去江陵采买物资，\n怎么这么许久了,还没回来呢？
column2: A while ago he volunteered to go to Jiangling to buy supplies for me.\nWhy has he been gone so long without coming back?

column1: 呵呵，师姐莫慌，估摸着是在江陵那个地方玩耍，忘了时间了。
column2: Heh, don't worry, Senior Sister. He probably got carried away having fun somewhere in Jiangling and lost track of time.

column1: 哼，思迟可不像你，整天想着怎么偷懒耍滑。\n他就是不吃饭不睡觉，这每天的练功也从不会落下。
column2: Hmph, Sichi isn't like you, always thinking of ways to slack off.\nEven if he skipped meals and sleep, he would never miss his daily training.

column1: 啊，想来杨师兄此前每次下山，好像都会行侠仗义，然后被暴打一顿……
column2: Come to think of it, every time Senior Brother Yang goes down the mountain, he seems to play the hero... and then gets beaten half to death...

column1: 乌鸦嘴……可若思迟真遇上歹人受了伤，那可如何是好……
column2: Don't jinx him... But what if Sichi really ran into villains and got hurt? What should we do...

column1: 你顾师兄重伤未愈，若思迟又有什么三长两短，我可怎么和师傅交代……
column2: Senior Brother Gu still hasn't recovered from his serious injuries. If something happens to Sichi too, how am I supposed to face Master...

column1: 嗨师姐莫慌，咱们一道沿路去江陵附近找找便是。\n杨师兄吉人天相，或许只是迷路罢了。
column2: Don't worry, Senior Sister. Let's follow the road toward Jiangling and look for him.\nSenior Brother Yang is blessed with good fortune. Maybe he simply got lost.

column1: 说的是，咱们赶紧出发。\n思迟还没吃早饭，我给他带一份，#PlayerName#你也拿着路上吃。
column2: You're right. Let's leave at once.\nSichi hasn't had breakfast yet, so I'll bring him some. #PlayerName#, take one for the road too.

column1: 狗贼，光天化日，朗朗乾坤，竟敢在此欺行霸市。\n我#SourceForceDescribe##$SourceInteractName#第一个不同意！
column2: You scoundrel! In broad daylight, under a clear sky, you dare bully the people and dominate the market?\nI, #SourceForceDescribe##$SourceInteractName#, will be the first to stop you!

column1: 久仰久仰，在下“化虎成龙”张成化，乃是龙虎寨寨主。\n在此向父老乡亲们收取保护费用，是为了寨内弟兄日常资用，实属无奈之举。
column2: A pleasure, a pleasure. I am Zhang Chenghua, known as 'Tiger Transformed into Dragon,' Chief of Dragon-Tiger Stronghold.\nI collect protection fees from the local folk only to cover my brothers' daily expenses. I truly have no choice.

column1: 这荆湖北路一带黑白两道，听闻我张成化的大名，多少给个面子。\n还望兄弟行个方便，莫要拂了在下这张老脸。
column2: Both the righteous and underworld circles of northern Jinghu give me, Zhang Chenghua, some face when they hear my name.\nI hope you can do me a favor, brother, and not embarrass this old face of mine.

column1: 看你说话文绉绉的，怎的竟是个土匪头子？\n你若明事理，便随我一道去官府自首，我替你说几句好话！
column2: You talk like a scholar, yet you're a bandit chief?\nIf you have any sense, come with me to surrender to the authorities. I'll even put in a few good words for you!

column1: 哈哈，杨兄弟说的甚好，我也正有此意。\n可惜……
column2: Ha! Well said, Brother Yang. I was thinking the very same thing.\nUnfortunately...

column1: 可惜……\n你要先走一步，去黄泉路了！
column2: Unfortunately...\nyou'll have to go ahead of me on the road to the underworld!

column1: 哎哟！狗贼竟敢偷袭我，看剑！
column2: Ow! You dog, you dare ambush me? Draw your sword!
Hmph! You've got some skill, you scoundrel.

column1: 杨兄咱们往日无怨近日无仇，今天也算不打不相识。\n不如就此罢手，你走你的阳关道，我走我的独木桥如何？
column2: Brother Yang, we've never had a grudge before today. You could say we've come to know each other through fighting.\nWhy not stop here? You take your broad road and I'll take my narrow bridge. How about it?

column1: 你把抢的钱财还给乡亲们，我就不和你计较！
column2: Return the money you stole to the villagers and I won't pursue this any further!

column1: 呵呵，好说，杨兄自己来拿如何？
column2: Heh, certainly. Why don't you come take it yourself, Brother Yang?
Fine. Looks like you still have a shred of conscience...

column1: 杨师兄当心，莫要中了贼人奸计！
column2: Senior Brother Yang, watch out! Don't fall for the villain's trick!

column1: 这种恶徒，一个字都不能信，杨师兄我和姜师姐来助你！
column2: You can't believe a single word from a villain like this. Senior Brother Yang, Senior Sister Jiang and I will help you!

column1: 哎这又何苦，如此可就难以收场了。\n小的们，莫留活口！
column2: Why make things so difficult? Now this will be hard to settle peacefully.\nMen, leave no survivors!

column1: 哎！竟敢偷袭，算什么英雄好汉。
column2: Hey! Ambushing me? What kind of hero does that?

column1: 呵呵，这叫以其人之道还治其人之身。
column2: Heh. I'm merely giving you a taste of your own medicine.

column1: 还是#PlayerName#脑袋灵活，以后我也试试这招......
column2: #PlayerName# really is quick-witted. I'll try that trick myself next time...
You dog, another ambush? Come on then!

column1: #PlayerName#，姜师姐你们去求援，我来断后！
column2: #PlayerName#, Senior Sister Jiang, go get help. I'll cover the retreat!

column1: 算了算了，各位如此执着，我就卖个面子。\n先走一步，告辞！
column2: Enough, enough. Since you're all so persistent, I'll give you some face.\nI'll be going now. Farewell!

column1: 哎，别追了别追了，思迟你看看你都伤成什么样子了。
column2: Stop chasing him, Sichi! Look at the state you're in.

column1: 师姐没事，我都习惯了……哎哟哎哟！看来是受了内伤。
column2: I'm fine, Senior Sister. I'm used to it... Ow, ow! Looks like I suffered an Internal Injury.

column1: 这点痛都忍不了，还学别人行侠仗义啊？
column2: You can't even endure this much pain, yet you want to play the wandering hero?

column1: 师姐莫要取笑，我……\n哎，我学艺不精，对不起师傅和各位师兄弟。
column2: Please don't tease me, Senior Sister. I...\nSigh. My Martial Arts are poor. I've let Master and everyone down.

column1: 好啦好啦，你有侠义之心是好事，\n只是以后莫要再不顾性命，出头逞强了。
column2: Alright, alright. Having a chivalrous heart is a good thing,\nbut from now on, don't risk your life just to show off and play the hero.

column1: 嗯，多谢#PlayerName#和师姐搭救，我以后会小心的。
column2: Mm. Thank you, #PlayerName# and Senior Sister, for saving me. I'll be more careful from now on.

column1: 我反正是习惯了，不过杨师兄你以后尽量别招惹太厉害的人物。\n若是把什么七大恶人招来了，怕是师傅也救不了你咯！
column2: I'm used to it by now, but Senior Brother Yang, try not to provoke anyone too powerful.\nIf you somehow attract one of the Seven Great Villains, even Master might not be able to save you!
Hehehe. Don't worry, #PlayerName#. I know my limits.

column1: 你要是有分寸，师姐我也不至于整日操心。\n好了好了，快随我回门派疗伤去，别落下什么病根了。
column2: If you knew your limits, I wouldn't have to worry about you every day.\nCome on, back to the Sect for treatment. Don't let those injuries leave any lasting problems.

column1: 哦，#PlayerName#！来得正好！你来与我过两招！
column2: Oh, #PlayerName#! Perfect timing! Come exchange a few moves with me!

column1: 啊？这么突然？我先准备准备…
column2: Huh? So suddenly? Let me get ready first...

column1: 哎呀呀，#TargetInteractName#剑法好生凌厉，\n承让了承让了。
column2: Whoa, #TargetInteractName#'s Sword technique is fierce.\nYou let me win, you let me win.

column1: 哎呀呀，#TargetInteractName#剑法好生凌厉，\n我甘拜下风！
column2: Whoa, #TargetInteractName#'s Sword technique is fierce.\nI admit defeat!

column1: 哎，总觉得还是不对……\n不对不对，肯定有问题。
column2: Sigh, something still feels wrong...\nNo, no. There has to be a problem.

column1: 有啥不对的，#TargetInteractName#怎么神神叨叨的，莫不是练功走火入魔了？
column2: What's wrong with it? #TargetInteractName# is acting so mysterious. Did you suffer Qi Deviation from training?

column1: 哎，我整日在山上与师兄弟们切磋，\n各自的剑招已是烂熟于胸，毫无新意，闭着眼睛也能应对自如了。
column2: Sigh. I spar with our Senior Brothers and Sisters on the mountain every day.\nI know all their Sword moves by heart now. There's nothing new, and I could deal with them with my eyes closed.

column1: 长此以往，这剑招是越来越老气俗套，乏善可陈了，\n何年何月，才能窥见武学之巅峰！
column2: If this keeps up, my Sword techniques will only grow stale and conventional, with nothing worth mentioning.\nWhen will I ever glimpse the pinnacle of Martial Arts?

column1: 老气俗套？我怎么没看出来。
column2: Stale and conventional? I don't see it.

column1: 不是很明显么？这剑招是有“气”蕴含其中的，\n用手使出来和用心使出来，自是截然不同！\n我近来的招式，越来越像是用手使出来的，而非用心使出来的了。
column2: Isn't it obvious? A Sword move carries a certain 'spirit' within it.\nA move performed with the hand and one performed with the heart are completely different!\nLately my techniques feel more and more like something done by hand, not from the heart.

column1: 啊？虽然听不懂，但感觉很高深的样子。
column2: Huh? I don't really understand, but it sounds profound.

column1: 总之这样下去可不行，得下山去见见世面了。\n寻几位前辈高人切磋学习一番，方能移除成规，突破桎梏。
column2: Anyway, I can't go on like this. I need to leave the mountain and broaden my horizons.\nI should spar with some senior experts and learn from them, so I can break old habits and overcome this bottleneck.

column1: 啊？这前辈高人，都是神龙见首不见尾的，没那么容易寻得吧。
column2: Huh? Senior experts are elusive. They're not exactly easy to find.

column1: 本门附近不就有一个么？\n武当派文逸真人！听说她一手太极剑法出神入化，咱就先去寻她。
column2: Isn't there one right near our Sect?\nDaoist Wenyi of Wudang Sect! I hear her Taiji Sword is extraordinary. Let's go find her first.

column1: 啊？那可是堂堂武当派副掌门，\n怕是不会见我们这两个来路不明的小虾米吧……
column2: Huh? She's the Vice Sect Leader of Wudang Sect.\nShe probably won't meet two nobodies like us...

column1: 不试试怎么知道？\n习武之人最忌瞻前顾后，畏畏缩缩，\n说干就干，咱们赶紧出发。
column2: How will we know unless we try?\nA martial artist must never hesitate or shrink back.\nOnce you've decided, act. Let's go!

column1: 好吧好吧，到时候吃了闭门羹，可别怪我没提醒你。
column2: Alright, alright. If she shuts the door in our faces, don't say I didn't warn you.

column1: 哇，武当果真是名门大派，这亭台楼阁依山而建，鳞次栉比，廊腰缦回，檐牙高啄，\n俯瞰荆襄大地，只见平原千里，江山锦绣。\n武当奇观七十二，峰峦叠翠探虚空，真是名不虚传！
column2: Wow, Wudang truly is a prestigious Sect. These pavilions and halls climb the mountainside in orderly rows, with winding corridors and soaring eaves.\nLooking over the lands of Jingxiang, vast plains stretch into the distance beneath a magnificent landscape.\nWudang's seventy-two wonders, emerald peaks reaching into the clouds... it truly lives up to its reputation!

column1: 好了好了，#PlayerName#别欣赏风景了，还有正事要办呢。
column2: Alright, alright, #PlayerName#. Enough sightseeing. We still have important business to handle.

column1: （你们紧赶慢赶走了数时，眼看就要到武当门口，\n忽见一名女道自悬崖上飘然而下，朝你们盈盈施了一礼）
column2: (You hurry onward for several hours. Just as Wudang's gates come into view,\na female Daoist suddenly glides down from the cliff and gracefully bows to you.)

column1: 两位小友，行色匆匆，是要寻什么人去吗？
column2: You two seem to be in quite a hurry. Are you looking for someone?

column1: 不错，我们去寻文逸真人。\n听说她一手太极剑法出神入化，特意前去讨教讨教。
column2: Yes. We're looking for Daoist Wenyi.\nWe heard her Taiji Sword is extraordinary, so we came specifically to ask for guidance.
Senior Sister Yu, mind your words!

column1: 呵呵，没事没事，小姑娘志气高远，并非坏事。\n不过这文逸真人避世绝俗，不见外人，我代她和你们过两招如何？
column2: Hehe, it's fine. The young lady has lofty ambitions; that's no bad thing.\nBut Daoist Wenyi lives in seclusion and does not meet outsiders. How about I exchange a few moves with you in her place?

column1: 前辈你也会太极剑法吗？
column2: Senior, you know Taiji Sword too?
Then allow us to ask for a lesson!

column1: 我这以大欺小，有违江湖道义，就以三招为限定胜负，如何？
column2: It would go against Jianghu propriety for me to bully juniors. Let us decide the outcome within three moves. How about it?

column1: 两位年纪轻轻，就能在我手下挺过三招，\n在江湖年轻一代中已属凤毛麟角，日后必有一番成就。
column2: You're both still young, yet you managed to last three moves against me.\nAmong the younger generation of the Jianghu, talent like yours is exceedingly rare. You are certain to accomplish great things in time.

column1: 两位年纪轻轻，虽未能在我手下挺过三招，\n但在江湖年轻一代中已属上游，日后或有一番成就。
column2: You're both still young. Though you couldn't last three moves against me,\nyou already rank among the better fighters of your generation in the Jianghu. You may accomplish great things in time.

column1: 不敢当不敢当，多谢前辈手下留情。
column2: You flatter us. Thank you for showing mercy, Senior.

column1: 嗯……原来这就是太极剑法……我已有所领悟。
column2: Hmm... so this is Taiji Sword... I think I understand something now.

column1: 哦？你能看出这太极剑法，有何玄妙之处？
column2: Oh? Then tell me—what subtleties do you see in this Taiji Sword?

column1: 这太极剑法不着形貌，不留痕迹，\n看似信手挥洒，实则是大音希声，大道无形，\n令对敌者无从下手，无法可破，便可无招胜有招。
column2: Taiji Sword has no fixed form and leaves no trace.\nIt may look effortless, but its essence is that the greatest sound is barely heard and the Great Way is formless.\nIt gives the opponent nothing to seize and nothing to counter—formlessness defeats fixed techniques.

column1: 只是前辈的剑法，依我看还有雕琢粉饰之痕迹，\n能看出诸多武当道剑的路数，距离无招之境界还有些距离。
column2: Still, Senior, your Sword carries traces of deliberate refinement.\nI can see many patterns of Wudang Sword within it, so it is still some way from true formlessness.

column1: （这女娃儿……说的竟有几分道理。）
column2: (This girl... what she says actually makes some sense.)

column1: 余师姐说什么呢？\n初生牛犊不怕虎，前辈你莫要与她一般见识。
column2: Senior Sister Yu, what are you saying?\nA newborn calf doesn't fear a tiger. Senior, please don't take offense at her bluntness.

column1: 呵呵呵呵，你们二人资质不错，\n若是有意，今天便拜入我武当门下，如何？\n假以时日，也能一睹这太极剑法之神髓。
column2: Hehehe. You two are quite talented.\nIf you're willing, why not join Wudang Sect today?\nGiven time, you may even glimpse the true essence of Taiji Sword.

column1: 不行不行，我已师从仙霞派，不可背弃师门。
column2: No, I can't. I'm already a disciple of Xianxia Sect and cannot betray my Sect.

column1: 看来缘分未至，可惜可惜。\n两位小友招式之中的纰漏，我便也投桃报李，替你们一一指出……（一番指点）
column2: Then our paths are not yet destined to meet. What a pity.\nAs for the flaws in your techniques, let me return the favor and point them out one by one... (She offers some guidance.)

column1: 前辈所言果真鞭辟入里，受教了！
column2: Your guidance truly gets to the heart of it, Senior. I have learned much.

column1: 好了，两位小友，我还有事在身，先行告辞了！
column2: Alright, my young friends. I have other matters to attend to, so I'll take my leave.

column1: 师姐你怎么说话没大没小的，\n还好前辈没有生气，否则我们非得吃不了兜着走。
column2: Senior Sister, why did you speak to her so casually?\nIt's a good thing she didn't get angry, or we would've been in serious trouble.

column1: 她的招式虽说精妙，但就是有纰漏嘛！\n#PlayerName#何必如此毕恭毕敬的？
column2: Her techniques were exquisite, but they still had flaws!\nWhy does #PlayerName# have to be so deferential?

column1: 你懂啥，此人太极剑法信手拈来，绝对是武当高层人物。\n江湖中人见到，巴结还来不及呢，哪像你……
column2: What do you know? She used Taiji Sword as naturally as breathing. She's definitely one of Wudang's senior figures.\nMost people in the Jianghu would be desperate to curry favor with someone like her, unlike you...

column1: 武学之道，唯有强弱，分什么地位高低，前辈后辈？
column2: In Martial Arts, there is only strength and weakness. Why divide people by status, rank, seniority, or age?

column1: 好啦好啦，今日一战，收获颇丰，我回去参悟去了。\n下次想下山的时候，我再飞鸽找你！
column2: Alright, alright. I gained a lot from today's fight, so I'm going back to reflect on it.\nNext time I want to go down the mountain, I'll send you a carrier pigeon!
H-Hey... take care, Senior Sister Yu...

column1: （小声嘀咕）哎，要能加入武当派，也是不错。\n以后在江湖中也可以横行霸道，吃香喝辣了……
column2: (Muttering quietly) Sigh... joining Wudang Sect wouldn't be bad either.\nThen I could swagger around the Jianghu, eating and drinking well wherever I go...

column1: （忽然回头）说什么呐！师傅对我们恩深义重，\n#PlayerName#你若有二心，我可要清理门户了啊！
column2: (Suddenly turns back) What did you say?! Master has shown us immense kindness.\n#PlayerName#, if you harbor any disloyal thoughts, I'll personally clean house!

column1: 嘿嘿，开玩笑开玩笑，我对师傅老人家可是忠心耿耿，天地可鉴。\n师姐慢走~
column2: Hehe, just joking, just joking. My loyalty to Master is beyond question—Heaven and Earth can bear witness.\nTake care, Senior Sister~

column1: 师姐早啊！一起去用早点不？\n听说小师妹又学了几手新菜式，这不得好好品尝一番啊？
column2: Morning, Senior Sister! Want to have breakfast together?\nI heard Junior Sister learned a few new dishes. We have to give them a proper taste, right?

column1: #PlayerName#？难得你起的这么早，\n看来还是小师妹的菜有吸引力啊。
column2: #PlayerName#? It's rare to see you awake this early.\nLooks like Junior Sister's cooking is more motivating than anything else.

column1: 师姐这话说得，我最近可是每日都有早起练功的哦。
column2: Come on, Senior Sister. I've been getting up early to train every day lately.

column1: 呵呵，你这早起是巳时还是午时啊？\n好了好了，吃完早点赶紧练功去。
column2: Hehe. When you say 'early,' do you mean late morning or noon?\nAlright, alright. Finish breakfast and go train.

column1: 不知为何，今天门派里格外安静呢。
column2: For some reason, the Sect is unusually quiet today.

column1: 是啊……总感觉哪里不太对劲……师兄弟们都去哪儿了？
column2: Yeah... something feels wrong... Where did all our Senior Brothers and Sisters go?

column1: （察觉一阵劲风袭来，你猛然出手，击落来袭的暗器！）\n慢着，师姐当心！
column2: (Sensing a sharp gust, you strike in an instant and knock down the incoming hidden weapon!)\nWait—Senior Sister, watch out!

column1: 师姐莫慌。快来人呐，有刺客！保护师姐！
column2: Don't panic, Senior Sister. Someone, come quickly! Assassins! Protect Senior Sister!

column1: 师姐！又有几个贼人现身，似乎是冲着你而来。\n要不你先走一步，此处我来抵挡！
column2: Senior Sister! More villains have appeared, and they seem to be after you.\nWhy don't you leave first? I'll hold them here!

column1: 身为师姐，怎能让#PlayerName#孤军奋战？\n你们既是冲我来的，那就放过#PlayerName#！
column2: How could I, as your Senior Sister, let #PlayerName# fight alone?\nIf you're here for me, then leave #PlayerName# out of this!

column1: 师姐放心，我#$PlayerName#料理这些小贼不在话下。\n只是你自己多加小心！
column2: Don't worry, Senior Sister. I, #$PlayerName#, can handle these petty thieves.\nJust be careful yourself!

column1: #PlayerName#，早饭都快凉了……\n什么情况什么情况？怎么这么多黑衣蒙面人？\n姜师姐怎么受伤了？
column2: #PlayerName#, breakfast is getting cold...\nWhat happened? Why are there so many masked men in black?\nHow did Senior Sister Jiang get hurt?

column1: 有有有有有刺客！！！\n狗贼，敢来仙霞派撒野，先过我杨思迟这关！
column2: A-a-a-assassins!!!\nYou dogs dare cause trouble in Xianxia Sect? You'll have to get past me, Yang Sichi, first!

column1: 杨师弟，小师妹，你们先护住姜师姐。
column2: Junior Brother Yang, Junior Sister, protect Senior Sister Jiang first.

column1: 贼人武功高强，就由我和#PlayerName#来抵挡，\n你们千万小心，拖住贼人，师傅马上就到！
column2: These villains are skilled. #PlayerName# and I will hold them off.\nBe careful and keep them occupied. Master will be here soon!

column1: 大白天的，哪来的狗贼，敢搅了小爷清梦？
column2: In broad daylight? What dogs dare disturb this young master's peaceful sleep?

column1: 今日有所感悟，正好拿你们试剑！
column2: I had an insight today. Perfect timing—I'll test my Sword on you!

column1: 哼！姜师妹所受之伤，定当百倍奉还！
column2: Hmph! I will repay Senior Sister Jiang's wounds a hundredfold!

column1: 师傅，您老人家可算来了，这些刺客当真是嚣张至极。
column2: Master, you finally made it! These assassins are outrageously bold.

column1: 徒儿莫慌，今日恰逢御史大人来访，\n待我们二位好好教训这群不长眼的贼人。
column2: Don't panic, disciple. Imperial Censor Chu happened to be visiting today.\nThe two of us will teach these blind fools a proper lesson.

column1: 哼，大胆贼人，竟敢在这光天化日之下为非作歹，给我束手就擒！
column2: Hmph! Insolent villains! You dare commit crimes in broad daylight? Surrender at once!

column1: 贼人终于败退，作鸟兽散了。\n胥华，你与游年去掩杀一阵，莫要放跑了余党。
column2: The villains have finally broken and fled in all directions.\nXuhua, take Younian and pursue them. Don't let the remnants escape.
Yes, Master. Leave it to us!

column1: 哎，只可惜今天本门一片大乱，让御史大人见笑了。
column2: Sigh. What a mess our Sect has become today. Imperial Censor, I'm embarrassed you had to see this.

column1: 姜掌门不必过谦，我也是探查到相关情报，\n贼人可能会对贵派姜婉姑娘图谋不轨，才特意选在今日拜访。
column2: Sect Leader Jiang, there's no need to be modest. I uncovered intelligence that the villains might target Miss Jiang Wan,\nwhich is precisely why I chose today to visit.

column1: 御史大人明察秋毫，佩服佩服。
column2: Imperial Censor, your insight is remarkable. I admire it.

column1: 御史大人，我不过是一介平民女子，\n为何会招来这么多刺客？
column2: Imperial Censor, I'm merely an ordinary woman.\nWhy would so many assassins come after me?

column1: 今天若不是#PlayerName#拼命保护，\n我恐怕是凶多吉少......
column2: If #PlayerName# hadn't risked everything to protect me today,\nI fear I might not have survived...

column1: 御史？你就是号称风林火山的四大御史之一？
column2: Imperial Censor? You're one of the Four Imperial Censors known as Wind, Forest, Fire, and Mountain?

column1: 正是，忘了自我介绍了。\n在下楚风疾，目前在朝廷当差，专司追捕为非作歹的江湖人士。\n承蒙圣上厚爱，得了个“御史”的虚职，惭愧惭愧。
column2: Indeed. I forgot to introduce myself.\nI am Chu Fengji. I currently serve the imperial court, specializing in hunting down criminals of the Jianghu.\nHis Majesty has graciously granted me the nominal post of 'Imperial Censor.' I am hardly worthy of it.
I feel like I've seen you somewhere before...

column1: 咳咳咳，这话说的……我时常微服出巡，探查情报。\n或许不经意间与姑娘你打了照面，实属正常。
column2: Ahem, well... I often travel incognito to investigate cases.\nPerhaps we crossed paths without realizing it. Nothing unusual about that.

column1: 等等，不对！你是之前偷姜师姐贴身衣物的淫贼！\n身形和武功路数一模一样！
column2: Wait, no! You're the pervert who stole Senior Sister Jiang's undergarments before!\nSame build, same Martial Arts!

column1: 这这这，咳咳咳咳！\n没有没有，我堂堂御史，怎会……
column2: W-w-well, ahem ahem!\nNo, no! I am a dignified Imperial Censor. How could I possibly...

column1: 哎，此事御史大人已经向为师致歉过了，\n皆是为了探查一件要案，实在不得已方才出此下策。
column2: Sigh. The Imperial Censor has already apologized to me for that matter.\nHe was investigating an important case and had no choice but to resort to such methods.

column1: 师傅您莫要被这淫贼蒙蔽了，\n查案就查案，和我姜师姐的贴身衣物有什么关系！\n淫贼看剑！
column2: Master, don't let this pervert fool you!\nInvestigating is one thing. What could it possibly have to do with Senior Sister Jiang's undergarments?!\nPervert, take my sword!

column1: 哎！慢着慢着，此事说来话长，\n包括这次的杀手，皆与你姜师姐的身世有关！\n你们不知其中利害，方才有此误会。
column2: Hey! Wait, wait! It's a long story.\nThe killers this time—and that earlier incident—are both connected to Senior Sister Jiang's origins!\nYou didn't understand the danger involved, which is why this misunderstanding happened.

column1: 惭愧惭愧，这位女侠你就刺我一剑消消气好了，\n只是还请不要把此事传扬出去，坏了我楚风疾一世英名……
column2: My apologies, my apologies. Heroine, if it will calm you down, you may stab me once.\nI only ask that you don't spread this story around and ruin my lifelong reputation...

column1: 哼，刺你怕脏了我这剑！\n师傅，您说这一切都与姜师姐身世有关，还请明示！
column2: Hmph! Stabbing you would only dirty my Sword.\nMaster, you said all of this is connected to Senior Sister Jiang's origins. Please explain!
Sigh... Since matters have come this far, Wan'er...

column1: 为师瞒了你这么多年，如今也是时候道明真相了。\n其实你并非为师远房亲戚的遗腹子，而是飞龙门副掌门，诸葛伶托付于我抚养的。
column2: I've hidden this from you for many years. Now it is time to tell you the truth.\nYou are not the posthumous child of a distant relative of mine. You were entrusted to my care by Zhuge Ling, Vice Sect Leader of Flying Dragon Sect.

column1: 姜婉也并非你的真名，这一切都是为了保护你，免遭贼人伤害。
column2: And Jiang Wan is not your true name. Everything was done to protect you from those who wished you harm.

column1: 弟子……难怪诸葛姐姐对我关照有加，那弟子的身世究竟为何？
column2: I... No wonder Sister Zhuge has always treated me with such care. Then who am I really?

column1: 实话说，为师也不甚清楚，只知你可能是前朝某位忠良之后。\n这位忠臣受奸佞陷害，被判满门抄斩，\n诸葛掌门唯独救下了你一人。
column2: To be honest, even I don't know the full story. I only know that you may be descended from a loyal official of the former dynasty.\nThat loyal minister was framed by corrupt officials and his entire clan was sentenced to execution.\nSect Leader Zhuge managed to save you alone.

column1: 为避人耳目，诸葛掌门将你托付给为师代为抚养。\n同时为免走漏消息，你的真实姓名与身世，恐怕也只有她一人知晓。
column2: To keep you hidden, Sect Leader Zhuge entrusted you to me to raise.\nAnd to prevent the secret from leaking, your true name and origins are probably known only to her.

column1: 原来弟子并非师傅亲眷，有劳师傅一直以来悉心照料……\n只是弟子身世究竟如何，看来只能找诸葛姐问个清楚了！
column2: So I was never Master's relative... Thank you for caring for me all these years.\nBut if I want to know the truth of my origins, it seems I'll have to ask Sister Zhuge myself!

column1: 作为忠良遗孤，为师尽心尽力抚养你，自是天经地义之事。\n只是眼下时机未到，知晓身世之事对你并无益处，\n还是不要向诸葛掌门去求问真相为好。
column2: You are the surviving child of a loyal family. Raising you with all my care was only right.\nBut the time is not yet ripe. Knowing the truth now would bring you no benefit.\nIt would be better not to press Sect Leader Zhuge for answers yet.

column1: 我……话虽如此……弟子也不愿活得如此浑浑噩噩，不明不白！
column2: I... Even so... I don't want to keep living in ignorance, without even knowing who I am!

column1: 江湖中已有风闻，这忠臣之后潜藏在巴蜀一带。\n我上次前来，正是为了追查此事，\n所以翻找了……一些私人物品，万望恕罪！
column2: There are already rumors in the Jianghu that the descendant of that loyal minister is hiding somewhere in Bashu.\nMy previous visit was precisely to investigate this matter,\nwhich is why I searched... certain personal belongings. Please forgive me!

column1: 而今日这群杀手，则是对当今朝廷忠心耿耿的亡命之徒，\n想必也是听到传闻，前来清剿前朝余孽来了。
column2: And the killers today are desperate men fiercely loyal to the current court.\nThey must have heard the rumors too and came to eliminate a remnant of the former dynasty.

column1: 妹子你就算知道了身世，也于事无补，反而增加了泄露天机之风险，\n如今还需先蛰伏在仙霞派，等风闻平息之后，再去追寻真相不迟。
column2: Even if you learn the truth now, little sister, it won't help. It would only increase the risk of exposing the secret.\nFor now, remain hidden in Xianxia Sect. Once the rumors die down, there will still be time to search for the truth.

column1: 那你呢？你身为当朝御史，岂不是也要把姜师姐捉拿归案？
column2: What about you? You're an Imperial Censor of the current dynasty. Aren't you supposed to arrest Senior Sister Jiang too?

column1: 哈哈哈哈，什么“御史”，不过一介虚名而已！\n我楚风疾只抓大奸大恶之人，姜妹子身为忠良之后，何罪之有？\n若是把她抓去受审，岂不是要被天下英雄耻笑。
column2: Hahahaha! 'Imperial Censor' is nothing but an empty title!\nI, Chu Fengji, only arrest truly wicked criminals. Miss Jiang is the descendant of a loyal official—what crime has she committed?\nIf I dragged her away for trial, heroes throughout the land would laugh me out of the Jianghu.
Hmph. At least you still have a conscience.

column1: 姜妹子，还请务必再隐忍些时候，在仙霞派内避避风头，莫要逞强。\n假以时日，你之身世自有真相大白的一天。
column2: Miss Jiang, please endure a little longer. Stay within Xianxia Sect and keep out of sight; don't act rashly.\nIn time, the truth of your origins will surely come to light.

column1: 诸位，我还要去追查这群杀手的来历，就不在此逗留了。\n告辞！
column2: Everyone, I still need to investigate the origins of these assassins, so I won't stay any longer.\nFarewell!

column1: 原来我并非姜婉……\n也并非师傅的远房亲戚……\n（低头默默向疗伤室走去）
column2: So I am not really Jiang Wan...\nand I am not Master's distant relative either...\n(She lowers her head and silently walks toward the Medical Hall.)

column1: 无名无姓，无亲无故，\n天下之大，我又该何去何从呢……\n（想到此处，竟几乎要落下泪来）
column2: No true name, no family, no relatives...\nIn this vast world, where am I supposed to go...?\n(At the thought, tears nearly fall from her eyes.)

column1: 余师姐，师傅？你们怎么都在？吓我一跳……\n呵呵，我已不是什么姜婉了，连姓甚名谁都不晓得……
column2: Senior Sister Yu? Master? Why are you all here? You startled me...\nHeh... I'm not even 'Jiang Wan' anymore. I don't even know my own family name...

column1: 姓甚名谁有什么要紧，不过都是父母给的名号罢了。\n一日为师终身为父，只要为师在世一天，你便是婉儿，谁敢反对不成？
column2: What does a name matter? It's only a label given by one's parents.\nOnce a teacher, always a father. As long as I live, you are Wan'er. Who would dare say otherwise?

column1: 就是！无论师姐你身世如何，姓名如何，同门情谊不会改变，\n只要我余采薇在世一天，你便是我们的姜婉师姐，情比金坚，至死不渝。
column2: Exactly! Whatever your origins or your true name, the bond between fellow disciples will never change.\nAs long as I, Yu Caiwei, live, you will be our Senior Sister Jiang Wan—our bond stronger than gold, unchanged until death.

column1: 嗯，师傅，还有各位，你们对我恩重如山，情谊深厚，\n不论身世如何，姓名如何，我也会以#SourceForceDescribe##$SourceInteractName#之身生活下去，\n情比金坚，至死不渝！
column2: Mm. Master, everyone... you have shown me kindness as weighty as a mountain and friendship deeper than words.\nWhatever my origins or name may be, I will continue living as #SourceForceDescribe##$SourceInteractName#.\nOur bond is stronger than gold and will never change!

column1: 什么死啊活啊的太不吉利了，\n姜师姐上次重病蒙你照护，今天我来给你疗伤，走吧！
column2: Enough with all this talk of death—it's unlucky!\nSenior Sister Jiang cared for me when I was gravely ill last time. Today I'll treat your wounds. Come on!

column1: 还有早饭，#PlayerName#别忘了给师姐留一份。
column2: And the breakfast! #PlayerName#, don't forget to save some for Senior Sister.

column1: 放心小师妹，给师姐留着呢。\n等包扎好咱们一起吃！
column2: Don't worry, Junior Sister. We saved some for her.\nOnce she's bandaged up, we'll all eat together!

column1: 师傅，此次之情报颇为可信，\n黑风寨贼人似乎在铁掌帮附近集结，近来异动不断。
column2: Master, this intelligence appears highly reliable.\nThe Black Wind Stronghold bandits seem to be gathering near Iron Palm Gang, and they've been unusually active lately.

column1: 这黑风寨大当家熊百胜，与铁掌帮沆瀣一气，狼狈为奸，\n想必又在策划什么阴谋诡计，不可不防。
column2: Xiong Baisheng, Chief of Black Wind Stronghold, is in league with Iron Palm Gang.\nThey're surely plotting another scheme. We cannot let our guard down.

column1: 哼，顾师弟的血债，我定要让熊百胜和铁掌帮血偿不可！
column2: Hmph. I will make Xiong Baisheng and Iron Palm Gang repay Junior Brother Gu's blood debt in full!

column1: 我已差采薇游年巡查巴陵，巩固防御去了。\n只可惜我在明，敌在暗，加之黄鹤盟约尚在，如今还不可轻举妄动。
column2: I've already sent Caiwei and Younian to patrol Baling Village and reinforce its defenses.\nUnfortunately, we are in the open while the enemy hides in the shadows, and the Yellow Crane Pact remains in force. We cannot act rashly yet.

column1: 胥华你身为大师兄，也算学有所成。\n为师就命你去铁掌帮附近，打探黑风寨贼人情报。\n若能查得对方动向，自然再好不过。
column2: Xuhua, as the Senior Brother, your training has reached a respectable level.\nI want you to go near Iron Palm Gang and investigate the Black Wind Stronghold bandits.\nIf you can learn their movements, all the better.

column1: 嗯，弟子立刻出发，定不辱使命。
column2: Yes. I will leave immediately and will not fail this mission.

column1: 师傅，大师兄一人深入铁掌帮腹地，难免孤立无援，弟子愿一同前往！
column2: Master, Senior Brother is going deep into Iron Palm Gang territory alone. He may have no support. Your disciple is willing to go with him!

column1: 你呀，还是算了吧。\n本次任务颇为凶险，别给你大师兄添乱了。
column2: You? Better not.\nThis mission is dangerous. Don't become a burden to your Senior Brother.

column1: #PlayerName#近来进步神速，大家有目共睹。\n师傅就让他与弟子一同前往，也算历练一场。
column2: #PlayerName# has improved rapidly lately; everyone has seen it.\nMaster, let him come with me. It will be good experience for him.

column1: 既然胥华同意，那你就一道前往，\n注意安全，莫要轻敌冒进。
column2: Since Xuhua agrees, you may go together.\nBe careful and do not underestimate the enemy or rush ahead recklessly.

column1: 师傅放心，定不会给大师兄添乱！
column2: Don't worry, Master. I won't hold Senior Brother back!

column1: （你们隐匿身形，悄悄来到传闻中黑风寨贼人聚集之处。\n只见火光闪烁，炊烟四起，一处小型山寨已近建设完成。）
column2: (Concealing yourselves, you quietly approach the place where the Black Wind Stronghold bandits are said to be gathering.\nFirelight flickers and cooking smoke rises; a small mountain stronghold is nearly complete.)

column1: （趁着夜色翻过低矮的栅栏，你们悄悄向山寨深处潜去。\n四下贼人狂呼大叫，饮酒作乐，丝毫没有察觉你们二人的身影。）
column2: (Under cover of darkness, you climb over the low palisade and quietly make your way deeper into the stronghold.\nBandits shout, drink, and celebrate all around, completely unaware of your presence.)

column1: （小声）大师兄小心，前方有两名巡逻贼人。
column2: (Whispering) Senior Brother, careful. Two patrolmen ahead.

column1: （小声）潜在暗处，等他们接近。听我号令，一起动手！
column2: (Whispering) Stay hidden and wait until they come close. On my signal, we strike together!

column1: （小声）那头目模样的交给我，跟班交给你，\n定要速战速决，不可令贼人反应过来。
column2: (Whispering) I'll take the one who looks like their leader. You handle the follower.\nFinish it quickly. We can't give them time to react.

column1: （轻巧几剑，干净利落结果了跟班）\n小菜一碟。
column2: (With a few quick, clean Sword strikes, you finish off the follower.)\nPiece of cake.

column1: （手起剑落，也将头目斩杀）\n呵呵，#PlayerName#身手不错。
column2: (With one swift Sword stroke, he cuts down the leader as well.)\nHeh. Not bad, #PlayerName#.

column1: 嘿嘿，和大师兄比还差得远。
column2: Hehe. I'm still a long way from Senior Brother.

column1: （连续几剑，都被那跟班格开）\n糟了！贼人要呼救！
column2: (Several consecutive Sword strikes are deflected by the follower.)\nDamn! He's about to call for help!

column1: （手起剑落将头目斩杀，随后回身一剑刺中跟班）\n啧，怎的如此不中用？还需我来擦屁股。
column2: (He cuts down the leader, turns, and pierces the follower with a single Sword strike.)\nTch. How can you be this useless? I still have to clean up after you.

column1: 额……嘿嘿嘿，今日状态不佳，大师兄见谅……
column2: Uh... hehehe. I'm not in great form today. Please forgive me, Senior Brother...

column1: 闲话少叙，大帐就在眼前，\n咱们去旁边探听情报，方为正事。
column2: Enough chatter. The main tent is right ahead.\nLet's listen from the side and gather intelligence. That's what matters.

column1: 大师兄稍等，待我将贼人尸体隐藏妥当。
column2: Wait a moment, Senior Brother. Let me hide the bodies first.

column1: 嗯，差点忘了，我与你一道搬运……
column2: Right. Nearly forgot. I'll help you move them...

column1: 夏掌门恕罪！小的进攻巴陵村，抓获顾游年，\n也算是尽心尽力，为此还折损了不少兄弟。
column2: Sect Leader Xia, forgive me! I attacked Baling Village and captured Gu Younian.\nI did everything I could, and I lost many brothers in the process.

column1: 贵派弟子公孙防殒命，实在是因为仙霞派人多势众，\n打了咱们个措手不及，加上还有官兵援助……
column2: Your disciple Gongsun Fang was killed only because Xianxia Sect had superior numbers,\ncaught us off guard, and even had government troops supporting them...

column1: 噢？熊寨主言下之意，是埋怨我方支援不力？
column2: Oh? Chief Xiong, are you implying that my side failed to provide enough support?

column1: 不敢不敢，夏掌门派两位高徒前来支援，已是感激不尽！\n实在是……人算不如天算呐，夏掌门还请节哀！
column2: I wouldn't dare! Sect Leader Xia sent two outstanding disciples to support us, and I am deeply grateful.\nIt was simply... man proposes, Heaven disposes. Please accept my condolences, Sect Leader Xia.

column1: 听熊寨主说，你眼看作战不利，公孙师兄殒命，\n竟然第一个带头逃跑……可有此事啊？
column2: Chief Xiong tells me that when the battle turned against you and Senior Brother Gongsun was killed,\nyou were the first to turn and run... Is that true?

column1: 师师师师父……师父饶命啊！\n弟弟弟子看到官兵前来，慌慌慌慌了手脚……
column2: M-M-Master... Master, spare me!\nD-d-disciple saw the government troops arrive and p-panicked...

column1: 什么狗屁官兵！我已查明，\n那姜映泉一时间哪里找来这么多官兵，都是巴陵村壮丁假扮的！\n你个废物东西！
column2: What damned government troops?! I've already investigated it.\nWhere would Jiang Yingquan suddenly find that many soldiers? They were Baling villagers in disguise!\nYou useless trash!

column1: 啊？可可可……弟子一一一时之间，没没没能看出！\n师傅饶饶饶命！饶命啊！
column2: Huh? B-b-but... disciple c-c-couldn't tell at the time!\nMaster, m-mercy! Mercy!

column1: 按照帮规，本该将你大卸八块。\n不过眼下正是用人之际，就先留你一条狗命！
column2: By Gang rules, I should have you torn limb from limb.\nBut we're short of men right now, so I'll spare your worthless life for the moment!
You may escape death... but punishment is unavoidable.

column1: 唔啊！\n（被一掌命中胸口，惨叫一声喷出大口献血，随后昏死在地。）
column2: Ugh!\n(A palm strike slams into his chest. He screams, spits out a mouthful of blood, and collapses unconscious.)

column1: 给我抬下去！铁掌帮内再有胆敢临阵脱逃者，皆是跟他一个下场！\n到时候，别怪我夏天雄手下不留情！
column2: Drag him away! Anyone in Iron Palm Gang who dares flee from battle will share his fate!\nWhen that happens, don't blame me, Xia Tianxiong, for showing no mercy!

column1: （几名铁掌弟子两股战战，将昏死的狄坤慌忙抬了下去。\n熊百胜在旁也是噤若寒蝉，往老脸上抹一把汗。）
column2: (Several Iron Palm disciples, their legs trembling, hurriedly carry the unconscious Di Kun away.\nXiong Baisheng stands nearby in terrified silence, wiping sweat from his old face.)

column1: 呵呵呵，熊寨主，徒儿不肖，让您见笑了！
column2: Hehehe. Chief Xiong, my disciple has embarrassed himself in front of you!

column1: 夏夏夏帮主过谦了。\n铁掌帮高手林立，猛将如云，\n不过是一时失手，让仙霞小贼赚了便宜。
column2: S-S-Sect Leader Xia is too modest.\nIron Palm Gang is filled with experts and mighty fighters.\nIt was only a momentary mistake that let those Xianxia brats gain an advantage.

column1: 话说回来，咱们也重创了姜映泉的得意弟子顾游年，\n如今此人已是废人一个，和死了没多大差别，不算太亏。
column2: Besides, we also gravely wounded Jiang Yingquan's prized disciple, Gu Younian.\nThe man is practically crippled now, barely different from dead. It wasn't a complete loss.

column1: 哼！我夏天雄纵横江湖多年，何曾吃过这种亏！\n熊寨主也是，不仅此前新建的山寨被毁，更是折损不少弟兄，\n如今只能屈居于此荒僻之所，勉强谋生。
column2: Hmph! I, Xia Tianxiong, have roamed the Jianghu for years. When have I ever suffered such humiliation?\nAnd you, Chief Xiong—your newly built stronghold was destroyed, many brothers were lost,\nand now you're forced to scrape by in this remote place.

column1: 哎，都怪仙霞派那群狗贼！\n我二当家三当家，还有豺狼虎豹四兄弟的血债，定要讨还！\n还请夏掌门为小的做主啊！
column2: Sigh, it's all because of those Xianxia Sect dogs!\nThe blood debts of my Second and Third Chiefs, and the four brothers Jackal, Wolf, Tiger, and Leopard, must be repaid!\nSect Leader Xia, please uphold justice for us!

column1: 眼下就有一个绝佳的机会，\n明年……时，佯攻……巴陵村……实则一齐……仙霞派总舵……
column2: There is an excellent opportunity before us.\nNext year... when... feign an attack on... Baling Village... while together... Xianxia Sect Headquarters...

column1: 咳咳，兹事体大，\n日后寻个避人耳目的去处，再与熊寨主详谈。
column2: Ahem. This matter is too important.\nWe should find somewhere away from prying eyes another day and discuss it in detail, Chief Xiong.

column1: 此刻，还需熊寨主继续招募人手，秣马厉兵，\n待到时机来临，定要将这仙霞派连根铲除，一个不留！
column2: For now, Chief Xiong must continue recruiting men and preparing for war.\nWhen the time comes, we will uproot Xianxia Sect completely and leave no one alive!

column1: 哈哈哈哈，夏帮主雄才伟略，智计无双，\n你我二人齐心，何愁仙霞派不灭，姜映泉不死！哈哈啊哈哈！
column2: Hahahaha! Sect Leader Xia is brilliant and unmatched in strategy.\nIf the two of us work together, how could Xianxia Sect survive, or Jiang Yingquan escape death? Hahahaha!

column1: 啊哈哈哈哈！熊寨主，为表诚意，我带了几本铁掌帮秘籍。\n你与寨中兄弟们好生练习，定能精进武艺，受益无穷。
column2: Hahahaha! Chief Xiong, as a token of sincerity, I brought several Iron Palm Gang Manuals.\nHave your brothers study them carefully. Their Martial Arts will surely improve greatly.

column1: 夏掌门对我黑风寨恩深义重，请受我一拜！\n我熊百胜与黑风寨上下几十号兄弟，定当肝脑涂地，报效夏掌门恩情！
column2: Sect Leader Xia has shown Black Wind Stronghold immeasurable kindness. Please accept my bow!\nI, Xiong Baisheng, and the dozens of brothers under me will give our lives to repay your grace!

column1: 哈哈啊哈哈，熊寨主客气了，喝酒！
column2: Hahahaha! You're too polite, Chief Xiong. Drink!

column1: （你们正侧耳细听，忽闻身后寨中鼓噪声起，\n似乎是发现了两名巡逻贼人失踪，眼下正在四处搜寻）
column2: (As you listen closely, a sudden commotion erupts behind you in the stronghold.\nIt seems they've noticed two patrolmen are missing and are now searching everywhere.)

column1: （小声）大师兄，贼人已经察觉，此地不宜久留。
column2: (Whispering) Senior Brother, they've noticed something. We shouldn't stay here any longer.

column1: （小声）你先稍后，我还有事要办……\n（话音未落，便催动轻功消失在夜色中）
column2: (Whispering) Wait here. I still have something to do...\n(Before the words are finished, he activates his Movement Art and vanishes into the night.)

column1: （等了约莫一盏茶时间，只听得寨中喊声不断，惨叫练练，\n四下更是渐渐火起，烟雾冲天，救火之声连绵不绝）
column2: (After waiting roughly the time it takes to drink a cup of tea, shouts and screams echo through the stronghold.\nFires begin rising everywhere, smoke fills the sky, and cries to put out the flames continue without end.)

column1: 不好，有几个脚步靠近，看来是贼人察觉。\n无妨，看我打他们个措手不及！
column2: Bad. Several footsteps are approaching. Looks like they've found us.\nNo matter. I'll catch them off guard!

column1: 区区几个小贼，不足挂齿。就怕贼人越来越多，不胜其烦。
column2: Just a few petty bandits—nothing worth mentioning. I'm more worried they'll keep coming until there are too many to handle.

column1: 该死，这些贼人有两下子，眼看坚持不住了。
column2: Damn. These bandits have some skill. I won't be able to hold out much longer.

column1: 这大师兄怎么还不回来……
column2: Why hasn't Senior Brother come back yet...

column1: （忽然数道寒光划破黑暗，随后惨叫连连，\n贼人嘈杂的脚步声逐渐消散，直至归于死寂。）
column2: (Several cold flashes suddenly cut through the darkness, followed by a series of screams.\nThe noisy footsteps of the bandits gradually fade until everything falls silent.)
What are you standing around for, #PlayerName#!

column1: 哇呀呀呀，吓死我了魏师兄！\n呼~还以为是被贼人发现了呢。\n你怎么搞了这么大的动静？
column2: Aah! You scared me to death, Senior Brother Wei!\nWhew~ I thought the bandits had found me.\nWhy did you cause such a huge commotion?

column1: 哼！听贼人提及顾师弟之事，我怒从心头起，\n去放几把火，杀几个贼人出出气。
column2: Hmph! Hearing those bandits talk about Junior Brother Gu made my blood boil.\nI went and set a few fires and killed a few of them to vent my anger.

column1: 不过这夏天雄武功高强，我俩恐怕还不是对手，\n等他反应过来前，赶紧撤吧！
column2: But Xia Tianxiong's Martial Arts are formidable. The two of us probably aren't his match yet.\nLet's get out before he realizes what's happening!

column1: 另外，适才从贼人身上摸了本刀法。\n放我这儿也没用，#PlayerName#你拿去看看。
column2: Also, I found a Blade Manual on one of the bandits just now.\nIt's useless to me. #PlayerName#, take it and have a look.

column1: 这有什么好谢的？别婆婆妈妈，咱们走！
column2: What is there to thank me for? Stop fussing. Let's go!

column1: 师傅，我与#PlayerName#已探查完黑风寨回来了。
column2: Master, #PlayerName# and I have finished scouting Black Wind Stronghold and returned.

column1: 回来了就好，可探得什么有用情报？
column2: Good. Did you uncover anything useful?

column1: 嗯，那熊百胜，果真与铁掌帮主夏天雄狼狈为奸，\n好像在密谋什么大事。
column2: Yes. Xiong Baisheng truly is colluding with Xia Tianxiong of Iron Palm Gang.\nThey seem to be plotting something major.

column1: 弟子从只言片语中听出，\n铁掌帮想在明年某个时候，佯攻巴陵村，\n实则主力与黑风寨一道进攻本门总舵，来个直捣黄龙！
column2: From the fragments we overheard,\nIron Palm Gang plans to feign an attack on Baling Village sometime next year,\nwhile its main force joins Black Wind Stronghold to strike our Sect Headquarters directly!

column1: 好个夏天雄，果然大胆，\n竟敢越过巴陵村，直接进攻本门防御严密的总舵！
column2: That Xia Tianxiong is bold indeed.\nHe actually dares bypass Baling Village and attack our heavily defended Sect Headquarters directly!

column1: 弟子认为，此计虽然凶险，\n但他们若真佯攻巴陵村，考虑到前几次的经验，\n我们也定会精锐尽出，前去抵御。
column2: I believe the plan is dangerous,\nbut if they really feign an attack on Baling Village, considering what happened before,\nwe would certainly send our elites there to defend it.

column1: 届时总舵防守空虚，若铁掌帮与黑风寨合兵一处，\n确实可以以多击少，打我们个措手不及。
column2: Our Headquarters would then be poorly defended. If Iron Palm Gang and Black Wind Stronghold combined their forces,\nthey could indeed overwhelm us with numbers and catch us completely unprepared.

column1: 嗯，胥华此言有理，万一本门总舵失守，\n轻则死伤惨重，重则百年基业毁于一旦……
column2: Mm. Xuhua is right. If our Sect Headquarters fell,\nat best we'd suffer terrible casualties; at worst, a century of foundations could be destroyed...

column1: 如此看来，此招虽险，回报也颇高，\n确实像是那夏天雄会想出的计策。
column2: Seen that way, the plan is risky but offers a great reward.\nIt does sound like something Xia Tianxiong would devise.

column1: 看来，你们这些时候，还得加强本门总舵的巡查防御，\n同时注意黑风寨和铁掌帮动向，时刻防备敌袭才行。
column2: Then for the time being, you must strengthen patrols and defenses around our Sect Headquarters.\nKeep watch on Black Wind Stronghold and Iron Palm Gang as well, and remain prepared for an enemy attack.

column1: 你们二人此趟劳苦功高，又替本门探得了如此重要的情报。\n这些银两就拿去，作为为师之嘉奖吧。
column2: You two have worked hard and uncovered intelligence of great importance to our Sect.\nTake this Silver as your Master's reward.

column1: 作为大师兄为本门分忧，乃是分内之事。\n这次任务#PlayerName#出力不小，我那份就给#PlayerName#好了。
column2: As the Senior Brother, it is my duty to ease the Sect's burdens.\n#PlayerName# contributed greatly to this mission. Give him my share as well.

column1: 嘿嘿，谢谢师傅和大师兄……\n哎呀，大师兄你怎么受伤了？
column2: Hehe, thank you, Master and Senior Brother...\nHuh? Senior Brother, how did you get hurt?

column1: 小小皮肉伤，不足挂齿。\n弟子先退下练功去了。
column2: A minor flesh wound. Nothing worth mentioning.\nYour disciple will take his leave and return to training.

column1: 好……哎，胥华还是这么爱逞强。
column2: Alright... Sigh. Xuhua still likes to act tough.

column1: 大师兄身先士卒，做出表率，\n我也要努力赶上了啊。
column2: Senior Brother leads from the front and sets an example.\nI need to work hard and catch up too.

column1: #PlayerName#你在这儿悠哉悠哉做什么呢？大事不好了？
column2: #PlayerName#, what are you doing lounging around here? Something terrible has happened!

column1: 什么？！铁掌帮又攻过来了？
column2: What?! Iron Palm Gang attacked again?

column1: 哎呀，什么呀，是你沈师兄！\n师傅发现他偷学铁掌帮武功，正要狠狠责罚他呢！
column2: No, no! It's Senior Brother Shen!\nMaster discovered that he secretly learned Iron Palm Gang Martial Arts and is about to punish him severely!

column1: 你快随我一道去劝劝师傅，饶你沈师兄一次！
column2: Come with me quickly. We have to persuade Master to spare Senior Brother Shen this once!

column1: 哦……沈师兄偷学铁掌帮武功？\n我也……有所耳闻就是了。
column2: Oh... Senior Brother Shen secretly learned Iron Palm Gang Martial Arts?\nI... may have heard something about that.

column1: 走，我们一道去劝劝师傅便是。
column2: Come on. Let's go persuade Master together.

column1: 退儿，为师待你向来不薄，本门武功也大都任你参阅。\n你为何非要去学那铁掌帮的武功？
column2: Tui'er, I have never treated you poorly, and I allow you to study most of our Sect's Martial Arts.\nWhy must you insist on learning Iron Palm Gang techniques?

column1: 师傅，铁掌帮武功与本门出自同源，\n巴陵村一战，弟子观其路数颇为霸道凌厉，便心生好奇……
column2: Master, Iron Palm Gang's Martial Arts share the same origins as ours.\nDuring the battle at Baling Village, I saw how fierce and domineering their methods were and became curious...

column1: 哼！江湖之大，好奇什么武学不好，偏偏好奇这铁掌帮的？
column2: Hmph! The Jianghu is vast. Of all the Martial Arts you could be curious about, why theirs?

column1: 我仙霞派弟子学习其他门派武功，博采众长，原本是件好事。\n唯有这铁掌帮，杀害你魏师兄，侵占我巴陵村，与本门有着血海深仇。
column2: It is normally a good thing for Xianxia Sect disciples to study other Sects' Martial Arts and learn from their strengths.\nBut Iron Palm Gang killed Senior Brother Wei, occupied Baling Village, and bears a blood feud with our Sect.

column1: 你放着本门武功不好好学，偏去练什么铁掌武功，\n岂非长他人志气，灭自己威风？
column2: Instead of properly studying our own Martial Arts, you chose to practice Iron Palm techniques.\nDoesn't that raise our enemy's prestige while diminishing our own?

column1: 万一带坏了师弟师妹，岂不是都要跟着你，去学什么铁掌武功了？\n那我仙霞派，干脆改名叫“小铁掌帮”好了！
column2: What if you set a bad example for your Junior Brothers and Sisters and they all start learning Iron Palm Martial Arts too?\nWe might as well rename Xianxia Sect the 'Little Iron Palm Gang'!

column1: 师傅！弟子不过是想看看，这铁掌帮武功究竟有何精妙之处罢了！\n如此一来，方能知己知彼百战不殆不是？
column2: Master! I only wanted to understand what makes Iron Palm Gang's Martial Arts special!\nOnly by knowing ourselves and the enemy can we win every battle, right?

column1: 要是因为一时的成见和仇恨，就放弃精进武艺的机会。\n要到猴年马月才能夺回巴陵村，为魏师兄报仇！
column2: If temporary prejudice and hatred make us give up opportunities to improve our Martial Arts,\nwhen will we ever retake Baling Village and avenge Senior Brother Wei?

column1: 大胆！还敢提你魏师兄！\n他才刚丧命于你学的这些铁掌武功之下，你可记得！\n君子爱财取之有道，为了精进武艺，也不能什么功夫都学。
column2: Insolent! You still dare mention Senior Brother Wei?\nHe was only just killed by the very Iron Palm Martial Arts you're practicing—have you forgotten?\nA gentleman seeks wealth by proper means. The same is true of Martial Arts: improving yourself doesn't mean you should learn everything indiscriminately.

column1: 若以后你得了什么五毒教、阎罗殿的邪门功夫，\n为了精进武艺岂不是都要学了去？\n你真不怕为师到时清理门户？
column2: If you later obtained some sinister art of Five Poisons Sect or Yama Palace,\nwould you learn that too just to improve your Martial Arts?\nAre you not afraid I would expel you from the Sect when the time comes?

column1: 退一步讲，就算你执意要学铁掌武功，\n若能提前禀报，诚心恳求，说不定为师也会准许。\n你这样先斩后奏，未免没把为师这掌门，以及仙霞派门规放在眼里！
column2: Even putting that aside, if you truly insisted on learning Iron Palm Martial Arts,\nhad you reported it beforehand and sincerely asked permission, I might have allowed it.\nActing first and asking later shows no respect for me as Sect Leader or for Xianxia Sect's rules!

column1: 师傅！退儿他也是一时鬼迷心窍，还请您老人家息怒！
column2: Master! Tui'er was momentarily led astray. Please calm your anger!

column1: 是啊是啊，沈师兄这是好心办坏事，但毕竟还是对本门忠心耿耿的，\n还望师傅从轻发落！
column2: Yes, Master. Senior Brother Shen meant well but handled it badly. He is still utterly loyal to our Sect.\nPlease give him a lighter punishment!

column1: 难得沈师兄练武如此认真，虽然练的是铁掌帮武功……\n哎呀我是不是说错话了……
column2: It's rare to see Senior Brother Shen take Martial Arts so seriously, even if what he's practicing belongs to Iron Palm Gang...\nAh, did I say the wrong thing...?

column1: 几位不必为我求情。\n一人做事一人当，我沈退甘愿受罚！
column2: None of you need to plead for me.\nI, Shen Tui, will take responsibility for my own actions. I accept the punishment!

column1: 好，念在你还算有自知之明，且尚未铸成大错，\n为师就罚你去后山面壁思过一个月！
column2: Fine. Since you still understand your mistake and haven't caused a disaster yet,\nI sentence you to one month of secluded reflection on the rear mountain!

column1: 这一个月没有为师的允许，不许随意离开后山，听到没有！
column2: For this entire month, you are not to leave the rear mountain without my permission. Do you understand?

column1: 谢师傅！弟子这就收拾被褥，上后山思过去。
column2: Thank you, Master! I'll pack my bedding and go to the rear mountain to reflect at once.

column1: 哎呀，退儿，那后山凄风苦雨的，不是人呆的地方。\n你就和我一起再去求求师傅，他老人家心一软，兴许就放你一马了。
column2: Tui'er, the rear mountain is cold and miserable. It's no place for a person to stay.\nCome with me and ask Master again. If his heart softens, he may let you off.

column1: 姜师姐，自作孽不可活，我犯了门规，自当受罚。\n只是我心中不服，凭什么仙霞派弟子就不能学铁掌帮武功？
column2: Senior Sister Jiang, I brought this upon myself. I broke Sect rules and should be punished.\nI simply refuse to accept that Xianxia Sect disciples should be forbidden from learning Iron Palm Gang Martial Arts.

column1: 为了精进武艺，为了报仇，就是五毒教，阎罗殿的武功，也未必不可学！\n师傅他就是食古不化，冥顽不灵！
column2: To improve my Martial Arts and take revenge, even techniques from Five Poisons Sect or Yama Palace might be worth learning!\nMaster is simply bound by old ways and refuses to change!

column1: 说什么呢，不要命了你！\n好好好，我也不管你了，让你去后山自生自灭好了！（扭头就走）
column2: What are you saying? Do you have a death wish?!\nFine, fine! I won't care about you either. Go to the rear mountain and fend for yourself! (She turns and leaves.)

column1: 哎沈师兄你这又是何苦……
column2: Sigh, Senior Brother Shen... why make things harder for yourself?

column1: 事已至此，沈退你就去后山将就一个月吧。\n按照门规，师傅已经是从轻发落了。
column2: Things have already come to this, Shen Tui. Endure one month on the rear mountain.\nBy Sect rules, Master has already shown you considerable leniency.

column1: 我看他老人家也不是真心发火，就是想让你去后山收收心，\n日后莫要再游手好闲，三心二意，好好修炼好本门武功才是正道。
column2: I don't think he was truly furious. He only wants you to calm down on the rear mountain.\nStop drifting around and dividing your attention. Properly mastering our Sect's Martial Arts is the right path.

column1: ……几位师兄弟，告辞了，我这就上后山去。
column2: ...Senior Brothers, Junior Brothers... farewell. I'm going to the rear mountain now.

column1: 等等！我给你拿了被褥和冬衣。\n要是着凉了，怕冻死你个没良心的！
column2: Wait! I brought you bedding and winter clothes.\nIf you catch a chill, a heartless fool like you might freeze to death up there!

column1: 还有我做的干粮酒水……\n沈师兄，保重。
column2: And I made some dry rations and brought wine...\nSenior Brother Shen, take care.

column1: 哎，沈师弟就是死鸭子嘴硬，\n让他去后山挫挫锐气，兴许也是好事。
column2: Sigh. Junior Brother Shen is all hard words and stubborn pride.\nLetting the rear mountain wear down his temper might actually be good for him.

column1: 希望沈师兄，别为此记恨师傅他老人家就是了……
column2: I just hope Senior Brother Shen doesn't hold a grudge against Master over this...

column1: 哼！明明是他自己作孽，还敢记恨师傅？\n我看早该让他去后山收收心了！
column2: Hmph! He caused this himself, and he still dares resent Master?\nHe should have been sent to the rear mountain to cool his head long ago!

column1: 好了好了，咱们吃香喝辣的，让他自生自灭去！
column2: Alright, alright. We'll keep eating and drinking well while he fends for himself!

column1: 姜师姐，真是刀子嘴，豆腐心啊。\n我看不出三天，她肯定得送饭到后山去。
column2: Senior Sister Jiang has a sharp tongue but a soft heart.\nI'll bet that within three days she'll be delivering food to the rear mountain.

column1: 站住！你就是黑道五鬼？\n竟敢在飞龙门地界撒野，看我不把你捉拿归案！
column2: Stop! You're one of the Five Ghosts of the Underworld?\nYou dare run wild in Flying Dragon Sect territory? I'll see you arrested and brought to justice!

column1: 听说这黑道五鬼，天下名门大派都在悬赏，\n只要把这家伙捉拿归案，定能荣华富贵享之不尽呐。
column2: I hear all the great Sects under Heaven have placed bounties on the Five Ghosts of the Underworld.\nCapture this man and we'll enjoy wealth and honor for the rest of our lives!

column1: 呵呵，这钱，怕你们是有命赚没命花。
column2: Heh. I'm afraid you'll have the life to earn that money, but not the life to spend it.

column1: 我就是高首，高手就是我！\n我高首虽在黑道五鬼中排行老末，武功却是排行第一。
column2: I am Gao Shou—and 'Gao Shou' means expert!\nThough I, Gao Shou, rank last among the Five Ghosts of the Underworld, my Martial Arts rank first!

column1: 双拳难敌四手，大家一起上，到时候平分赏金就是！
column2: Two fists cannot defeat four hands. Everyone attack together, and we'll split the bounty afterward!

column1: 慢着！\n（双手一挥，周身衣服如充气般鼓起，竟喷出许多白色烟雾来）
column2: Wait!\n(He throws out both hands. His clothes swell as if inflated, and a cloud of white mist sprays out.)

column1: 真气化形？此人内功已至化境，不容小觑。
column2: Manifesting True Qi? His Internal Art has reached a terrifying level. We can't underestimate him.

column1: 老子今天心情不错，不想杀人。\n你们若识相，速速留下财物，饶你们一命！
column2: I'm in a good mood today and don't feel like killing anyone.\nIf you know what's good for you, leave your valuables and I'll spare your lives!

column1: 哼，会点内功有什么了不起。\n我们几个车轮战，不怕耗不死你，上！
column2: Hmph. So what if you know some Internal Art?\nWe'll take turns wearing you down. Let's see how long you last! Attack!

column1: 慢着！\n（冷笑两声，弯腰从地上捡起一块石头）
column2: Wait!\n(He sneers twice, bends down, and picks up a stone.)

column1: （手指轻搓两三下，\n那整块石头竟被碾作齑粉，飘飘洒洒落了一地）
column2: (He rubs it between his fingers a few times,\nand the entire stone is ground into powder that drifts to the ground.)

column1: 这这这，这力道，这硬功……\n恐怖如斯！
column2: T-this... that strength, that Hard Skill...\nTerrifying!

column1: 几位莫慌，我看这贼人虽内外兼修，但却不会什么精妙招式。\n我们四面围攻，必能以招式胜之！
column2: Don't panic. This villain may cultivate both Internal and External Arts, but he doesn't seem to know any refined techniques.\nIf we surround him from all sides, we can defeat him through superior technique!

column1: 说的也是，为了下半辈子荣华富贵，和这贼人拼上一拼又何妨？
column2: That's true. For a lifetime of wealth and comfort, why not risk a fight with this villain?

column1: 慢着！\n（冷笑两声，突然衣袖一挥，从怀中飞出一把小剑）
column2: Wait!\n(He sneers again, suddenly flicks his sleeve, and a small Sword flies from his robe.)

column1: （随着手臂挥舞，那小剑在空中回环曲折，弯弯绕绕，\n随后竟直直飞回贼人手中，好似长了眼睛一般！）
column2: (With each wave of his arm, the tiny Sword twists and loops through the air,\nthen flies straight back into the villain's hand as if it had eyes of its own!)

column1: 御剑之术！！！大王饶命大王饶命！小的有眼不识泰山！\n（连连磕头，将身上兵器财物扔到地上，随后拔腿就跑）
column2: Sword Control!!! Great King, spare me! Spare me! I was blind and failed to recognize Mount Tai!\n(He repeatedly kowtows, throws his weapons and valuables to the ground, then turns and runs.)

column1: 咳咳咳咳，阁下武功高绝，是在下输了。\n（作了个揖，丢下兵器财物，跌跌撞撞逃走）
column2: Ahem... Your Martial Arts are supreme. I admit defeat.\n(He bows, drops his weapons and valuables, and stumbles away.)

column1: 哎哎哎几位！……怎么就剩我了……大王饶命！\n（一边丢下财物，一边慌忙逃窜，\n不经意被佩剑绊倒，摔了个四脚朝天）
column2: H-hey, everyone! ...Why am I the only one left? Great King, mercy!\n(Throwing down his valuables as he flees in panic,\nhe trips over his own Sword and falls flat on his back.)

column1: 噢哈哈哈哈哈哈！我高首，天下无敌啊！\n（见人已走远，赶忙弯腰捡拾地上的兵器财物）
column2: Ohohohoho! I, Gao Shou, am invincible under Heaven!\n(Once the others are far away, he hurriedly bends down to collect their weapons and valuables.)

column1: 狗贼，你就是那个什么黑道五鬼？\n二弟三弟，今天咱们飞龙三杰，扬名立万之机会来了！
column2: You dog! Are you one of those Five Ghosts of the Underworld?\nSecond Brother, Third Brother—today is our Flying Dragon Three Heroes' chance to make our names!

column1: 他妈的，又来几个碍事的……\n咳咳，我就是高首，高手就是我！\n我高首虽在黑道五鬼中排行老末，武功却是排行第一。
column2: Damn it, more nuisances...\nAhem. I am Gao Shou—and 'Gao Shou' means expert!\nThough I rank last among the Five Ghosts of the Underworld, my Martial Arts rank first!

column1: 座次排行老末，武功却排行第一？骗鬼呢这是！\n大哥二哥，咱们围上去擒贼。
column2: Last in rank, but first in Martial Arts? Who are you trying to fool?\nBig Brother, Second Brother, let's surround him and capture the villain.

column1: 慢着！\n（双手一挥，周身衣服又如充气般鼓起，竟喷出许多白色烟雾来）
column2: Wait!\n(He throws out both hands again. His clothes swell as if inflated, spraying a cloud of white mist.)

column1: 赏金，我的赏金，快把我的赏金拿来！\n（挥刀砍去，那贼人闪避不及，衣服应声破裂，\n从里面竟掉下个鼓风皮囊来）
column2: The bounty! My bounty! Give me my bounty!\n(He slashes with his Blade. The villain fails to dodge and his clothes tear open,\nrevealing a hidden leather bellows that drops out.)

column1: 慢着慢着慢着！哪来的愣头青？
column2: Wait, wait, wait! Where did this reckless idiot come from?

column1: 好家伙，原来是把鼓风皮囊藏在身上，装作真气充沛！\n三位兄弟莫被唬住了，我们一道擒贼！
column2: Well, look at that. He hid a bellows under his clothes to pretend his True Qi was overflowing!\nBrothers, don't let him bluff you. Let's capture him together!

column1: 装神弄鬼，招摇撞骗，贼人吃我一剑！
column2: Playing tricks and deceiving people? Villain, take my Sword!

column1: 哎哟，哎哟，好小子，给我等着！
column2: Ow, ow! You brat—just you wait!

column1: 嗯？哦！是#PlayerName#啊！我适才正构思一妙招，只需如此施展……
column2: Hm? Oh, #PlayerName#! I was just working out a clever move. If I execute it like this...

column1: 依我所见，武学的精要之处在于战无不胜，攻无不克
column2: To my mind, the essence of Martial Arts lies in winning every battle and overcoming every defense.

column1: 依我所见，武学的精要之处在于勤学苦练，登峰造极
column2: To my mind, the essence of Martial Arts lies in diligent training until one reaches the very peak.

column1: 依我所见，武学的精要之处在于步步为营，攻守兼备
column2: To my mind, the essence of Martial Arts lies in advancing carefully while balancing offense and defense.

column1: 依我所见，武学的精要之处在于修身养性，仁者无敌
column2: To my mind, the essence of Martial Arts lies in cultivating body and character, for the benevolent have no equal.

column1: 依我所见，武学的精要之处在于删繁就简，返璞归真
column2: To my mind, the essence of Martial Arts lies in stripping away complexity and returning to what is pure and true.

column1: 依我所见，武学的精要之处在于活学活用，灵巧多变
column2: To my mind, the essence of Martial Arts lies in adapting what you learn with agility and endless variation.

column1: 依我所见，武学的精要之处在于行云流水，挥洒自如
column2: To my mind, the essence of Martial Arts lies in moving like flowing clouds and water, natural and unrestrained.

column1: 依我所见，武学的精要之处在于避实就虚，随心所欲
column2: To my mind, the essence of Martial Arts lies in avoiding strength, striking weakness, and moving as the heart wills.

column1: 依我所见，武学的精要之处在于算无遗策，克敌机先
column2: To my mind, the essence of Martial Arts lies in leaving nothing unplanned and seizing the initiative before the enemy.

column1: 依我所见，武学的精要之处在于破除陈规，剑走偏锋
column2: To my mind, the essence of Martial Arts lies in breaking convention and taking the unexpected path.

column1: 一旦做起喜欢的事就会废寝忘食，#PlayerName#也会如此吗？
column2: Once I start doing something I enjoy, I forget food and sleep. Are you the same, #PlayerName#?

column1: 若是这门功夫一日不练成，我便一日不得安寝。
column2: Until I master this technique, I will not sleep peacefully for a single day.

column1: 今日艳阳高照，正适合邀三五好友郊游野炊一番
column2: The sun is shining today—perfect weather to invite a few friends for an outing and picnic.

column1: 躺着不动，静静发呆也是一件美事，#PlayerName#也这么认为吧！
column2: Lying still and letting the mind wander is a pleasure in itself. Do you not agree, #PlayerName#?

column1: 我正要去街上闲逛，#PlayerName#若是想来的话就同去吧
column2: I am heading out for a stroll. Come along if you would like, #PlayerName#.

column1: 听说城中名伶正登台唱戏，#PlayerName#何不随我去听几首小曲，快活快活？
column2: I hear a famous performer is on stage in town. Why not come listen to a few songs with me, #PlayerName#, and enjoy ourselves?

column1: 若是一事不能增进武艺或谋取利益，我便万万不愿去做
column2: If something neither improves my Martial Arts nor brings me any benefit, I have no interest in doing it.

column1: 我已习惯独来独往，#PlayerName#若是无事，还望别来打扰。
column2: I am used to traveling alone. If you have no business with me, #PlayerName#, please do not disturb me.

column1: 每日练武练武，真是烦煞人也！
column2: Training, training, every single day... how tiresome!
What brings you to see me, #PlayerName#?

column1: 真巧，我正要离开此处，便遇到了#PlayerName#你。
column2: What a coincidence. I was just about to leave when I ran into you, #PlayerName#.

column1: 击筑复击筑，欲歌双泪横。宝刀重如命，命如鸿毛轻。
column2: I strike the zhu again and again; before I can sing, tears cross my face. A treasured blade is valued as life itself, yet life can be light as a goose feather.

column1: 日出扶桑一丈高，人间万事细如毛。野夫怒见不平事，磨损胸中万古刀。
column2: The sun rises high above Fusang; the affairs of the world are fine as hairs. A common man burns at the sight of injustice, wearing down the timeless blade within his heart.

column1: 滚滚长江东逝水，浪花淘尽英雄。是非成败转头空，青山依旧在，几度夕阳红。
column2: The mighty Yangtze rolls east, its waves washing heroes away. Right and wrong, victory and defeat all turn to emptiness; the green mountains remain beneath sunsets seen time and again.

column1: 士卒涂草莽，将军空尔为。乃知兵者是凶器，圣人不得已而用之。
column2: Soldiers fall among the weeds while generals gain empty fame. Thus we know that weapons are instruments of misfortune, used by the wise only when necessary.

column1: 十年磨一剑，霜刃未曾试。今日把示君，谁有不平事？
column2: Ten years I have honed one sword, its frosty edge still untested. Today I show it to you—who has suffered an injustice?

column1: 贵逼人来不自由，龙翔凤翥势难收。满堂花醉三千客，一剑霜寒十四州。
column2: Rank and honor press upon a man and leave him little freedom; dragon and phoenix soar with a force hard to restrain. Flowers intoxicate three thousand guests in the hall, while one sword casts frost across fourteen provinces.

column1: 人生得意须尽欢，莫使金樽空对月。天生我材必有用，千金散尽还复来。
column2: When life goes well, enjoy it to the fullest; do not let the golden cup face the moon empty. Heaven gave me talent for a purpose, and gold scattered away will come again.

column1: 名花倾国两相欢，长得君王带笑看。解释春风无限恨，沉香亭北倚阑干。
column2: Peerless flower and peerless beauty delight each other, forever drawing the sovereign’s smiling gaze. They dispel the spring wind’s endless sorrow beside the railing north of Chenxiang Pavilion.

column1: 飞剑纵横乍可惊，翻疑风俗妄传声。如今至穷在何处，不出为人平不平。
column2: Flying swords crossing the skies may startle the eye, yet people dismiss such tales as fanciful rumor. Where does true extremity lie today? In whether one will rise to right another’s wrong.

column1: 十步杀一人，千里不留行。事了拂衣去，深藏身与名。
column2: Ten steps, one man falls; a thousand miles, no trace remains. When the deed is done, brush off your robes and go, hiding both name and self from the world.

column1: 能够不断精进武艺，磨炼心性，实在是人生一大乐事。
column2: Continuously improving one’s Martial Arts and tempering one’s character is one of life’s great joys.

column1: 即便穷极此生，也要追寻武学之至高境界。
column2: Even if it takes my whole life, I will pursue the highest realm of Martial Arts.

column1: 江湖中人需得处处小心谨慎，行差踏错一步，就可能招来杀身之祸。
column2: Those who walk the Jianghu must be cautious at every turn. One wrong step can bring death.

column1: 得道多助，失道寡助，行走江湖还需以道义为重。
column2: Those who uphold the Way gain many allies; those who abandon it gain few. In the Jianghu, righteousness must still come first.

column1: 在乱世中能够平平淡淡，无病无灾，便已是大幸了。
column2: In troubled times, a quiet life free of illness and disaster is already a great blessing.

column1: 自由自在，来去如风的江湖生活，怎能不令人心驰神往？
column2: How could one not yearn for a Jianghu life of freedom, coming and going like the wind?

column1: 什么皇图霸业，不过几杯浊酒，三两笑谈罢了。
column2: Imperial ambitions and grand achievements? In the end, they are no more than a few cups of rough wine and a few laughs.

column1: 人生在世数十载，弹指一挥间，还是应当及时行乐才是。
column2: A human life lasts only a few decades, gone in the blink of an eye. Better to enjoy it while we can.

column1: 宁教我负天下人，休教天下人负我。
column2: Better that I betray the world than let the world betray me.

column1: 与我为敌之人，自是应当赶尽杀绝才是。
column2: Those who become my enemies should naturally be eliminated completely.

column1: 人生在世，能得一两知己，便已足够。
column2: In this life, having one or two true friends is enough.

column1: 君子一诺值千金，对待朋友必当生死相依，不离不弃。
column2: A gentleman’s promise is worth a thousand gold. A true friend should stand by you through life and death, never abandoning you.

column1: 知人知面不知心，在结交朋友时，也应当思量三分，不可率性而为。
column2: You may know a person’s face without knowing their heart. Even when making friends, think carefully and do not act on impulse.

column1: 对待朋友应当肝胆相照，毫无保留，#PlayerName#想必也如此认为。
column2: Friends should treat each other with complete sincerity, holding nothing back. I imagine you agree, #PlayerName#.

column1: 对待他人若是真心实意，他人自然也会以真心回报。
column2: Treat others with sincerity and they will naturally repay you in kind.

column1: 缘起相聚，缘散别离，江湖中人身若浮萍，无外如是。
column2: Fate brings us together and fate parts us. Those of the Jianghu drift like duckweed; such is life.

column1: 不论正邪贵贱，男女老少，只要能共饮三杯，便是朋友一场。
column2: Righteous or wicked, rich or poor, young or old—if we can share three cups of wine, then we are friends.

column1: 窈窕淑女，君子好逑，如此风雅之事，又何罪之有？
column2: A graceful lady is a gentleman’s delight. What fault could there be in something so refined?

column1: 若没有利用价值，这样的朋友不如不交。
column2: If someone has no value to me, they are not worth befriending.

column1: 江湖中所谓知己好友，大多是酒肉之交，相互利用罢了。
column2: Most so-called close friends in the Jianghu are merely drinking companions, using one another when convenient.

column1: 兵来将挡，水来土掩，若有人与我为敌，我便要与他分个高下。
column2: When soldiers come, send generals; when water comes, build a dam. If someone becomes my enemy, I will settle the matter with them.

column1: 冤家自是宜解不宜结，但一旦结下，便定要赶尽杀绝。
column2: Better to resolve a grudge than create one—but once a grudge is made, it must be settled completely.

column1: 行走江湖，危机四伏，还是不要与人轻易结下仇怨为妙。
column2: The Jianghu is fraught with danger. It is best not to make enemies lightly.

column1: 江湖中人以和为贵，若能化敌为友，化干戈为玉帛，岂不是美事一桩！
column2: Peace is precious in the Jianghu. If enemies can become friends and weapons can be laid aside, would that not be a fine thing?

column1: 以德报怨，何以报德。对待为敌之人，不能心慈手软。
column2: Repay resentment with virtue? Then what do you repay virtue with? You cannot be soft-hearted toward an enemy.

column1: 往事如烟，去日苦多，没有什么仇怨是不能化解的。
column2: The past is smoke and bygone days bring enough sorrow. There is no grudge that cannot be resolved.

column1: 遇上仇家，我自然要啐上他两口唾沫，方能一解心头之恨
column2: When I meet an enemy, of course I have to spit at them a couple of times before the anger in my heart subsides.

column1: 天下熙熙，皆为利来，没有永远的敌友，只有永远的利益。
column2: All under heaven bustle for profit. There are no eternal friends or enemies, only eternal interests.

column1: 江湖纷扰，不过乱花迷人眼，修炼自身的武功心性，才是求真之道。
column2: The turmoil of the Jianghu is only a profusion of distractions. Refining one’s Martial Arts and tempering one’s heart is the true path to understanding.

column1: 只要日夜苦练，百折不挠，定能在江湖上闯出一番名头！
column2: Train day and night and never yield to setbacks, and you will surely make a name for yourself in the Jianghu!

column1: 江湖险恶，其中魑魅魍魉甚众，#PlayerName#还要多加小心啊。
column2: The Jianghu is treacherous and full of monsters in human form. Take care, #PlayerName#.

column1: 若人人贯彻仁义之道，江湖也定能成为一方乐土。
column2: If everyone upheld benevolence and righteousness, the Jianghu could surely become a peaceful land.

column1: 江湖世事，纷乱繁杂，每每想到都令我头疼不已。
column2: The affairs of the Jianghu are chaotic and complicated. Just thinking about them gives me a headache.

column1: 江湖风云，诡谲多变，唯有顺势而动，方能立于不败之地。
column2: The tides of the Jianghu are unpredictable and ever-changing. Only by moving with the situation can one remain undefeated.

column1: 天下英雄出我辈，一入江湖岁月催，不知这乱世之中，最终几人成名，几人饮恨。
column2: Heroes arise from our generation; once we enter the Jianghu, the years rush by. In these troubled times, who will win renown, and who will leave only regret?

column1: 那些循规蹈矩，迂腐无趣的江湖大侠，却又偏偏好为人师，实在令人避之不及。
column2: Those rigid, dull Great Heroes of the Jianghu also love lecturing others. Best to stay far away from them.

column1: 江湖中人多有侠义之名，可又有几人真能大公无私，行侠义之实呢？
column2: Many in the Jianghu bear the name of chivalry, but how many are truly selfless enough to live by it?

column1: 时无英雄，使竖子成名，当下江湖所谓名门高手，实则大多酒囊饭袋而已。
column2: When an age has no true heroes, lesser men become famous. Most so-called masters of today’s prestigious sects are little more than useless fools.

column1: 随身携带的珍宝，\\n若学识足够会每日自动尝试鉴定。
column2: Treasures carried with you will automatically be appraised once per day if your Knowledge is high enough.

column1: 珍宝在鉴定后才能卖出更高价格。
column2: Treasures can be sold for a higher price only after Appraisal.

column1: 声望达到对方一半才能结识。
column2: You can become acquainted with someone once your Reputation reaches at least half of theirs.

column1: 门派的占领区域达到上限后，\\n就无法占领新的区域。
column2: Once a Sect reaches its Territory limit, it cannot occupy any new areas.

column1: 门派的弟子人口达到上限后，\\n就无法招募新的弟子。
column2: Once a Sect reaches its Disciple Population limit, it cannot recruit new disciples.

column1: 每一级别的武功都有修习数量上限，\\n超出上限后所有该级别武功获得的经验都会减少。
column2: Each Martial Arts rank has a training limit. Exceeding it reduces the experience gained by all Martial Arts of that rank.

column1: 装备负重会影响角色在战斗中的速度。
column2: Equipment Weight affects a character’s Speed in combat.

column1: 成为掌门后，可以在京城皇宫获取御赐勋阶。
column2: After becoming a Sect Leader, you can obtain an Imperial Rank at the Imperial Palace in Jingcheng.

column1: 在官府获取官职后，便可以替朝廷效力。
column2: After obtaining an Official Position from the government, you can serve the Imperial Court.

column1: 野外有时会出现强力恶贼，\\n此时应绕道而行，以免遭到袭击。
column2: Powerful bandits sometimes appear in the wilderness. Take a detour to avoid being attacked.

column1: 探索起始时，偶尔会察觉到高人气息。\\n此时若仔细搜寻，定会有意外收获。
column2: At the start of Exploration, you may occasionally sense the presence of an expert. Search carefully and you may make an unexpected discovery.

column1: 秘籍品质越高，阅读中越容易出现较好的方格。
column2: The higher a Manual’s quality, the more likely better tiles are to appear while reading it.

column1: 放在藏经阁内的秘籍会根据品质，\\n提升全门派修习该武学的速度。
column2: Manuals stored in the Scripture Pavilion increase Sect-wide training speed for that Martial Art according to their quality.

column1: 好感达到50后可以成为朋友。
好感达到100后，可以让关系更进一步。
column2: Reach 100 Affection to deepen the relationship further.

column1: 恶名过高时进入城镇，\\n很可能会被官府或城内侠士抓捕。
column2: Entering a city with high Notoriety may cause the authorities or local martial artists to arrest you.

column1: 行囊超重会减慢你的大地图旅行速度。
column2: An overloaded inventory slows your travel Speed on the Big Map.

column1: 穿着过于沉重的装备会减慢你的战斗速度。
column2: Wearing overly heavy equipment slows your Speed in combat.

column1: 在编纂秘籍时，\\n你可以将两本低品质秘籍合成一本高品质秘籍。
column2: When Compiling Manuals, you can combine two low-quality Manuals into one higher-quality Manual.

column1: 与对方的性格越接近，好感提升越快。
column2: The closer your Personalities are, the faster Affection increases.

column1: 与对方的立场越接近，初始好感越高。
column2: The closer your Alignments are, the higher your Initial Affection.

column1: 较高的恶名会降低好感获取，\\n其他侠士在野外遭遇时也会避而远之。
column2: High Notoriety reduces Affection Gain and causes other martial artists to avoid you in wilderness encounters.

column1: 袭击同门或亲朋好友，\\n会导致恶名成倍增加。
column2: Attacking fellow Sect members, friends, or relatives greatly increases Notoriety Gain.

column1: 恶名每个月会自动衰减10%，\\n投案自首时也会减少10%。
column2: Notoriety automatically decreases by 10% each month. Surrendering to the authorities also reduces it by 10%.

column1: 在城镇或安全区内行凶作恶，\\n会导致恶名成倍增加。
column2: Committing crimes in cities or Safe Zones greatly increases Notoriety Gain.

column1: 探索耐力耗尽后，\\n每走一步都会消耗越来越多生命/内力。
column2: After Exploration Stamina is depleted, each step consumes increasing amounts of Health / Inner Force.

column1: 战斗中某项伤势较高时，\\n会获得针对该伤势的临时抗性。
column2: When an injury becomes severe in combat, you gain temporary resistance to that type of injury.

column1: 战斗中一名角色败退时，\\n其所控制的机关兽也都会败退。
column2: When a character is defeated in combat, every Mechanical Beast they control is defeated as well.

column1: 在西域灵州的莫高窟中，\\n可闭关遗忘已有的零级武学或天赋。
column2: At the Mogao Caves in Lingzhou, Western Regions, Seclusion can be used to forget Level 0 Martial Arts or Talents.

column1: 外功武学的突破效果，\\n只有在使用该武学时才会生效。

column1: 京城的私宅因为等级最高，\\n价格自然也最贵。

column1: 战场局势瞬息万变，\\n对付实力较弱者也不可掉以轻心。

column1: 侧面攻击提升5%伤害及命中，\\n背后攻击则提升10%。
