站住！你便是雨夜人屠了吧！\n此处江陵百姓与你无冤无仇，还望手下留情，放他们一条生路！
column2: Stop! You're the Rainy Night Butcher, aren't you?\nThe people of Jiangling have no grudge with you. Please show mercy and spare their lives!

column1: 哈哈哈哈，看来你也听过我雨夜人屠的大名！\n老子每逢雨夜便会兴致大发，必须杀满九人方可停歇。
column2: Hahahaha! So you've heard of the Rainy Night Butcher!\nWhenever rain falls at night, I get the urge to kill, and I don't stop until I've slain nine people.

column1: 今日不巧，老子已杀满九人，心满意足正要打道回府。\n你若赶着投胎，下次再来找老子！
column2: Bad timing. I've already killed my nine today and was just heading home satisfied.\nIf you're eager to die, come find me next time!

column1: 狗贼！你作恶多端，罪大恶极，\n我姜映泉今日，便要替江陵百姓讨回公道！
column2: You fiend! Your crimes are countless and your sins unforgivable.\nToday, I, Jiang Yingquan, will seek justice for the people of Jiangling!

column1: 公道？哈哈哈哈哈！公道算个屁！\n既然你一心寻死，我便成全你！！！
column2: Justice? Hahahaha! Justice is worth nothing!\nSince you're so determined to die, I'll oblige you!!!

column1: 哈哈哈哈哈，就这么两下子，也敢来行侠仗义？\n这世间哪有什么公道，你唤他出来救你啊！
column2: Hahahaha! With skills like that, you dare play the hero?\nWhat justice is there in this world? Call it out and have it save you!

column1: （趁着雨人屠与师傅大战，竟不知何时偷偷绕到后方，\n随后掏出一大包石灰粉，重重向雨人屠头上砸去！）
column2: (While Yu Rentu is locked in battle with Master, Shen Tui somehow circles behind him unnoticed,\nthen pulls out a large bag of lime powder and smashes it over Yu Rentu's head!)

column1: 呜啊啊啊啊啊啊！石灰粉？\n竟敢使这种下三滥的手段，给老子死！！！
column2: Aaaaaagh! Lime powder?!\nYou dare use such a low trick? Die!!!

column1: （猛然中掌，顿时直直飞了出去，喷出一大口鲜血）噗！
column2: (A palm strike hits him hard. He is sent flying and spits out a mouthful of blood.) Pfft!
Tui'er, how could you be so reckless!

column1: 师傅......这可是徒儿屯的......上好石灰粉......\n保证叫贼人......睁不开眼......
column2: Master... this is... the finest lime powder your disciple stockpiled...\nI guarantee that villain... won't be opening his eyes...

column1: 你若还走的动路，就快跑吧！\n贼人双眼已迷，为师定能挡住他！
column2: If you can still walk, run!\nThe villain is blinded. Your Master can hold him off!

column1: （话音未落，只见雨人屠一手捂眼，一手狂挥乱舞大刀，已杀奔到眼前）\n杀杀杀杀杀杀杀杀杀杀杀杀杀杀杀杀杀！
column2: (Before he can finish, Yu Rentu charges forward, one hand covering his eyes and the other wildly swinging his blade.)\nKill! Kill! Kill! Kill! Kill! Kill! Kill! Kill! Kill! Kill! Kill! Kill! Kill! Kill! Kill! Kill! Kill!

column1: 胥华，这雨人屠虽说双眼已被退儿用石灰粉迷住，但还是极难对付。\n你们去寻武当派支援，这儿有为师抵挡！
column2: Xuhua, though Tui'er blinded Yu Rentu with lime powder, he's still extremely dangerous.\nGo seek aid from Wudang Sect. I'll hold him here!

column1: 师傅，贼人已经发狂，若是走脱，此地百姓必定又要惨遭屠戮！\n不如咱们仙霞派上下一心，就在此地挡住此贼！
column2: Master, he's gone berserk. If he escapes, the local people will suffer another massacre!\nBetter that Xianxia Sect stand united and stop him here!

column1: 好，为师平日以侠义自诩，今日正当以身作则。\n仙霞派弟子，随我惩奸除恶！
column2: Good. I have always prided myself on righteousness; today I must lead by example.\nXianxia Sect disciples, follow me to punish evil!

column1: 是！师傅，天地有正气，杂然赋流形，\n仙霞派弟子，拔剑！
column2: Yes! Master—'Heaven and earth possess a righteous spirit, which takes manifold forms.'\nXianxia Sect disciples, draw your swords!

column1: 对，大师兄说的正是，天地有正气，杂然赋流形！
column2: Exactly! Senior Brother is right: 'Heaven and earth possess a righteous spirit, which takes manifold forms!'

column1: 下则为河岳，上则为日星。
column2: Below, it becomes rivers and mountains; above, the sun and stars.

column1: 於人曰浩然，沛乎塞苍冥。
column2: In people, it is called the noble spirit, vast enough to fill heaven and earth.

column1: 皇路当清夷，含和吐明庭。
column2: When the imperial road is clear and peaceful, it breathes harmony through the court.
In desperate times... in desperate times, what comes next again?

column1: 时穷节乃见，一一垂丹青。
column2: In desperate times, true integrity is revealed, each name recorded in history.

column1: （捂着胸口，显然伤势深重）\n咳咳咳咳，都什么时候了还有心情念诗......\n先退敌再说吧各位！
column2: (Clutching his chest, obviously badly wounded.)\nCough, cough... Is this really the time to recite poetry?!\nLet's defeat the enemy first, everyone!

column1: 姜掌门莫慌，武当派宋廉庭前来援手！
column2: Sect Leader Jiang, fear not! Song Lianting of Wudang Sect has come to help!

column1: 宋掌门！可算来了，快一道制住这恶贼！
column2: Sect Leader Song! Finally! Quickly, help us restrain this villain!
Very well. Wudang disciples, form the formation!

column1: 水姑娘，又见面了。\n听闻你近来行侠仗义，闯出了不少名声。
column2: Miss Shui, we meet again.\nI hear you've been acting chivalrously lately and have made quite a name for yourself.

column1: 是#PlayerName#啊，真巧！\n正好上次承蒙你出手相助，今天请你喝酒去。
column2: #PlayerName#! What a coincidence!\nYou helped me last time, so today I'm treating you to a drink.

column1: 啊？看你斯斯文文的样子，竟然也会喝酒？
column2: Huh? You look so refined. You actually drink?

column1: 行、行走江湖，怎能不会喝酒？\n敢小瞧本女侠，今天非把你喝趴下不可！
column2: A-a wandering hero has to know how to drink!\nDon't look down on me. Today I'll drink you under the table!

column1: 呵呵，失敬失敬。\n今天就见识见识水女侠的酒量，走！
column2: Heh, my apologies.\nThen today I'll witness Heroine Shui's drinking capacity for myself. Let's go!

column1: 二位客官里面请，今天吃点啥喝点啥？
column2: Welcome, honored guests! What would you like to eat and drink today?

column1: 先给本姑娘来十坛好酒，今天不醉不归！\n这一百两银子够不够，不够我再给......
column2: Bring me ten jars of your best wine! We're drinking until we drop today!\nWill a hundred taels be enough? If not, I'll pay more...

column1: 这、这位姑娘，用不着用不着！\n一百两银子够五十位客官开怀畅饮了。
column2: M-miss, there's really no need!\nA hundred taels is enough for fifty guests to drink to their hearts' content.

column1: 况且本店的酒颇有些烈，\n二位喝上一坛也绰绰有余......
column2: Besides, our wine is rather strong.\nOne jar is more than enough for the two of you...

column1: 看不起谁呢！本女侠喝酒如喝水一般，只管拿上来！
column2: Who are you looking down on?! I drink wine like water. Just bring it!

column1: 算了算了水女侠，\n先上个一坛品尝品尝，万一味道不佳呢......
column2: Easy, Heroine Shui.\nLet's start with one jar and taste it first. What if it's no good?
...Fine. One jar to rinse my mouth first.
Right away. Please wait a moment.

column1: 水女侠，这酒闻着就劲大，你当真要喝？
column2: Heroine Shui, this wine smells strong. Are you sure you want to drink it?

column1: 喝，怎么不喝。\n来，今天和你一决胜负！
column2: Of course. Why wouldn't I?\nCome on. Today we'll settle who's the better drinker!

column1: 好，那我就舍命陪君子，请了！
column2: Very well. Then I'll risk my life to keep a noble lady company. Cheers!

column1: 啊呸呸呸，原来酒这么难喝。\n那些大侠一个个喝得如痴如醉，没想到都是骗人的。
column2: Ptooey! So wine tastes this awful.\nThose Great Heroes drink like they're enchanted by it. Turns out it was all a lie.

column1: 哈哈哈哈，水女侠莫急，后面还有九坛要喝。
column2: Hahahaha! Easy, Heroine Shui. You still have nine jars left.

column1: 不喝了不喝了，再也不喝了，\n不仅辣喉咙，还有股怪味。\n真想不通，怎么会有人喜欢这种鬼东西。
column2: I'm done! I'm never drinking again!\nIt burns my throat and has this strange taste.\nI can't understand how anyone likes this stuff.

column1: 行走江湖，难免跌打损伤，\n加上风吹日晒，奔波劳顿，\n不喝点烈酒，晚上可睡不着觉。
column2: When you wander the Jianghu, bruises and injuries are unavoidable.\nAdd the wind, sun, and exhaustion from constant travel—\nwithout a little strong wine, it can be hard to sleep at night.

column1: “水女侠”你这种养尊处优的大小姐，\n自是不懂这混江湖的辛苦。
column2: A pampered young lady like 'Heroine Shui'\nwouldn't understand the hardships of living in the Jianghu.

column1: 呵呵，我行走江湖也有些日子了。\n像“水女侠”这样身着华服又不谙世事，一看就出自富贵人家。
column2: Heh, I've traveled the Jianghu for a while now.\nSomeone like 'Heroine Shui,' dressed in fine clothes yet unfamiliar with the world, clearly comes from a wealthy family.

column1: 好吧......我还以为自己装侠客装的挺像的。
column2: Alright... I thought I was doing a pretty convincing job of pretending to be a wandering hero.

column1: 水姑娘，江湖凶险，你又涉世未深。\n还是多加小心，早些回家为妙。
column2: Miss Shui, the Jianghu is dangerous and you're still inexperienced.\nPlease be careful. It would be best to return home sooner rather than later.

column1: 我......我可不想回家......\n时候不早，我先走一步，告辞！
column2: I... I don't want to go home...\nIt's getting late. I'll be going now. Farewell!
Sigh... Alright. Take care, Miss Shui...

column1: 等等，不是你请客么？还没结账呢！
column2: Wait, weren't you treating me? You haven't paid the bill!
I'm not drunk... I can still drink...

column1: #PlayerName#？#PlayerName#？！\n你这酒量怎么连我都不如啊......
column2: #PlayerName#? #PlayerName#?!\nHow is your tolerance even worse than mine...?

column1: 你们究竟是什么人？\n我死也不会和你们走的！
column2: Who exactly are you people?\nI'd rather die than go with you!

column1: 好泼辣的小姑娘，今天便要把你绑上山做压寨夫人，哈哈哈哈啊哈哈！
column2: What a fiery little lady. Today we'll tie you up and make you the chief's bride! Hahahahaha!

column1: 水姑娘，听说你被一伙恶贼盯上，就是这些家伙吗？
column2: Miss Shui, I heard a gang of villains has been after you. Are these the ones?

column1: #PlayerName#！正是这群家伙，尾随我好些日子了......
column2: #PlayerName#! Yes, it's them. They've been following me for days...

column1: 光天化日，朗朗乾坤，竟敢在大街上强抢民女，看招！
column2: In broad daylight, under a clear sky, you dare abduct a woman in the middle of the street? Take this!

column1: 深冬时分，腊月初八，北风刺骨，万物萧瑟。\n即便是习武之人如我，也冷得四肢僵劲，不想动弹啊......
column2: Deep winter, the eighth day of the twelfth lunar month. The north wind cuts to the bone and all things lie bleak.\nEven a martial artist like me feels stiff with cold and hardly wants to move...

column1: 此时此刻，若能趁热喝上一碗香甜可口的腊八粥，必定能将周身寒意驱散全无。
column2: Right now, a steaming bowl of sweet Laba Congee would drive every trace of this cold from my body.

column1: 不行不行，口水快挂成冰了。\n不知师兄弟们烹饪准备的如何，待我瞧上一瞧。
column2: No, no—my drool is about to freeze into icicles.\nI wonder how everyone's cooking preparations are going. I'll go take a look.

column1: 真是群没见过世面的家伙，不过就是腊八粥而已，\n又不是什么鱼翅熊掌，有啥好大惊小怪的。
column2: What a sheltered bunch. It is only Laba Congee,\nnot shark fin or bear paw. What is there to make such a fuss about?

column1: 我仙霞派的腊八粥，在这巴蜀一带颇具美名，无人不晓，\n年关将近，自是应当烹调一锅好粥犒劳各位。
column2: Our Xianxia Sect Laba Congee is famous throughout Bashu.\nWith the New Year approaching, naturally we should cook a fine pot to reward everyone for their hard work.

column1: 又开始贫嘴了，你们呀，\n别整天好吃懒做，在旁边游手好闲，也撸起袖子来帮帮忙。\n谁不帮忙，我就往谁碗里加辣椒面！
column2: There you go joking around again.\nStop lazing about and roll up your sleeves to help.\nAnyone who refuses gets chili powder in their bowl!

column1: 我跟着姜师姐学了不少手艺，这腊八粥的做法也是烂熟于心。\n你们若是有不懂的地方，来问我就好啦！
column2: I learned quite a few cooking skills from Senior Sister Jiang, and I know this Laba Congee recipe by heart.\nIf there is anything you do not understand, just ask me!

column1: 本门烹饪这腊八粥，讲究一个同心协力，人人有份。\n不论厨艺高低，皆需尽心尽力，\n如此一来，方知这“众人拾柴火焰高”的道理不是？
column2: When our Sect cooks Laba Congee, everyone works together and everyone takes part.\nNo matter your Cooking skill, give it your best.\nThat is how you learn the truth of “many hands make light work,” is it not?

column1: 刀剑无眼，不想死就把钱财乖乖交出来！
column2: Blades have no eyes. If you do not want to die, hand over your money!

column1: 我劫道多年，刀下亡魂无数！要钱还是要命，自己选吧！
column2: I have robbed these roads for years, and countless souls have fallen to my blade! Your money or your life—choose!

column1: 少侠说的入情入理，我也并非穷凶极恶之人。\n既然如此，今天放你一马便是！
column2: Young Hero, your words make sense. I am not some utterly vicious fiend.\nVery well—I will let you go today!

column1: 少侠可算来了。此行前路颇为险峻，还请少侠替我们护送周全。\n若能安全抵达目的地，本镖局自当重谢。
column2: Young Hero, you are finally here. The road ahead is dangerous; please escort us safely.\nIf we reach our destination safely, the Escort Agency will reward you generously.

column1: 眼看即将抵达终点，四周忽然窜出数条人影将你们团团围住。\n看来这群劫匪已准备多时，特地选在你们最疲惫且松懈的旅程终点，出手劫镖！
column2: Just as your destination comes into view, several figures leap out and surround you.\nThese bandits have clearly prepared for some time, choosing the end of the journey—when you are most tired and least alert—to raid the escort!

column1: 胜负已分，是时候看看本届比武大会的最终名次了...
column2: The results are settled. Time to see the final standings of this Martial Arts Tournament...

column1: 胜负已分，是时候看看本届辩才大会的最终名次了...
column2: The results are settled. Time to see the final standings of this Debate Tournament...

column1: 我可不会口下留情，进言吧！
column2: I will not hold back in debate. Make your argument!

column1: 大家皆是武林同道，今日难得共聚一堂，饮酒畅谈，也算是缘分一场。
column2: We are all fellow martial artists. It is rare for us to gather, drink, and talk freely like this—surely this is fate.

column1: 宾客皆已离场，宴会圆满结束了。
column2: All the guests have departed, and the Banquet has concluded successfully.

column1: 此处阴风阵阵，寒气逼人，诸多骸骨坟包和残破墓碑矗立其间。\n即便勇气过人之士，只怕也会对此地敬而远之。
column2: Cold, sinister winds sweep through this place. Bones, burial mounds, and broken gravestones stand everywhere.\nEven the bravest would think twice before approaching.

column1: 一路跋涉，你终于来到乱葬岗深处，\n没想到坟茔间阴影中，忽有一人暴起发难，抽刀向你袭来，\n竟是一名穷凶极恶的江湖逃犯躲藏在此。
column2: After a long trek, you finally reach the depths of the Disorderly Burial Grounds.\nA figure suddenly bursts from the shadows between the graves and attacks with a drawn blade—\na vicious Jianghu fugitive has been hiding here.

column1: 那名逃犯被你打倒在地，当场将其绳之以法。\n随后你在他的藏身地旁，发现了一处埋藏诸多珍宝的古代坟茔，可寻其中一件进行挖掘。
column2: You defeat the fugitive and bring them to justice on the spot.\nBeside the hideout, you discover an ancient tomb containing many treasures. You may excavate one of them.
Mooring at Night at Niuzhu, Remembering the Past
Gazing at the Moon, Thinking of One Far Away

column1: 牀前看月光，疑是地上霜。
column2: Before my bed, moonlight gleams; I wonder if it is frost upon the ground.

column1: 举头望山月，低头思故乡。
column2: I raise my head to gaze at the mountain moon, then lower it and think of home.

column1: 春眠不觉晓，处处闻啼鸟。
column2: In spring sleep, I do not notice dawn; everywhere I hear birds calling.

column1: 夜来风雨声，花落知多少。
column2: Through the night came wind and rain—who knows how many blossoms fell?

column1: 白日依山尽，黄河入海流。
column2: The white sun sinks behind the mountains; the Yellow River flows into the sea.

column1: 欲穷千里目，更上一层楼。
column2: To see a thousand miles farther, climb one more floor.

column1: 昔人已乘白云去，此地空馀黄鹤楼。
column2: Those of old rode away on white clouds; only Yellow Crane Tower remains here.

column1: 黄鹤一去不复返，白云千载空悠悠。
column2: The Yellow Crane once gone never returns; white clouds drift idly for a thousand years.

column1: 晴川历历汉阳树，春草萋萋鹦鹉洲。
column2: Across the clear river the trees of Hanyang stand distinct; spring grass grows lush on Parrot Isle.

column1: 日暮乡关何处是，烟波江上使人愁。
column2: At dusk, where is my homeland? Mist and waves upon the river fill me with sorrow.

column1: 朝辞白帝彩云间，千里江陵一日还。
column2: At dawn I leave Baidi amid colored clouds; a thousand li to Jiangling, returned in a single day.

column1: 两岸猨声啼不尽，轻舟已过万重山。
column2: Monkeys cry endlessly along both banks; my light boat has already passed ten thousand mountains.

column1: 红豆生南国，秋来发故枝。
column2: Red beans grow in the southern land, sprouting new branches when autumn comes.

column1: 愿君多采撷，此物最相思。
column2: Gather as many as you can, my friend; they most deeply embody longing.

column1: 空山新雨后，天气晚来秋。
column2: After fresh rain in the empty mountains, evening air brings autumn.

column1: 明月松间照，清泉石上流。
column2: Bright moon shines between pines; clear spring flows over stones.

column1: 竹喧归浣女，莲动下渔舟。
column2: Bamboo stirs as washerwomen return; lotus leaves sway beneath a fisherman’s boat.

column1: 随意春芳歇，王孙自可留。
column2: Let spring’s fragrance fade as it may; here a noble heart can linger.

column1: 月落乌啼霜满天，江枫渔父对愁眠。
column2: The moon sets, crows cry, frost fills the sky; by river maples and fishing fires I sleep in sorrow.

column1: 姑苏城外寒山寺，夜半钟声到客船。
column2: Outside Gusu, from Hanshan Temple, the midnight bell reaches my boat.

column1: 君不见黄河之水天上来，奔流到海不复迴。
column2: Do you not see the Yellow River’s waters come from heaven, rushing to the sea and never returning?

column1: 君不见高堂明镜悲白髮，朝如青丝暮成雪。
column2: Do you not see, in the hall’s bright mirror, grief over white hair—black silk at dawn, snow by evening?

column1: 人生得意须尽欢，莫使金樽空对月。
column2: When life goes well, enjoy it to the fullest; do not let the golden cup face the moon empty.

column1: 天生我材必有用，千金散尽还复来。
column2: Heaven gave me talent for a purpose; a thousand gold pieces spent will come again.

column1: 烹羊宰牛且爲乐，会须一饮三百盃。
column2: Cook the sheep, slaughter the ox, and make merry; when we drink, let it be three hundred cups.

column1: 岑夫子，丹丘生，将进酒，君莫停。
column2: Master Cen, Danqiu my friend—bring in the wine, do not stop the cup.

column1: 与君歌一曲，请君爲我侧耳听。
column2: Let me sing you a song; please lend me your ears.

column1: 钟鼓馔玉不足贵，但愿长醉不愿醒。
column2: Bells, drums, fine food, and jade are not worth treasuring; I only wish to stay drunk and never wake.

column1: 古来圣贤皆寂寞，惟有饮者留其名。
column2: Sages and worthies of old are all forgotten; only great drinkers leave their names.

column1: 陈王昔时宴平乐，斗酒十千恣讙谑。
column2: Prince Chen once feasted at Pingle, spending ten thousand on wine in carefree delight.

column1: 主人何爲言少钱，径须沽取对君酌。
column2: Host, why say there is too little money? Go buy wine at once and pour it for us.

column1: 五花马，千金裘，呼儿将出换美酒，与尔同销万古愁。
column2: The dappled horse, the thousand-gold fur—send the boy to trade them for good wine, and together we will drown the sorrows of all ages.

column1: 名花倾国两相欢，常得君王带笑看。
column2: Famous flower and peerless beauty delight each other, always drawing the sovereign’s smiling gaze.

column1: 解得春风无限恨，沉香亭北倚阑干。
column2: They dispel the spring wind’s endless sorrow, leaning on the railing north of Chenxiang Pavilion.

column1: 风急天高猨啸哀，渚清沙白鸟飞迴。
column2: The wind is sharp, sky high, apes cry mournfully; over clear islets and white sand, birds circle back.

column1: 无边落木萧萧下，不尽长江衮衮来。
column2: Endless falling leaves rustle down; the boundless Yangtze rolls on.

column1: 万里悲秋常作客，百年多病独登台。
column2: A thousand miles from home, sad autumn makes me a constant traveler; a lifetime of illness brings me alone to this terrace.

column1: 艰难苦恨繁霜鬓，潦倒新停浊酒桮。
column2: Hard times and bitter sorrow have frosted my temples; worn down, I have lately stopped even drinking turbid wine.

column1: 国破山河在，城春草木深。
column2: The nation is broken, mountains and rivers remain; spring fills the city with deep grass and trees.

column1: 感时花溅泪，恨别鸟惊心。
column2: Moved by the times, flowers bring tears; hating separation, birds startle the heart.

column1: 烽火连三月，家书抵万金。
column2: Beacon fires have burned for three months; a letter from home is worth ten thousand gold.

column1: 白头搔更短，浑欲不胜簪。
column2: I scratch my white hair, now so thin it can barely hold a hairpin.

column1: 千山鸟飞绝，万迳人踪灭。
column2: Across a thousand mountains, no birds fly; on ten thousand paths, no human trace remains.

column1: 孤舟蓑笠翁，独钓寒江雪。
column2: A lone boat, an old man in straw cape and hat, fishing alone in the cold river snow.

column1: 青山横北郭，白水遶东城。
column2: Green hills lie beyond the northern wall; white waters circle the eastern city.

column1: 此地一爲别，孤蓬万里征。
column2: Here we part, and you drift like a lone tumbleweed for ten thousand li.

column1: 浮云游子意，落日故人情。
column2: Floating clouds mirror the traveler’s heart; the setting sun holds the feeling of old friends.

column1: 挥手自兹去，萧萧班马鸣。
column2: We wave and go our separate ways; the departing horse neighs sadly.

column1: 牛渚西江夜，青天无片云。
column2: At Niuzhu on the Western River at night, the blue sky holds not a single cloud.

column1: 登舟望秋月，空忆谢将军。
column2: I board the boat and gaze at the autumn moon, vainly remembering General Xie.

column1: 余亦能高咏，斯人不可闻。
column2: I too can chant fine verse, yet that man can no longer hear.

column1: 明朝挂帆席，枫叶落纷纷。
column2: Tomorrow I raise the sail; maple leaves will fall everywhere.

column1: 海上生明月，天涯共此时。
column2: The bright moon rises over the sea; at the edge of the world we share this moment.

column1: 情人怨遥夜，竟夕起相思。
column2: Lovers resent the long night, rising to think of each other till dawn.

column1: 灭烛怜光满，披衣觉露滋。
column2: I extinguish the candle, cherishing the full light; put on clothes and feel the dew grow wet.

column1: 不堪盈手赠，还寝梦佳期。
column2: I cannot scoop up moonlight in my hands to give you; I return to bed and dream of our meeting.

column1: 时无英雄，使竖子成名，当下Jianghu所谓名门高手，实则大多酒囊饭袋而已。
column2: In an age without true heroes, mediocrities become famous. Most so-called masters of prestigious sects in today’s Jianghu are little more than useless fools.

column1: 若有人敢与我为敌，我定要叫他后悔终生
column2: If anyone dares make an enemy of me, I will make them regret it for the rest of their life.

column1: 即便穷极此生，也要追寻Martial Arts之至高境界。
column2: Even if it takes my entire life, I will pursue the highest realm of Martial Arts.

column1: 若是一事不能improve Martial Arts或谋取利益，我便万万不愿去做
column2: If something can neither improve my Martial Arts nor bring me profit, I absolutely refuse to do it.

column1: 我虽无门无派， in the Jianghu少了份依靠，\n却也不必遵守Faction那些清规戒律，落得一个逍遥快活。
column2: Though I belong to no sect and have fewer people to rely on in the Jianghu, I also need not obey a faction’s strict rules, leaving me free to live as I please.

column1: 若遇到仇家上门，打得过就打，打不过只管逃跑便是。
column2: If an enemy comes seeking revenge, fight if you can win; if you cannot, just run away.

这分舵中人来人往，不乏一些意欲拜入本门的武林人士。\n若是少侠有心，可在此物色一名新弟子人选，估摸着花上五天时间就够了。
column2: People come and go through this Branch, including many martial artists hoping to join Our Sect.\nIf you are interested, Young Hero, you can look here for a promising new disciple. About five days should be enough.

column1: 端午临中夏，时清日复长。\n又是一年端午佳节，不妨去城中闲逛一番，买几个粽子尝尝。
column2: The Dragon Boat Festival arrives in midsummer, when the days grow long and clear.\nAnother Dragon Boat Festival has arrived. Why not stroll through the city and try some zongzi?

column1: 少侠少侠，十万火急，速速救援啊！
column2: Young Hero! This is urgent—please come to our aid at once!

column1: 你按镖头指示抵达目标地点，只见一群强人正围着镖队僵持不下，\n有数名镖师已然身受重伤，勉强支撑着。
column2: Following the escort chief’s directions, you reach the site and find a band of brigands locked in a standoff with the escort team.\nSeveral escorts are badly wounded and barely holding on.

column1: 临时搭建起的擂台颇具气势，四处彩旗招展，人头攒动，\n台上鼓声阵阵，越发急促，已有不少武林人士站在台上摩拳擦掌，\n看来比武大赛即将开始了。
column2: The temporary arena looks impressive, surrounded by fluttering banners and a bustling crowd.\nDrums thunder from the stage with growing urgency while many martial artists are already warming up in the ring.\nIt looks like the Martial Arts Tournament is about to begin.

column1: 这黄鹤楼乃是江南胜景，来往之人不乏小有名气的意气游侠，青年才俊，\n少侠若是愿意花上五日时间在此处寻访，必能拔擢一批可造之材。
column2: Yellow Crane Tower is one of Jiangnan’s great scenic landmarks, frequented by promising young wanderers and talented youths.\nIf you spend five days seeking candidates here, Young Hero, you should be able to recruit several people of real potential.

column1: 宴会持续良久，肴核既尽，杯盘狼籍。相与枕藉，不觉天色昏沉。
column2: The banquet went on for a long while. By the end, the food and wine were gone and cups and plates lay scattered everywhere. Everyone reclined together until, before they knew it, dusk had fallen.

column1: 在这荒野之中竟有一地窖入口，其通路幽深阴暗，回环曲折，\n想必有诸多宵小邪祟之徒盘踞其中，正好将他们一网打尽！
column2: There's a cellar entrance hidden in this wilderness. Its passage is deep, dark, and winding.\nNo doubt all manner of villains are lurking inside—perfect. I'll wipe them out in one sweep!

column1: 一路跋涉，你终于来到无名地窖深处，只见一处堆积着各式财物的藏宝室赫然眼前，\n旁边几名贼人武器在手，怒目圆睁，似乎要将你生吞活剥。
column2: After a long trek, you finally reach the depths of the Unnamed Cellar. A treasure chamber piled high with valuables lies before you.\nSeveral bandits stand nearby with weapons drawn, glaring as though they mean to tear you apart.

column1: 那群恶贼被你悉数击败，纷纷丢盔弃甲，四散逃开去。\n随后你收缴了此处可用之宝物，一把火将这儿烧为灰烬。
column2: You defeat the entire gang of bandits. They cast aside their weapons and armor and flee in every direction.\nYou gather up anything of value, then set the place ablaze and burn it to the ground.

column1: 临时搭建起的擂台颇具气势，四处彩旗招展，人头攒动，\n台上鼓声阵阵，越发急促，已有不少本门弟子站在台上摩拳擦掌，\n看来门派大比即将开始了。
column2: The temporary arena is an impressive sight, surrounded by fluttering banners and a bustling crowd.\nDrums thunder from the stage, beating faster and faster as the sect's disciples step forward, eager to compete.\nIt looks like the Sect Tournament is about to begin.
Sing over wine—how fleeting is life?

column1: 天子呼来不上船\n自称臣是酒中仙。
column2: The Son of Heaven summons him, yet he will not board the imperial boat;\nhe calls himself an Immortal of Wine.

column1: 抽刀断水水更流\n举杯消愁愁更愁
column2: Draw a blade to cut the water, and it flows all the more;\nraise a cup to drown sorrow, and sorrow only deepens.
What can dispel my sorrow?\nOnly Du Kang.

column1: 满堂花醉三千客\n一剑霜寒十四州
column2: Flowers fill the hall and intoxicate three thousand guests;\none sword chills fourteen provinces.

column1: 两人对酌山花开\n一杯一杯复一杯
column2: We drink together as mountain flowers bloom—\none cup, another cup, and another.
